example2_zh: 地方政府可以通过提供更安全的路线和工作场所附近的安全自行车停车设施来鼓励骑行。

meanings_zh: n. 结束；末尾；尽头；v. 结束；终止；n. 目的；目标
example1_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
example1_zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。
example2_en: Governments should aim to end extreme poverty by improving access to education and secure employment.
example2_zh: 政府应通过改善教育机会和稳定就业的可及性，努力消除极端贫困。

meanings_zh: n. 敌人；敌方；n. 危害物；大敌
example1_en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
example1_zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。
example2_en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
example2_zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。

meanings_zh: adj. 精力充沛的；充满活力的
example1_en: Our energetic puppy chased a ball around the garden.
example1_zh: 我们那只精力旺盛的小狗在花园里追着球跑。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can help office workers feel more energetic and maintain concentration throughout the day.
example2_zh: 经常运动有助于办公室职员更有活力，并在一天中保持专注。

meanings_zh: n. 精力；活力；n. 能量；能源
example1_en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
example1_zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

meanings_zh: n. 发动机；引擎；n. 推动力；n. 专用软件引擎
example1_en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
example1_zh: 我们刚到车道入口，发动机就熄火了。
example2_en: Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.
example2_zh: 更清洁的发动机技术可以减少空气污染，但扩大公共交通仍是实现城市可持续出行的关键。

meanings_zh: n. 工程师；v. 设计制造；策划促成
example1_en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
example1_zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。
example2_en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
example2_zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。

meanings_zh: n. 英语；adj. 英语的；英格兰的
example1_en: We practise English together while walking home from college.
example1_zh: 我们从学院步行回家时一起练习英语。
example2_en: Learning English can widen access to international research and help students communicate across cultural boundaries.
example2_zh: 学习英语可以拓宽获取国际研究成果的渠道，帮助学生跨文化交流。

meanings_zh: v. 享受；喜爱；v. 享有
example1_en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。
example2_en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
example2_zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；有趣的
example1_en: The cooking class was enjoyable, especially making fresh pasta.
example1_zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。
example2_en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
example2_zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。

meanings_zh: det. 足够的；adv. 足够地；pron. 足够的数量
example1_en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。
example2_en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
example2_zh: 许多农村学校缺乏足够的资源，无法为学生开设广泛的课程。

meanings_zh: v. 进入；v. 参加；加入；v. 输入；录入
example1_en: Please wipe your shoes before you enter the kitchen.
example1_zh: 进入厨房前，请把鞋底擦干净。
example2_en: Young people often need practical training before they enter the workforce and take on professional responsibilities.
example2_zh: 年轻人在进入职场、承担职业责任之前，往往需要接受实践培训。

meanings_zh: n. 进入；进入权；n. 条目；记录；n. 参赛作品；参赛者
example1_en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
example1_zh: 今天进入游泳池免费。
example2_en: Strict entry requirements may prevent capable students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education opportunities.
example2_zh: 严格的入学要求可能使来自弱势背景的优秀学生无法获得高等教育机会。

meanings_zh: n. 自然环境；n. 生活或工作环境
example1_en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
example1_zh: 我们骑车上学，为保护环境出一份力。
example2_en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
example2_zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。

meanings_zh: n. 橡皮擦
example1_en: I borrowed an eraser to correct my pencil drawing.
example1_zh: 我借了一块橡皮擦来修改铅笔画。
example2_en: Providing basic classroom supplies, including pencils and erasers, helps ensure that all children can participate in lessons.
example2_zh: 提供铅笔和橡皮擦等基本课堂用品，有助于确保所有孩子都能参与课堂学习。

meanings_zh: adv. 尤其；特别
example1_en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
example1_zh: 我喜欢做饭，尤其是在朋友来吃晚饭的时候。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is especially important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
example2_zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通尤其重要。

meanings_zh: n. 论说文；短文；随笔
example1_en: I finished my history essay just before dinner.
example1_zh: 我刚好在晚饭前写完了历史课论文。
example2_en: Writing an essay encourages students to organise their ideas and support arguments with relevant evidence.
example2_zh: 撰写论说文能促使学生整理思路，并用相关证据支持论点。

meanings_zh: n. 欧洲
example1_en: My cousin travelled across Europe by train last summer.
example1_zh: 我表亲去年夏天乘火车游历了欧洲。
example2_en: Many cities in Europe are expanding cycling networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 欧洲许多城市正在扩建自行车路网，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

meanings_zh: adv. 甚至；连……都；adj. 平坦的；均匀的；相等的；adj. 偶数的
example1_en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
example1_zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。
example2_en: Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 即使公共交通只有小幅改善，也能让行动不便者的日常出行更加轻松。

meanings_zh: n. 傍晚；晚上
example1_en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
example1_zh: 我们做饭、听音乐，度过了这个晚上。
example2_en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
example2_zh: 晚间课程让在职成年人无需辞去现有工作，也能获得新的资格证书。

meanings_zh: n. 活动；重大事件；n. 比赛项目
example1_en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
example1_zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。
example2_en: Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.
example2_zh: 举办大型文化活动可以促进当地旅游业，但经济收益的分配可能不均。

meanings_zh: adv. 曾经；在任何时候；adv. 始终；不断地；adv. 究竟；到底
example1_en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
example1_zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？
example2_en: Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 随着不断扩张的城市面临交通拥堵和空气污染，公共交通比以往任何时候都更重要。

meanings_zh: pron. 每个人；所有人
example1_en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
example1_zh: 所有人都在外面等着开门。
example2_en: Public libraries should offer accessible services so that everybody can benefit from opportunities for lifelong learning.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应提供无障碍服务，让每个人都能受益于终身学习的机会。

meanings_zh: pron. 每个人；所有人
example1_en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
example1_zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。
example2_en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。

meanings_zh: pron. 一切；所有事物；pron. 最重要的东西
example1_en: Everything in my bag got wet during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨把我包里的东西全弄湿了。
example2_en: Although digital resources are valuable, students should not assume that everything they read online is accurate.
example2_zh: 虽然数字资源很有价值，但学生不应认为自己在网上读到的一切都准确无误。

meanings_zh: adv. 到处；处处
example1_en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。
example2_en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
example2_zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。

meanings_zh: adv. 精确地；恰好；adv. 正是；完全正确
example1_en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
example1_zh: 这件夹克正是我想要的颜色。
example2_en: Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须准确记录每户家庭的能耗，以确保地区之间的比较可靠。

meanings_zh: n. 考试；测验
example1_en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
example1_zh: 我周五上午有一场数学考试。
example2_en: Schools should consider practical skills alongside exam results when assessing students' overall progress.
example2_zh: 学校在评估学生的整体进步时，应将实践技能与考试成绩一并考虑。

meanings_zh: n. 例子；实例；n. 榜样
example1_en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
example1_zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？
example2_en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
example2_zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；优秀的
example1_en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
example1_zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。
example2_en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
example2_zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

meanings_zh: prep. 除……之外；conj. 只是；除了……情况
example1_en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
example1_zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。
example2_en: The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 拟议的交通政策惠及大多数居民，但偏远农村社区的居民除外。

meanings_zh: v. 交换；兑换；n. 交换；交流；n. 交易所
example1_en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
example1_zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？
example2_en: International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.
example2_zh: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴奋的；激动的
example1_en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
example1_zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。
example2_en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
example2_zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人兴奋的；刺激的
example1_en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
example1_zh: 比赛最后几分钟精彩刺激极了。
example2_en: Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.
example2_zh: 可再生能源的进步为希望应对全球环境挑战的年轻工程师提供了令人振奋的机会。

meanings_zh: n. 借口；辩解理由；v. 原谅；宽恕；v. 准许免做；准许离开
example1_en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
example1_zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。
example2_en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
example2_zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。

meanings_zh: n. 运动；练习；v. 锻炼；运动；v. 行使；运用
example1_en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
example1_zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。
example2_en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
example2_zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。

meanings_zh: n. 展览；展览会
example1_en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
example1_zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。
example2_en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
example2_zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

meanings_zh: v. 预料；预计；v. 要求；期望；v. 等待；期待到来
example1_en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
example1_zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。
example2_en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
example2_zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

meanings_zh: adj. 昂贵的；花钱多的
example1_en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
example1_zh: 这双靴子太贵，超出了我的预算。
example2_en: Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 大城市的住房越来越贵，迫使许多年轻职工住到离工作地点更远的地方。

meanings_zh: n. 经验；n. 经历；体验；v. 经历；感受
example1_en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
example1_zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。
example2_en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
example2_zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

meanings_zh: n. 实验；试验；v. 做实验；尝试
example1_en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
example1_zh: 我们的科学实验展示了植物根部如何朝水源生长。
example2_en: Schools should allow students to experiment with different materials before explaining the scientific principles involved.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生先尝试使用不同材料，再讲解其中的科学原理。

meanings_zh: n. 专家；行家；adj. 专业的；熟练的
example1_en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
example1_zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。
example2_en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
example2_zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

meanings_zh: v. 解释；说明；v. 说明……的原因
example1_en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
example1_zh: 你能说明一下这台咖啡机怎么用吗？
example2_en: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
example2_zh: 医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。

meanings_zh: v. 探索；探访；v. 探讨；研究
example1_en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
example1_zh: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。

meanings_zh: n. 探险者；勘探者
example1_en: The explorer carried a compass through the dense forest.
example1_zh: 探险者带着指南针穿过茂密的森林。
example2_en: An explorer can contribute valuable observations, but expeditions should avoid disturbing local wildlife and communities.
example2_zh: 探险者可以提供宝贵的观察资料，但探险活动应避免干扰当地野生动物和社区。

meanings_zh: v. 表达；表露；adj. 快速的；特快的；adj. 明确的；明示的
example1_en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
example1_zh: 莉娅用一个温暖的微笑表达了谢意。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to express their opinions on decisions that affect their education.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生有机会对影响其教育的决策发表意见。

meanings_zh: n. 表达；表示；n. 表情；神色；n. 词语；说法
example1_en: He sent flowers as an expression of his gratitude.
example1_zh: 他送了花来表达谢意。
example2_en: Schools should encourage creative expression by giving students regular opportunities to explore music, drama, and visual arts.
example2_zh: 学校应定期让学生接触音乐、戏剧和视觉艺术，以鼓励创造性表达。

meanings_zh: n. 眼睛；n. 眼光；鉴赏力；v. 注视；打量
example1_en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
example1_zh: 她闭上眼睛，听着雨声。
example2_en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
example2_zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。

meanings_zh: n. 脸；面部；v. 面临；面对；v. 面向；朝向
example1_en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
example1_zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。
example2_en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
example2_zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。

meanings_zh: n. 事实；真实情况
example1_en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
example1_zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。
example2_en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
example2_zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。

meanings_zh: n. 工厂
example1_en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
example1_zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。
example2_en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
example2_zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

meanings_zh: v. 失败；未能做到；v. 不及格；使不及格；v. 失灵；衰退
example1_en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
example1_zh: 尽管多加了一个鸡蛋，蛋糕还是没发起来。
example2_en: Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.
example2_zh: 地方政府若不提供清晰指导或便捷的收集服务，回收计划往往会失败。

meanings_zh: n. 失败；失败的事物；n. 故障；衰竭；n. 未做；未履行
example1_en: Despite her first failure, she tried baking bread again.
example1_zh: 尽管第一次失败了，她还是再次尝试烤面包。
example2_en: Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.
example2_zh: 学校应将失败视为学习的机会，而不是学生能力有限的证明。

meanings_zh: adj. 公平的；合理的；adj. 肤色白皙的；浅色的；n. 展销会；集市
example1_en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
example1_zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。
example2_en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
example2_zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；跌倒；下降；n. 跌落；下降；n. 秋天（美式）
example1_en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
example1_zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。
example2_en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
example2_zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。

meanings_zh: adj. 熟悉的；常见的；adj. 熟知的；了解的
example1_en: I heard a familiar voice outside the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 我听见厨房门外传来一个熟悉的声音。
example2_en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
example2_zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭；家人；亲属；n. 科；语族；同类群
example1_en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
example1_zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。
example2_en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；出名的
example1_en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
example1_zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。
example2_en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
example2_zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。

meanings_zh: n. 迷；爱好者；n. 风扇；扇子；v. 扇风；煽动
example1_en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
example1_zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。
example2_en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
example2_zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；出色的；adj. 奇幻的；异想天开的；adj. 极大的；惊人的
example1_en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
example1_zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。
example2_en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
example2_zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。

meanings_zh: n. 幻想；想象；n. 奇幻文学；奇幻作品
example1_en: Living in a castle was my favourite childhood fantasy.
example1_zh: 住在城堡里是我童年时最喜欢的幻想。
example2_en: Fantasy literature can encourage young readers to explore moral questions through imaginary worlds and unusual characters.
example2_zh: 奇幻文学可以鼓励年轻读者通过虚构世界和不同寻常的角色探索道德问题。

meanings_zh: n. 农场；v. 务农；耕种；养殖
example1_en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
example1_zh: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。
example2_en: Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
example2_zh: 小型农场既能支持当地食品供应，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。

meanings_zh: n. 农民；农场主
example1_en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
example1_zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。
example2_en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
example2_zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

meanings_zh: n. 时尚；流行款式；n. 方式；v. 制作；塑造
example1_en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
example1_zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。
example2_en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
example2_zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: adj. 快速的；adv. 迅速地；快；v. 禁食
example1_en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
example1_zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。
example2_en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
example2_zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

meanings_zh: n. 脂肪；食用油脂；adj. 肥胖的；肥的
example1_en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
example1_zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。
example2_en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
example2_zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 父亲；爸爸；n. 奠基人；创始人；v. 成为…的生父
example1_en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
example1_zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。

meanings_zh: n. 缺陷；故障；n. 过错；责任；n. 断层
example1_en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天一个小小的电路故障让洗衣机停止了运转。
example2_en: Regular inspections can identify a structural fault before it threatens the safety of residents.
example2_zh: 定期检查能在结构缺陷危及居民安全之前发现它。

meanings_zh: adj. 最喜欢的；n. 最喜爱的人或物；n. 最有望获胜者
example1_en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。
example2_en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。

meanings_zh: n. 恐惧；担忧；v. 害怕；担心
example1_en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
example1_zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。
example2_en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
example2_zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。

meanings_zh: n. 羽毛
example1_en: A white feather floated gently onto the garden path.
example1_zh: 一根白色羽毛轻轻飘落在花园小径上。
example2_en: Feathers help birds maintain their body temperature, allowing them to survive in colder environments.
example2_zh: 羽毛帮助鸟类维持体温，使它们能在较寒冷的环境中生存。

meanings_zh: n. 二月
example1_en: My sister starts her new job in February.
example1_zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。
example2_en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
example2_zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。

meanings_zh: v. 喂养；进食；n. 动物饲料；n. 信息流
example1_en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
example1_zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。
example2_en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
example2_zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。

meanings_zh: n. 反馈；意见
example1_en: My tutor gave me helpful feedback on my essay.
example1_zh: 导师针对我的作文给了我有用的反馈。
example2_en: Regular feedback enables students to identify weaknesses and develop more effective strategies for independent learning.
example2_zh: 定期反馈能帮助学生发现薄弱之处，并制定更有效的自主学习策略。

meanings_zh: v. 感到；觉得；v. 触摸；摸索；n. 触感；氛围
example1_en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
example1_zh: 盖着这条柔软的毯子，我觉得暖和多了。
example2_en: Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.
example2_zh: 当公共空间照明充足且由地方政府定期维护时，居民往往更有安全感。

meanings_zh: n. 情绪；感受；n. 知觉；身体感觉；n. 直觉；看法
example1_en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
example1_zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。
example2_en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
example2_zh: 强烈的归属感可以增强学生的自信，并鼓励他们参与学校活动。

meanings_zh: n. 节日；庆祝活动；n. 艺术节；系列展演活动
example1_en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
example1_zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。
example2_en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
example2_zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

meanings_zh: n. 发烧；发热；n. 狂热；极度兴奋
example1_en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
example1_zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。
example2_en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
example2_zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

meanings_zh: det. 很少的；几个；pron. 很少的人或事物
example1_en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。
example2_en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
example2_zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。

meanings_zh: n. 纤维；n. 膳食纤维
example1_en: A loose fibre was sticking out of my scarf.
example1_zh: 我的围巾上有一根松脱的纤维伸了出来。
example2_en: A diet rich in fibre can support digestive health and help people feel full for longer.
example2_zh: 富含膳食纤维的饮食有助于消化健康，并能延长饱腹感。

meanings_zh: n. 小说；虚构文学；n. 虚构之事；编造
example1_en: My sister reads fiction on the train every morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天早上在火车上读小说。
example2_en: Reading fiction can help young people understand unfamiliar perspectives and develop greater empathy for others.
example2_zh: 阅读小说能帮助年轻人理解陌生的视角，并更加体谅他人。

meanings_zh: n. 田地；牧场；n. 领域；专业；n. 运动场
example1_en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
example1_zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。
example2_en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

meanings_zh: num. 十五
example1_en: Fifteen students joined the club.
example1_zh: 十五名学生参加了社团。
example2_en: We rested for fifteen minutes.
example2_zh: 我们休息了十五分钟。

meanings_zh: num. 第五
example1_en: Our classroom is on the fifth floor.
example1_zh: 我们的教室在五楼。
example2_en: She finished fifth in the race.
example2_zh: 她在比赛中获得第五名。

meanings_zh: v. 打架；战斗；v. 抗争；努力争取；n. 打斗；斗争
example1_en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
example1_zh: 两只猫为了窗边一个有阳光的位置打了起来。
example2_en: Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 政府应通过改善教育和医疗服务的可及性、增加稳定就业机会来消除贫困。

meanings_zh: n. 数字；数值；n. 人物；人影；身形；v. 认为；估计
example1_en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
example1_zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。
example2_en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
example2_zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

meanings_zh: n. 文件；档案；文件夹；v. 归档；提交；n. 锉刀
example1_en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
example1_zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。
example2_en: Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.
example2_zh: 公共机构应安全存储机密文件，以防止未经授权的访问并保护公民的个人信息。

meanings_zh: v. 装满；充满；v. 填补；满足
example1_en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
example1_zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。
example2_en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。

meanings_zh: n. 电影；v. 拍摄；n. 薄膜；胶卷
example1_en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。
example2_en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
example2_zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

meanings_zh: n. 鱼鳍；鳍状物；n. 潜水脚蹼
example1_en: We spotted a shark's fin just above the water.
example1_zh: 我们看见一个鲨鱼鳍刚刚露出水面。
example2_en: Changes in fin shape can affect how efficiently fish move through different aquatic environments.
example2_zh: 鱼鳍形状的变化会影响鱼类在不同水生环境中的游动效率。

meanings_zh: adj. 最后的；最终的；adj. 不可更改的；决定性的；n. 决赛；期末考试
example1_en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
example1_zh: 我们装好最后一个箱子，锁上了门。
example2_en: The final stage of the research involved comparing energy consumption across several types of housing.
example2_zh: 研究的最后阶段是比较几种不同类型住房的能源消耗。

meanings_zh: adv. 终于；adv. 最后
example1_en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
example1_zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

meanings_zh: v. 找到；发现；v. 觉得；认为；n. 发现物
example1_en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我终于在外套口袋里找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
example2_zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。

meanings_zh: adj. 好的；健康的；优质的；adj. 细小的；纤细的；n. 罚款
example1_en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
example1_zh: 我现在感觉挺好的，我们去散步吧。
example2_en: A substantial fine may discourage companies from dumping industrial waste into rivers and damaging local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 高额罚款可能会阻止企业向河流倾倒工业废物、破坏当地生态系统。

meanings_zh: n. 手指；v. 用手指触摸或拨弄
example1_en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
example1_zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。
example2_en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
example2_zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

meanings_zh: v. 完成；结束；吃完；n. 结尾；终点；n. 表面处理；光洁度
example1_en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
example1_zh: 我们出门前，我会把碗洗完。
example2_en: Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.
example2_zh: 提前完成作业的学生有更多时间查看反馈并加深理解。

meanings_zh: n. 火；火灾；v. 解雇；开除；v. 开枪；发射
example1_en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。
example2_en: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.
example2_zh: 定期安全检查可以降低电气系统老化的旧住宅楼发生火灾的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 消防员
example1_en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
example1_zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。
example2_en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
example2_zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。

meanings_zh: n. 男消防员
example1_en: The fireman rescued a kitten from the smoky kitchen.
example1_zh: 这名男消防员从烟雾弥漫的厨房里救出了一只小猫。
example2_en: The fireman explained that regular safety inspections could prevent many accidents in residential buildings.
example2_zh: 这名男消防员解释说，定期安全检查可以预防住宅楼内的许多事故。

meanings_zh: num. 第一；adv. 首先；最初；优先
example1_en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
example1_zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。
example2_en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
example2_zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。

meanings_zh: n. 鱼；鱼肉；v. 捕鱼；钓鱼
example1_en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
example1_zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。
example2_en: Eating locally caught fish can support coastal communities, provided that fishing practices protect marine ecosystems.
example2_zh: 只要捕捞方式能保护海洋生态系统，食用本地捕获的鱼就能支持沿海社区。

meanings_zh: n. 渔民；钓鱼者
example1_en: The fisherman pulled his net onto the wooden boat.
example1_zh: 渔民把渔网拉上了木船。
example2_en: Each fisherman in the coastal village depends on healthy marine ecosystems to maintain a reliable income.
example2_zh: 这个沿海村庄的每位渔民都依靠健康的海洋生态系统来维持稳定收入。

meanings_zh: v. 合身；装得下；适合；adj. 健康强健的；adj. 适合的；合格的
example1_en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
example1_zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。
example2_en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
example2_zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。

meanings_zh: num. 五
example1_en: I have five storybooks.
example1_zh: 我有五本故事书。
example2_en: The game starts in five minutes.
example2_zh: 游戏五分钟后开始。

meanings_zh: adj. 固定的；不变的；adj. 牢固安装的
example1_en: This cafe offers lunch at a fixed price.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆以固定价格供应午餐。
example2_en: Workers on fixed incomes may struggle to afford basic necessities when inflation significantly increases the cost of living.
example2_zh: 当通货膨胀大幅推高生活成本时，收入固定的劳动者可能难以负担基本生活必需品。

meanings_zh: n. 旗；旗帜；v. 标记；提醒注意；v. 衰退；减弱
example1_en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
example1_zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在校门上方飘扬。
example2_en: Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.
example2_zh: 教师应尽早指出潜在的学习困难，以便学生获得适当的支持。

meanings_zh: n. 航班；空中旅程；n. 飞行；n. 一段楼梯
example1_en: Our flight leaves early, so we should pack tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的航班出发很早，所以今晚应该收拾好行李。
example2_en: Reducing the number of short domestic flights could lower emissions where reliable rail alternatives already exist.
example2_zh: 在已有可靠铁路替代方案的地区，减少短途国内航班可以降低排放。

meanings_zh: n. 洪水；水灾；v. 淹没；被水淹；n. 大量涌来的人或事物
example1_en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
example1_zh: 洪水退去后，我们的花园覆满了厚厚的淤泥。
example2_en: Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.
example2_zh: 恢复湿地可以让多余雨水自然扩散和排走，从而降低洪灾风险。

meanings_zh: n. 地板；室内地面；n. 楼层；n. 海底；谷底
example1_en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
example1_zh: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。
example2_en: Converting unused upper floors into apartments could help cities address housing shortages without expanding outwards.
example2_zh: 把闲置的较高楼层改建成公寓，有助于城市在不向外扩张的情况下缓解住房短缺。

meanings_zh: n. 面粉；谷物粉；v. 撒面粉于
example1_en: Add the flour slowly and stir until smooth.
example1_zh: 慢慢加入面粉，搅拌至顺滑。
example2_en: Replacing some refined flour with wholemeal flour can increase the fibre content of everyday foods.
example2_zh: 用全麦面粉替代部分精制面粉，可以提高日常食品中的膳食纤维含量。

meanings_zh: n. 花；开花植物；v. 开花
example1_en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
example1_zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。
example2_en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
example2_zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

meanings_zh: n. 流行性感冒
example1_en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
example1_zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。
example2_en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
example2_zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

meanings_zh: n. 长笛
example1_en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
example1_zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。
example2_en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
example2_zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。

meanings_zh: v. 飞；飞行；v. 乘飞机旅行；驾驶飞机；n. 苍蝇
example1_en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
example1_zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。
example2_en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
example2_zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: v. 集中注意力；聚焦；n. 重点；关注中心；n. 清晰度；焦点
example1_en: Please turn the music down so I can focus.
example1_zh: 请把音乐调小一点，好让我集中注意力。
example2_en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

meanings_zh: n. 雾；v. 使蒙上雾气；变模糊
example1_en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
example1_zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。
example2_en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
example2_zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 人们；adj. 民间的；传统的；n. 民间音乐；民谣
example1_en: Local folk gather here to chat every evening.
example1_zh: 当地人每晚都聚在这里聊天。
example2_en: Traditional folk music can help younger generations understand the cultural heritage of their communities.
example2_zh: 传统民间音乐能帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的文化遗产。

meanings_zh: v. 跟随；沿着走；v. 遵循；听从；v. 理解；听懂
example1_en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
example1_zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.
example2_zh: 学校应教导儿童在使用数字设备和网络服务时如何遵守安全准则。

meanings_zh: n. 食物；食品
example1_en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。
example2_en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 足球；足球运动；n. 美式橄榄球运动
example1_en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
example2_en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
example2_zh: 地方足球俱乐部能够聚集不同社会背景的人，从而增进社区联系。

meanings_zh: n. 力；力量；v. 强迫；迫使；n. 武力；暴力
example1_en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
example1_zh: 大风把我的伞吹翻了。
example2_en: Rising housing costs may force essential workers to move further away from the communities they serve.
example2_zh: 不断上涨的住房成本可能迫使必要岗位的工作人员搬离他们服务的社区。

meanings_zh: adj. 外国的；来自国外的；adj. 异物的；外来的；adj. 陌生的；不相符的
example1_en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
example1_zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。
example2_en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
example2_zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

meanings_zh: n. 森林；林区
example1_en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
example1_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。
example2_en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
example2_zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

meanings_zh: adv. 永远；adv. 老是；不断地
example1_en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
example1_zh: 我希望这些阳光明媚的午后能永远持续下去。
example2_en: Without effective conservation measures, some rare animal species could disappear forever within the next few decades.
example2_zh: 如果没有有效的保护措施，一些珍稀动物物种可能在未来几十年内永远消失。

meanings_zh: v. 忘记；记不起；v. 忘记做；忘带
example1_en: I always forget where I put my reading glasses.
example1_zh: 我总是忘记把老花镜放在哪里了。
example2_en: Students may quickly forget new vocabulary unless they review it regularly and use it in meaningful contexts.
example2_zh: 如果学生不定期复习新词，并在有意义的语境中运用，就可能很快忘记。

meanings_zh: v. 原谅；宽恕；v. 免除债务
example1_en: Can you forgive me for breaking your favourite mug?
example1_zh: 我打碎了你最喜欢的杯子，你能原谅我吗？
example2_en: International lenders may forgive some debts to help poorer countries invest more in healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 国际贷款机构可能减免部分债务，帮助较贫困国家增加医疗和教育投入。

meanings_zh: n. 餐叉；叉子；n. 岔路口；分叉处；v. 分叉
example1_en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
example1_zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。
example2_en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
example2_zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。

meanings_zh: n. 类型；形式；形状；n. 表格；v. 形成；组成；建立
example1_en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
example1_zh: 那些云呈现出一只巨兔的形状。
example2_en: Online learning has become a popular form of education because it offers flexibility for working adults.
example2_zh: 在线学习已成为一种受欢迎的教育形式，因为它为在职成年人提供了灵活性。

meanings_zh: adj. 正式的；官方的；adj. 庄重的；拘谨的；adj. 正规的；系统的
example1_en: You need a formal invitation to attend the ceremony.
example1_zh: 你需要正式邀请才能出席典礼。
example2_en: Formal education provides essential knowledge, while practical experience helps students apply what they have learned.
example2_zh: 正规教育提供必备知识，而实践经验帮助学生运用所学内容。

meanings_zh: adv. 向前；向将来；v. 转寄；转发；n. 前锋
example1_en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
example1_zh: 前面有空位时，请向前走一步。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源有助于各国迈向更可持续的经济未来。

meanings_zh: v. 创立；建立；v. 找到（find的过去式及分词）
example1_en: My aunt founded a small charity last winter.
example1_zh: 去年冬天，我姑姑创办了一家小型慈善机构。
example2_en: Graduates who found new businesses can create employment opportunities and introduce innovative services to local communities.
example2_zh: 创办新企业的毕业生可以创造就业机会，并为当地社区引入创新服务。

meanings_zh: num. 四；四个
example1_en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房桌子周围放了四把椅子。
example2_en: The research team compared four methods of reducing household energy use during the winter months.
example2_zh: 研究团队比较了四种减少冬季家庭能源消耗的方法。

meanings_zh: num. 十四
example1_en: There are fourteen desks in the room.
example1_zh: 房间里有十四张课桌。
example2_en: She became fourteen in May.
example2_zh: 她五月份满十四岁。

meanings_zh: num. 第四；n. 四分之一
example1_en: Our apartment is on the fourth floor, beside the lift.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓在四楼，就在电梯旁边。
example2_en: The fourth stage of the recycling process involves transforming cleaned plastic into material suitable for new products.
example2_zh: 回收流程的第四阶段是将清洗后的塑料转化为适合制造新产品的材料。

meanings_zh: n. 狐狸；v. 使困惑；难倒
example1_en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
example1_zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。
example2_en: The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.
example2_zh: 赤狐能够适应城市环境，因为人类活动使食物很容易获取。

meanings_zh: n. 法国
example1_en: We travelled through France by train last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了法国。
example2_en: France attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed transport networks.
example2_zh: 法国凭借文化遗产、多样的景观和发达的交通网络吸引国际游客。

meanings_zh: adj. 免费的；adj. 自由的；不受限制的；v. 释放；使摆脱
example1_en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。
example2_en: Providing free public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment for disadvantaged residents.
example2_zh: 提供免费公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善弱势居民的就业可及性。

meanings_zh: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的；n. 冰点
example1_en: My hands were freezing after waiting outside for the bus.
example1_zh: 在外面等公交车后，我的双手冰冷。
example2_en: Freezing temperatures can damage water pipes and disrupt essential services, particularly in areas with ageing infrastructure.
example2_zh: 冰冻天气可能损坏水管并扰乱基本服务，尤其是在基础设施老化的地区。

meanings_zh: adj. 法国的；法语的；n. 法语；n. 法国人（总称）
example1_en: We bought fresh bread from a small French bakery.
example1_zh: 我们在一家法国面包店买了新鲜面包。
example2_en: Learning French can improve employment prospects in regions where the language is widely used in business.
example2_zh: 在商业活动中广泛使用法语的地区，学习法语可以改善就业前景。

meanings_zh: adj. 新鲜的；adj. 清新的；凉爽宜人的；adj. 新的；不同于以往的
example1_en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。
example2_en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
example2_zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 星期五
example1_en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
example1_zh: 我们通常星期五在家一起做晚饭。
example2_en: Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.
example2_zh: 允许员工星期五居家办公，可能减轻通勤压力并提高工作满意度。

meanings_zh: n. 冰箱
example1_en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
example1_zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱。
example2_en: Choosing an energy-efficient fridge can reduce household electricity consumption and lower costs over time.
example2_zh: 选择节能冰箱可以减少家庭用电量，并在长期内降低开支。

meanings_zh: n. 朋友；友人
example1_en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
example1_zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。
example2_en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
example2_zh: 维持亲密友谊可以改善心理健康，因为朋友常在困难时期提供情感支持。

meanings_zh: adj. 友好的；亲切的；n. 友谊赛
example1_en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
example1_zh: 我们的新邻居很友善，总是挥手打招呼。
example2_en: Friendly staff can improve patients' experiences and encourage them to seek medical advice earlier.
example2_zh: 亲切的工作人员能改善患者的就医体验，并鼓励他们更早寻求医疗建议。

meanings_zh: n. 友谊；朋友关系
example1_en: Our friendship began when we shared a school desk.
example1_zh: 我们的友谊始于上学时做同桌的日子。
example2_en: Close friendship can improve mental health by providing emotional support during periods of stress.
example2_zh: 亲密的友谊可以在压力时期提供情感支持，从而改善心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 青蛙
example1_en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
example1_zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。
example2_en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
example2_zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。

meanings_zh: prep. 从；来自；prep. 由于；因为；prep. 与……不同；离
example1_en: This postcard came from my cousin in the mountains.
example1_zh: 这张明信片是住在山区的表亲寄来的。
example2_en: Students from rural communities may face additional barriers when applying to universities in major cities.
example2_zh: 来自农村社区的学生申请大城市的大学时，可能面临额外障碍。

meanings_zh: n. 前部；正面；adj. 前面的；正面的；n. 锋；天气锋面
example1_en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
example1_zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。
example2_en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
example2_zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。

meanings_zh: adj. 结冰的；冻硬的；adj. 冷冻保存的；adj. 冻僵的；冷极了的
example1_en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。
example2_en: Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.
example2_zh: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。

meanings_zh: n. 水果；果实；n. 成果；结果；v. 结果实
example1_en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
example1_zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。
example2_en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
example2_zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 燃料；v. 给……加燃料；v. 加剧；推动
example1_en: We stopped for fuel before driving into the mountains.
example1_zh: 我们开车进山前停下来加了油。
example2_en: Growing demand for private cars may fuel air pollution unless governments promote cleaner alternatives.
example2_zh: 除非政府推广更清洁的替代出行方式，否则私家车需求的增长可能加剧空气污染。

meanings_zh: adj. 满的；装满的；adj. 完整的；全部的；adj. 吃饱的
example1_en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
example1_zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。
example2_en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
example2_zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；充分地
example1_en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
example1_zh: 出门前确保手机已经充满电。
example2_en: Students benefit most from online learning when they fully understand how to use the available digital tools.
example2_zh: 学生充分了解如何使用现有数字工具时，才能最大程度地从在线学习中受益。

meanings_zh: n. 乐趣；快乐；adj. 有趣的；令人愉快的
example1_en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。
example2_en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
example2_zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童经常锻炼，并养成终身受益的健康习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 葬礼
example1_en: We brought white flowers to our neighbour's funeral yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们带着白花参加了邻居的葬礼。
example2_en: Funeral traditions vary across cultures, but they often provide families with emotional support during bereavement.
example2_zh: 不同文化的葬礼传统各异，但它们往往能在亲人离世时为家属提供情感支持。

meanings_zh: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；adj. 奇怪的；反常的
example1_en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
example1_zh: 那个好笑的故事逗得桌边的人都笑了。
example2_en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
example2_zh: 教师有时会用有趣的例子，让复杂概念更容易记住，并鼓励学生参与。

meanings_zh: n. 兽毛；软毛；n. 毛皮；裘皮
example1_en: The cat's wet fur dried quickly in the sunshine.
example1_zh: 猫湿漉漉的毛在阳光下很快就干了。
example2_en: Thick fur helps many mammals survive in cold climates by trapping a layer of warm air.
example2_zh: 浓密的毛通过留住一层暖空气，帮助许多哺乳动物在寒冷气候中生存。

meanings_zh: n. 未来；前途；adj. 未来的；将来的
example1_en: We talked about our future while walking home.
example1_zh: 我们走路回家时聊了聊我们的未来。
example2_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
example2_zh: 各国政府应投资可再生能源，为世界各地的子孙后代保护环境。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；增加；n. 增长；收益
example1_en: You will gain confidence after a few lessons.
example1_zh: 上几节课后，你就会更有信心。
example2_en: Students can gain valuable practical experience by volunteering for projects that benefit their local communities.
example2_zh: 学生可以通过志愿参与有益于当地社区的项目，获得宝贵的实践经验。

meanings_zh: n. 庆典；晚会
example1_en: Our class performed a dance at the New Year gala.
example1_zh: 我们班在新年晚会上表演了舞蹈。
example2_en: The charity gala raised money for children.
example2_zh: 慈善晚会为孩子们筹集了资金。

meanings_zh: n. 游戏；比赛；n. 猎物；野味；adj. 愿意尝试的；有胆量的
example1_en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。
example2_en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
example2_zh: 合作型游戏能帮助儿童培养沟通能力，并学会共同解决问题。

meanings_zh: n. 花园；菜园；v. 从事园艺
example1_en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们从菜园里摘了新鲜的豆角。
example2_en: Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood relationships while giving urban residents access to fresh vegetables and green space.
example2_zh: 社区花园既能加强邻里关系，又能让城市居民获得新鲜蔬菜和绿色空间。

meanings_zh: n. 气体；n. 燃气；天然气；n. 汽油（美式）
example1_en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
example1_zh: 我们在家用燃气做饭。
example2_en: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
example2_zh: 减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；总体的；adj. 大致的；非具体的；n. 将军
example1_en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
example1_zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。
example2_en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
example2_zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

meanings_zh: n. 天才人物；n. 天赋；非凡才能
example1_en: My sister is a genius at fixing broken toys.
example1_zh: 我姐姐修坏玩具特别有一手。
example2_en: Creative genius often develops when schools allow students to experiment rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_zh: 学校允许学生探索尝试，而非仅仅记忆知识时，创造天赋往往更容易得到发展。

meanings_zh: adj. 温柔的；温和的；adj. 轻柔的；不强烈的；adj. 坡度平缓的
example1_en: Be gentle when you pick up the little kitten.
example1_zh: 抱起那只小猫时，动作要轻柔。
example2_en: Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can improve physical health without placing excessive strain on joints.
example2_zh: 散步或游泳等温和运动可以改善身体健康，又不会给关节带来过大负担。

meanings_zh: n. 有礼貌的男士；绅士；n. 先生；男士
example1_en: A gentleman held the door open for us.
example1_zh: 一位绅士为我们扶住了门。
example2_en: The elderly gentleman described how public transport had improved his independence and access to community activities.
example2_zh: 这位年长的先生讲述了公共交通如何增强他的独立生活能力，并让他更方便地参加社区活动。

meanings_zh: n. 地理学；n. 地理特征；地形
example1_en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
example1_zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。
example2_en: The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.
example2_zh: 沿海地区的地理特征影响聚居格局，并决定当地社区如何应对海平面上升。

meanings_zh: adj. 德国的；德语的；n. 德国人；n. 德语
example1_en: We shared a traditional German cake after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一块传统德国蛋糕。
example2_en: German universities attract international students through research opportunities and a wide range of degree programmes.
example2_zh: 德国大学通过研究机会和丰富的学位课程吸引国际学生。

meanings_zh: n. 德国
example1_en: My cousin moved to Germany to study engineering.
example1_zh: 我的表亲搬到德国去学工程了。
example2_en: Germany has invested in renewable energy as part of its efforts to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 德国投资可再生能源，以减少对化石燃料的依赖。

meanings_zh: n. 礼物；赠品；n. 天赋；才能；v. 赠送
example1_en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
example1_zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。
example2_en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
example2_zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。

meanings_zh: n. 姜饼
example1_en: We made gingerbread during the holiday.
example1_zh: 假期里我们做了姜饼。
example2_en: The gingerbread house was covered with sweets.
example2_zh: 姜饼屋上装饰着糖果。

meanings_zh: n. 长颈鹿
example1_en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
example1_zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 女孩；姑娘
example1_en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
example1_zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。
example2_en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
example2_zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。

meanings_zh: v. 给；赠送；v. 提供；带来；v. 举办；作出
example1_en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
example1_zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。
example2_en: Schools should give students opportunities to develop practical skills through projects that address real community needs.
example2_zh: 学校应通过解决社区实际需求的项目，让学生有机会培养实践技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 高兴的；欣慰的；adj. 乐意的
example1_en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
example1_zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。
example2_en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
example2_zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。

meanings_zh: n. 玻璃；n. 玻璃杯；一杯的量；n. 眼镜
example1_en: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass.
example1_zh: 球砸中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。
example2_en: Recycling glass reduces demand for raw materials and can lower energy consumption in the manufacturing sector.
example2_zh: 回收玻璃能减少对原材料的需求，并可降低制造业的能源消耗。

meanings_zh: n. 手套
example1_en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。
example2_en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
example2_zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 胶；胶水；v. 用胶粘合
example1_en: Use a little glue to fix the paper wing.
example1_zh: 用一点胶水把纸翅膀粘好。
example2_en: Some packaging contains layers joined with glue, which can make the materials more difficult to recycle.
example2_zh: 有些包装的各层材料用胶粘合，这可能增加回收难度。

meanings_zh: v. 去；走
example1_en: We go to school by bus.
example1_zh: 我们乘公共汽车去上学。
example2_en: I went to the park with my family yesterday.
example2_zh: 昨天我和家人去了公园。

meanings_zh: n. 目标；n. 进球；进球得分；n. 球门
example1_en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
example1_zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。
example2_en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
example2_zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。

meanings_zh: n. 上帝；唯一的神
example1_en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
example1_zh: 我祖母在家每次用餐前都会感谢上帝。
example2_en: Belief in God can influence people's values, charitable activities, and responses to difficult circumstances.
example2_zh: 对上帝的信仰可能影响人们的价值观、慈善活动及应对困境的方式。

meanings_zh: n. 金；黄金；n. 金牌；adj. 金制的；金色的
example1_en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
example1_zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。
example2_en: Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.
example2_zh: 经济不确定时期，投资者会寻求他们认为相对安全的资产，黄金需求因此可能上升。

meanings_zh: adj. 金色的；adj. 绝佳的；珍贵的
example1_en: The bread turned golden after twenty minutes in the oven.
example1_zh: 面包在烤箱里烤了二十分钟后变成了金黄色。
example2_en: International exchange programmes offer students a golden opportunity to develop language skills and understand different cultures.
example2_zh: 国际交流项目为学生提供了提高语言能力、了解不同文化的绝佳机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 好的；优质的；adj. 有益的；有好处的；n. 益处；善
example1_en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
example1_zh: 这家面包店做的面包很好，外皮酥脆。
example2_en: Good public transport allows residents to reach essential services without relying on private cars.
example2_zh: 优质的公共交通让居民无需依赖私家车也能获得基本服务。

meanings_zh: n. 善良；美德；n. 营养；有益成分；int. 天哪
example1_en: Her goodness showed when she shared her last sandwich.
example1_zh: 她把最后一个三明治分给别人，显露出善良的本性。
example2_en: Steaming vegetables can preserve more of their natural goodness than boiling them for long periods.
example2_zh: 与长时间水煮相比，蒸蔬菜能保留更多天然营养。

meanings_zh: n. 商品；货物；n. 个人财物
example1_en: The shop sells handmade goods from nearby villages.
example1_zh: 这家店出售附近村庄制作的手工商品。
example2_en: Transporting goods by rail rather than road can lower emissions and reduce congestion in urban areas.
example2_zh: 采用铁路而非公路运输货物可以降低排放，缓解城市拥堵。

meanings_zh: n. 鹅；n. 鹅肉
example1_en: A white goose waddled across the path towards us.
example1_zh: 一只白鹅摇摇摆摆地穿过小路，朝我们走来。
example2_en: Protecting wetlands provides essential feeding grounds for wild geese and many other migratory birds.
example2_zh: 保护湿地能为野鹅及许多其他候鸟提供重要的觅食地。

meanings_zh: n. 政府；n. 治理；政体
example1_en: The government plans to build a new hospital nearby.
example1_zh: 政府计划在附近建一所新医院。
example2_en: Local government plays a crucial role in providing affordable housing and maintaining essential public services.
example2_zh: 地方政府在提供可负担住房和维持基本公共服务方面发挥着关键作用。

meanings_zh: n. 成绩；等级；n. 年级；v. 评分；分级
example1_en: I got a good grade on my science project.
example1_zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。
example2_en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
example2_zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。

meanings_zh: adv. 逐渐地；逐步地
example1_en: The sky gradually grew darker as we walked home.
example1_zh: 我们走回家时，天色渐渐暗了下来。
example2_en: Cities can gradually reduce traffic congestion by improving public transport and creating safer routes for cyclists.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通、为骑车者建设更安全的路线，逐步缓解交通拥堵。

meanings_zh: n. 谷物；粮食；n. 颗粒；细粒；n. 木材纹理
example1_en: The farmer stored the grain in a dry barn.
example1_zh: 农民把粮食存放在干燥的谷仓里。
example2_en: Growing grain requires reliable water supplies, which are increasingly threatened by drought in many agricultural regions.
example2_zh: 种植谷物需要可靠的供水，而许多农业地区的供水正日益受到干旱的威胁。

meanings_zh: n. 语法；语法规则
example1_en: Our teacher explains grammar using examples from everyday conversations.
example1_zh: 我们的老师用日常对话中的例子讲解语法。
example2_en: Although grammar instruction is important, language courses should also give learners opportunities to communicate in realistic situations.
example2_zh: 虽然语法教学很重要，语言课程也应让学习者有机会在真实情境中交流。

meanings_zh: n. 祖父；外祖父
example1_en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
example1_zh: 我的祖父教过我如何种番茄。
example2_en: A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.
example2_zh: 经常帮忙照顾孩子的祖父或外祖父能够增进家庭感情，并为在职父母提供支持。

meanings_zh: n. 奶奶；外婆
example1_en: My grandma grows flowers in her garden.
example1_zh: 我奶奶在花园里种花。
example2_en: Grandma taught me how to make dumplings.
example2_zh: 外婆教我包饺子。

meanings_zh: n. 祖母；外祖母
example1_en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
example1_zh: 我的祖母在厨房窗台上种新鲜的香草。
example2_en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
example2_zh: 对许多在职父母来说，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育儿帮助，也有助于维系紧密的家庭关系。

meanings_zh: n. 爷爷；外公
example1_en: My grandpa walks with me after dinner.
example1_zh: 我爷爷晚饭后和我一起散步。
example2_en: Grandpa told us an interesting story.
example2_zh: 外公给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

meanings_zh: n. 祖父母或外祖父母之一
example1_en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
example1_zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
example2_zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

meanings_zh: n. 孙子；外孙
example1_en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
example1_zh: 她的孙子每周日都来看她，并帮忙做饭。
example2_en: Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.
example2_zh: 经常与孙辈联系能帮助老年人增强与社会的联系感。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄
example1_en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
example1_zh: 她在我的午餐盒里装了一些葡萄。
example2_en: Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.
example2_zh: 随着夏季变得更炎热、更干燥，葡萄种植者可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

meanings_zh: n. 草；草地
example1_en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。
example2_en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
example2_zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。

meanings_zh: adv. 大大地；非常
example1_en: Your clear directions greatly helped us find the cottage.
example1_zh: 你清楚的指路说明帮了大忙，让我们找到了那间小屋。
example2_en: Access to affordable childcare can greatly improve parents' ability to remain in employment and pursue further education.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的托育服务，可以大大提升父母继续工作和接受进一步教育的能力。

meanings_zh: adj. 绿色的；adj. 环保的；n. 绿色
example1_en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
example1_zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。
example2_en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。

meanings_zh: n. 温室；暖房
example1_en: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
example1_zh: 整个冬天，我们都在温室里种番茄。
example2_en: Greenhouse cultivation can extend growing seasons, although heating these structures may require considerable amounts of energy.
example2_zh: 温室种植可以延长生长季，但为这些设施供暖可能需要消耗大量能源。

meanings_zh: v. 迎接；问候；v. 映入眼帘；传入耳鼻
example1_en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
example1_zh: 我们搬来时，邻居们热情地向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.
example2_zh: 受过培训的志愿者迎接参观者，介绍博物馆的藏品并为他们指路。

meanings_zh: adj. 灰色的；灰白的；n. 灰色；v. 头发变灰白
example1_en: A grey cat was sleeping on the windowsill.
example1_zh: 一只灰猫正在窗台上睡觉。
example2_en: Grey concrete buildings can appear less welcoming than neighbourhoods with colourful homes and abundant green space.
example2_zh: 灰色混凝土建筑可能不如拥有彩色住宅和充足绿地的街区亲切宜人。

meanings_zh: n. 地面；土地；n. 理由；根据；v. 使停飞
example1_en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
example1_zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。
example2_en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 组；群；团体；v. 分组；聚集
example1_en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
example1_zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。
example2_en: Teachers can group students by their learning needs to provide more effective support during classroom activities.
example2_zh: 教师可以根据学生的学习需求分组，以便在课堂活动中提供更有效的支持。

meanings_zh: v. 生长；增长；发展；v. 种植；v. 逐渐变得
example1_en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。
example2_en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
example2_zh: 随着城市发展，地方政府必须投资建设满足不断增长的人口需求的交通系统。

meanings_zh: n. 成年人；大人；adj. 成年的；成熟的
example1_en: Ask a grown-up to help you slice the bread.
example1_zh: 请一位大人帮你切面包。
example2_en: Children often develop grown-up attitudes towards responsibility when they participate in age-appropriate household tasks.
example2_zh: 孩子参与适合其年龄的家务时，往往会形成对待责任的成熟态度。

meanings_zh: n. 增长；增加；n. 生长；成长；发展；n. 赘生物；肿块
example1_en: The rapid growth of our town surprised my grandparents.
example1_zh: 我们小镇的迅速扩张让我的祖父母感到惊讶。
example2_en: Governments should balance economic growth with environmental protection to ensure that rising prosperity does not exhaust natural resources.
example2_zh: 政府应平衡经济增长与环境保护，确保日益繁荣的经济不会耗尽自然资源。

meanings_zh: n. 警卫；守卫；v. 守卫；保护；看守；n. 防护装置
example1_en: The guard checked my ticket before opening the gate.
example1_zh: 警卫检查了我的票才打开大门。
example2_en: Museums employ trained staff to guard valuable collections while ensuring that visitors can enjoy them safely.
example2_zh: 博物馆雇用受过培训的工作人员保护珍贵藏品，同时确保游客能够安全地观赏。

meanings_zh: n. 客人；受邀嘉宾；n. 旅馆住客
example1_en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
example1_zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。
example2_en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
example2_zh: 酒店可以仅在住客提出要求时更换毛巾，以鼓励节水。

meanings_zh: n. 指导；指引
example1_en: With your guidance, I finally planted the seeds correctly.
example1_zh: 在你的指导下，我终于把种子种对了。
example2_en: Schools should provide career guidance to help students make informed decisions about further education and employment.
example2_zh: 学校应提供职业指导，帮助学生在升学和就业方面作出明智的决定。

meanings_zh: n. 导游；向导；n. 指南；入门书；v. 引导；指导
example1_en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
example1_zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。
example2_en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
example2_zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。

meanings_zh: n. 吉他
example1_en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。
example2_en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
example2_zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。

meanings_zh: n. 枪；炮；n. 枪状工具
example1_en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
example1_zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。
example2_en: Strict gun storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety within local communities.
example2_zh: 严格的枪支存放规定有助于预防事故，提高当地社区的安全水平。

meanings_zh: n. 健身房；体育馆；n. 体育课；体育活动
example1_en: I usually go to the gym before work.
example1_zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。
example2_en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
example2_zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。

meanings_zh: n. 习惯；习性
example1_en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
example1_zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。
example2_en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
example2_zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。

meanings_zh: n. 头发；毛发；n. 一根头发；一根毛
example1_en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
example1_zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。
example2_en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
example2_zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。

meanings_zh: n. 理发；发型
example1_en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
example1_zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。
example2_en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
example2_zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

meanings_zh: n. 一半；半场；det. 一半的；adv. 半；部分地
example1_en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
example1_zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。
example2_en: Nearly half of the residents surveyed supported creating more green spaces in the city centre.
example2_zh: 受访居民中近一半支持在市中心增设绿地。

meanings_zh: n. 门厅；走廊；n. 礼堂；大厅；会堂；n. 大学学生宿舍
example1_en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
example1_zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。
example2_en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
example2_zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。

meanings_zh: n. 走廊；门厅
example1_en: Please leave your muddy boots in the hallway.
example1_zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子留在门厅里。
example2_en: Wide hallways and accessible entrances make public buildings easier to navigate for people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 宽敞的走廊和无障碍入口让行动不便的人更容易在公共建筑内通行。

meanings_zh: n. 汉堡包
example1_en: He ordered a hamburger and some juice.
example1_zh: 他点了一个汉堡包和一些果汁。
example2_en: We made a healthy hamburger at home.
example2_zh: 我们在家做了一个健康的汉堡包。

meanings_zh: n. 手；n. 帮助；v. 递给；交给
example1_en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
example1_zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。
example2_en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
example2_zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 英俊的；adj. 可观的；丰厚的
example1_en: My brother looks handsome in his new blue jacket.
example1_zh: 我哥哥穿着新的蓝色夹克，看起来很英俊。
example2_en: Companies investing in renewable energy may earn handsome profits as demand for cleaner alternatives continues to grow.
example2_zh: 随着对更清洁替代能源的需求持续增长，投资可再生能源的企业可能获得丰厚利润。

meanings_zh: v. 悬挂；吊着；v. 垂下；低垂
example1_en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
example1_zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。
example2_en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
example2_zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。

meanings_zh: v. 发生；v. 碰巧；恰好
example1_en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
example1_zh: 你窗边那盆植物怎么了？
example2_en: Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
example2_zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，更容易发生交通事故。

meanings_zh: adv. 快乐地；高兴地；adv. 乐意地；adv. 幸好；幸运地
example1_en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
example1_zh: 孩子们一起做三明治，开心地聊着天。
example2_en: Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.
example2_zh: 如果公共交通服务更可靠、价格更实惠，许多居民都会乐意乘坐。

meanings_zh: n. 幸福；快乐
example1_en: Her face shone with happiness when the puppy arrived.
example1_zh: 小狗到来时，她的脸上洋溢着喜悦。
example2_en: Strong social connections often contribute more to lasting happiness than the purchase of expensive possessions.
example2_zh: 与购买昂贵物品相比，牢固的社会联系往往更能带来持久的幸福。

meanings_zh: adj. 坚硬的；adj. 困难的；艰苦的；adv. 努力地；猛烈地
example1_en: This bread is too hard to bite into.
example1_zh: 这块面包太硬了，咬不动。
example2_en: Many students work hard to gain qualifications, yet still find it difficult to secure stable employment.
example2_zh: 许多学生努力取得学历或资格，却仍然难以找到稳定的工作。

meanings_zh: adj. 勤奋的；努力工作的
example1_en: She is a hard-working student.
example1_zh: 她是一名勤奋的学生。
example2_en: Hard-working team members finish their tasks on time.
example2_zh: 勤奋的团队成员会按时完成任务。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎不；几乎没有；adv. 刚刚；才
example1_en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
example1_zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。
example2_en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
example2_zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。

meanings_zh: n. 伤害；损害；v. 伤害；损害
example1_en: Too much sunlight can harm the leaves of this plant.
example1_zh: 阳光过强会损伤这种植物的叶子。
example2_en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harm caused to rivers and protect local wildlife.
example2_zh: 加强对工业废弃物的管控可以减少河流受到的损害，并保护当地野生动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 有害的
example1_en: Too much direct sunlight can be harmful to your skin.
example1_zh: 过多的阳光直射会伤害你的皮肤。
example2_en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harmful effects of water pollution on local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 加强对工业废物的管控，可以减少水污染对当地生态系统的有害影响。

meanings_zh: n. 和谐；融洽；n. 协调；一致；n. 和声
example1_en: Our cats and dogs live together in perfect harmony.
example1_zh: 我们家的猫和狗相处得十分融洽。
example2_en: Community projects can promote social harmony by bringing residents from different backgrounds together to achieve shared goals.
example2_zh: 社区项目让不同背景的居民携手实现共同目标，从而促进社会和谐。

meanings_zh: n. 帽子
example1_en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
example1_zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。
example2_en: Wearing a wide-brimmed hat can reduce sun exposure, particularly for people who spend long hours working outdoors.
example2_zh: 戴宽檐帽可以减少日晒，对长时间在户外工作的人尤其有用。

meanings_zh: v. 憎恨；非常讨厌；n. 憎恨；强烈厌恶
example1_en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
example1_zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。
example2_en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
example2_zh: 虽然许多通勤者讨厌拥挤的列车，但价格实惠的公共交通对于缓解城市交通拥堵仍然至关重要。

meanings_zh: v. 有；吃；进行
example1_en: I have a new schoolbag.
example1_zh: 我有一个新书包。
example2_en: She had lunch with her classmates.
example2_zh: 她和同学们一起吃了午饭。

meanings_zh: pron. 他
example1_en: He plays football after school.
example1_zh: 他放学后踢足球。
example2_en: He is the student who helped me.
example2_zh: 他就是帮助我的那名学生。

meanings_zh: n. 头；头部；n. 负责人；领导；v. 朝某方向行进
example1_en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
example1_zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。
example2_en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
example2_zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 头痛；n. 令人头痛的难题
example1_en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
example1_zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。
example2_en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
example2_zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。

meanings_zh: n. 健康；身体状况；n. 良好状况；兴旺
example1_en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
example1_zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。
example2_en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

meanings_zh: adj. 健康的；adj. 有益健康的；adj. 良好的；兴旺的
example1_en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
example1_zh: 我们家的猫通过经常运动和定期检查保持健康。
example2_en: Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.
example2_zh: 学校应提供健康膳食，以促进儿童身体发育，并鼓励他们从小养成更好的饮食习惯。

meanings_zh: v. 听见；听到；v. 听说；得知；v. 审理；听取
example1_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
example1_zh: 我能听见卧室窗外的鸟鸣声。
example2_en: Local councils should hear residents' concerns before making decisions about major changes to public transport.
example2_zh: 地方议会在对公共交通作出重大调整前，应听取居民的顾虑。

meanings_zh: n. 听力；听觉；n. 听证会；庭审
example1_en: My grandfather's hearing improved after he received a hearing aid.
example1_zh: 祖父配了助听器后，听得更清楚了。
example2_en: A public hearing allows residents to express concerns before major construction projects receive official approval.
example2_zh: 公开听证会让居民能在大型建设项目获得正式批准前表达关切。

meanings_zh: n. 心脏；n. 内心；感情；n. 核心；中心
example1_en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
example1_zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。
example2_en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
example2_zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 热；高温；v. 加热；变热；n. 预赛
example1_en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
example1_zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。
example2_en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。

meanings_zh: adv. 大量地；很大程度上；adv. 沉重地；猛烈地
example1_en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
example1_zh: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。
example2_en: Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
example2_zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。

meanings_zh: adj. 沉重的；adj. 大量的；强烈的；adj. 繁重的；难以承受的
example1_en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。
example2_en: Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.
example2_zh: 繁忙的交通加剧了城市空气污染，也增加了人们的通勤时间。

meanings_zh: n. 高度；身高；n. 离地高度；海拔；n. 顶峰；最盛时期
example1_en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
example1_zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。
example2_en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助；有助于；n. 帮助；援助
example1_en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？
example2_en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

meanings_zh: adj. 有帮助的；有用的；adj. 乐于助人的
example1_en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
example1_zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。
example2_en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
example2_zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

meanings_zh: pron. 她（宾格）；det. 她的
example1_en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
example1_zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。
example2_en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
example2_zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。

meanings_zh: pron. 她的；她的东西
example1_en: The yellow coat is hers.
example1_zh: 这件黄色外套是她的。
example2_en: My desk is next to hers.
example2_zh: 我的课桌在她的课桌旁边。

meanings_zh: pron. 她自己
example1_en: She made the card herself.
example1_zh: 她自己制作了这张卡片。
example2_en: The girl looked at herself in the mirror.
example2_zh: 女孩看着镜子里的自己。

meanings_zh: int. 嘿；喂；嗨
example1_en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
example1_zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！
example2_en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
example2_zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。

meanings_zh: adj. 隐藏的；不易察觉的
example1_en: We found a hidden cupboard behind the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房门后发现了一个隐蔽的橱柜。
example2_en: Consumers should consider the hidden costs of online purchases, including delivery fees and charges for returning items.
example2_zh: 消费者应考虑网购的隐性成本，包括运费和退货费用。

meanings_zh: v. 隐藏；躲藏；v. 隐瞒；掩饰；n. 兽皮
example1_en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
example1_zh: 我们把生日礼物藏在了床底下。
example2_en: Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.
example2_zh: 企业不应隐瞒其产品或生产流程所涉及的环境风险信息。

meanings_zh: adj. 高的；高处的；adj. 大量的；高水平的；adv. 在高处；向高处
example1_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
example1_zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。
example2_en: High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.
example2_zh: 高昂的住房成本可能使年轻人无法独立居住，在大城市中心尤其如此。

meanings_zh: n. 公路；干道
example1_en: We followed the highway along the coast until sunset.
example1_zh: 我们沿着海岸公路一直开到日落。
example2_en: Building a new highway may reduce travel times but also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
example2_zh: 修建一条新公路可能缩短出行时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 远足；徒步旅行；v. 远足；徒步旅行；n. 大幅上涨
example1_en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
example1_zh: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。
example2_en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。

meanings_zh: pron. 他（宾格）
example1_en: My brother forgot his lunch, so I brought it to him.
example1_zh: 我哥哥忘了带午饭，所以我给他送了过去。
example2_en: When a student struggles with reading, teachers can support him through regular practice and constructive feedback.
example2_zh: 当一名男学生阅读有困难时，教师可以通过定期练习和建设性反馈帮助他。

meanings_zh: det.; pron. 他的；他的东西
example1_en: His schoolbag is under the chair.
example1_zh: 他的书包在椅子下面。
example2_en: This red pencil is his.
example2_zh: 这支红铅笔是他的。

meanings_zh: n. 历史学家；史学研究者
example1_en: The historian examined an old map under a lamp.
example1_zh: 这位历史学家在灯下仔细查看一张旧地图。
example2_en: Historians use a range of sources to explain how industrialisation transformed everyday life in urban communities.
example2_zh: 历史学家利用多种资料解释工业化如何改变城市社区的日常生活。

meanings_zh: adj. 历史的；有关历史的
example1_en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
example1_zh: 我们在图书馆找到了这条街过去的照片。
example2_en: Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.
example2_zh: 历史记录帮助研究人员了解过去的社会如何应对环境变化和经济不确定性。

meanings_zh: n. 历史；历史学；n. 经历；既往记录
example1_en: Our guide explained the history of the old castle.
example1_zh: 导游讲述了这座古堡的历史。
example2_en: Studying history helps citizens understand how past decisions continue to shape modern societies and institutions.
example2_zh: 学习历史有助于公民理解过去的决策如何持续塑造现代社会及其制度。

meanings_zh: v. 击打；碰撞；v. 严重影响；打击；n. 大获成功的人或事物
example1_en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
example1_zh: 球撞上围栏，又朝我弹了过来。
example2_en: Rising energy prices have hit small businesses particularly hard, forcing many owners to reduce their operating hours.
example2_zh: 能源价格上涨对小企业的打击尤其严重，迫使许多经营者缩短营业时间。

meanings_zh: n. 业余爱好
example1_en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
example1_zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。
example2_en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
example2_zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

meanings_zh: n. 曲棍球；冰球
example1_en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在学校运动场练习了曲棍球。
example2_en: Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.
example2_zh: 让曲棍球设施更便于使用，可以鼓励更多年轻人参加团队运动。

meanings_zh: v. 握住；拿着；v. 举行；召开；v. 容纳；装得下
example1_en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
example1_zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？
example2_en: Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.
example2_zh: 地方议会在对交通服务作出重大调整之前，应当召开公众会议。

meanings_zh: n. 洞；孔；坑；n. 漏洞；缺陷
example1_en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
example1_zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。
example2_en: The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.
example2_zh: 安全围栏上发现了一个破洞，促使居民要求紧急维修。

meanings_zh: n. 家；住所；家乡；adv. 在家；回家；adj. 家庭的；国内的
example1_en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
example1_zh: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。
example2_en: Working from home can reduce commuting costs, but it may also limit social interaction among colleagues.
example2_zh: 居家办公可以降低通勤成本，但也可能限制同事之间的社交互动。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭作业；n. 事前准备工作
example1_en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
example1_zh: 我在晚饭前做完了作业，然后出门了。
example2_en: Schools should limit homework so that children have enough time for exercise and family activities.
example2_zh: 学校应限制家庭作业量，让孩子有足够的时间锻炼和参加家庭活动。

meanings_zh: adj. 诚实的；正直的；adj. 坦率的；真诚的
example1_en: The honest cashier returned the money I had overpaid.
example1_zh: 那位诚实的收银员退还了我多付的钱。
example2_en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
example2_zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。

meanings_zh: n. 蜂蜜
