example1_en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
example1_zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。
example2_en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
example2_zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 荣誉；尊敬；荣幸；v. 尊敬；表彰；v. 履行承诺；遵守协议
example1_en: It was an honour to represent my local team.
example1_zh: 能代表本地球队出场，我感到很荣幸。
example2_en: Companies must honour their commitments to workers if they hope to maintain trust and reduce staff turnover.
example2_zh: 企业若想维持信任并减少员工流失，就必须履行对员工的承诺。

meanings_zh: v. 希望；期望；n. 希望；期盼
example1_en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
example1_zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。
example2_en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

meanings_zh: adv. 但愿；希望如此；adv. 满怀希望地
example1_en: Hopefully, the weather will stay dry for our walk.
example1_zh: 但愿我们散步时天气能保持晴好。
example2_en: Hopefully, improvements in cycling infrastructure will encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 希望自行车基础设施的改善能鼓励更多居民放弃开车出行。

meanings_zh: n. 马
example1_en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.
example1_zh: 那匹棕色的马轻轻地吃走了我手里的苹果。
example2_en: Before motor vehicles became widespread, horses played a central role in farming and transporting goods.
example2_zh: 在机动车普及之前，马在农业和货物运输中发挥着核心作用。

meanings_zh: n. 医院
example1_en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
example1_zh: 她在当地医院当护士。
example2_en: Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.
example2_zh: 在该地区新建一家医院将有助于农村居民获得专科医疗服务。

meanings_zh: n. 主人；主持人；v. 主办；主持；招待；n. 大量；许多
example1_en: Our host welcomed us with warm bread and tea.
example1_zh: 主人用热面包和茶欢迎我们。
example2_en: Cities that host international sporting events often invest heavily in transport infrastructure and visitor accommodation.
example2_zh: 举办国际体育赛事的城市往往在交通基础设施和游客住宿方面投入大量资金。

meanings_zh: n. 女主人；女东道主；n. 餐厅女迎宾员
example1_en: Our hostess brought out fresh fruit after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚餐后，女主人端来了新鲜水果。
example2_en: A welcoming hostess can help international visitors feel comfortable and encourage meaningful conversations across cultures.
example2_zh: 热情的女主人能让国际访客感到自在，并促进有意义的跨文化交流。

meanings_zh: adj. 热的；温度高的；adj. 辣的；adj. 热门的；备受关注的
example1_en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
example1_zh: 小心，汤还很烫。
example2_en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
example2_zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。

meanings_zh: n. 酒店；旅馆
example1_en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
example1_zh: 我们住的酒店房间可以俯瞰一片宁静的沙滩。
example2_en: Building a new hotel near the station could create jobs and attract more visitors to the area.
example2_zh: 在车站附近新建一家酒店可以创造就业机会，并吸引更多游客前来。

meanings_zh: n. 小时；n. 工作或营业时间
example1_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
example1_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。
example2_en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
example2_zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。

meanings_zh: n. 房屋；住宅；v. 为……提供住所；容纳
example1_en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
example1_zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。
example2_en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
example2_zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。

meanings_zh: n. 家务劳动
example1_en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
example1_zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。
example2_en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
example2_zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。

meanings_zh: adv. 然而；不过；adv. 无论多么；conj. 无论以何种方式
example1_en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
example1_zh: 这件夹克看起来很暖和，摸起来却出奇地薄。
example2_en: Online courses offer greater flexibility; however, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers.
example2_zh: 在线课程更加灵活；不过，有些学习者从与教师的直接互动中获益更多。

meanings_zh: v. 拥抱；抱紧；n. 拥抱
example1_en: Lena hugged her grandmother before leaving for school.
example1_zh: 莉娜上学前拥抱了奶奶。
example2_en: A reassuring hug from a parent can help young children manage stress in unfamiliar situations.
example2_zh: 父母一个令人安心的拥抱能帮助幼儿应对陌生环境中的压力。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；大量的
example1_en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
example1_zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。
example2_en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

meanings_zh: adj. 人的；人类的；n. 人；人类成员
example1_en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
example1_zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。
example2_en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
example2_zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。

meanings_zh: n. 幽默；幽默感；n. 心情；情绪；v. 迁就；顺着
example1_en: Her gentle humour made everyone at dinner feel relaxed.
example1_zh: 她温和的幽默让晚餐时的每个人都放松了下来。
example2_en: Teachers can use humour to reduce classroom anxiety and encourage students to participate more confidently.
example2_zh: 教师可以利用幽默缓解课堂焦虑，鼓励学生更自信地参与。

meanings_zh: n. 饥饿；食物匮乏；n. 渴望；v. 渴望；渴求
example1_en: A bowl of warm soup quickly satisfied my hunger.
example1_zh: 一碗热汤很快就让我不饿了。
example2_en: Reducing global hunger requires reliable food supplies as well as better access to education and employment.
example2_zh: 减少全球饥饿既需要可靠的食物供应，也需要更多受教育和就业的机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 饥饿的；adj. 渴望的
example1_en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
example1_zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。
example2_en: School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.
example2_zh: 学校供餐计划帮助饥饿的孩子集中课堂注意力，更积极地参与学习。

meanings_zh: v. 狩猎；猎捕；v. 搜寻；寻找；n. 搜寻；狩猎
example1_en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。
example2_en: When natural habitats shrink, predators may hunt closer to farms, increasing conflict between wildlife and local communities.
example2_zh: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。

meanings_zh: v. 疼痛；使受伤；v. 伤感情；损害；adj. 受伤的；伤心的
example1_en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
example1_zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。
example2_en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
example2_zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。

meanings_zh: n. 丈夫；v. 节约使用
example1_en: Her husband brought her lunch during a busy shift.
example1_zh: 她忙着上班时，丈夫给她送来了午饭。
example2_en: When husbands share household responsibilities equally, both partners have more opportunities to pursue their careers.
example2_zh: 当丈夫平等分担家务时，伴侣双方都有更多机会发展事业。

meanings_zh: v. 滑冰
example1_en: We ice-skate on the frozen lake in winter.
example1_zh: 冬天我们在结冰的湖面上滑冰。
example2_en: She learned to ice-skate at the sports centre.
example2_zh: 她在体育中心学会了滑冰。

meanings_zh: n. 主意；想法；n. 概念；观念；n. 了解；印象
example1_en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
example1_zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。
example2_en: The idea of free public transport attracts support, but its financial implications require careful consideration.
example2_zh: 免费公共交通这一想法获得了支持，但其财政影响需要慎重考虑。

meanings_zh: adj. 理想的；最合适的；n. 理想；理想标准
example1_en: This quiet corner is ideal for reading after lunch.
example1_zh: 这个安静的角落最适合午饭后看书。
example2_en: An ideal public transport system would be affordable, reliable, and accessible to residents of all ages.
example2_zh: 理想的公共交通系统应价格合理、运行可靠，并方便各年龄段居民使用。

meanings_zh: conj. 如果；假如；conj. 是否
example1_en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
example1_zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。
example2_en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
example2_zh: 如果城市投资建设安全的自行车道，更多居民可能会选择骑车进行日常出行。

meanings_zh: adj. 生病的；身体不适的；adv. 恶劣地；不友善地
example1_en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
example1_zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。
example2_en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
example2_zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；生病
example1_en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
example1_zh: 她突然生病，没能参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.
example2_zh: 及早获得医疗服务可以防止小病发展为严重的健康问题。

meanings_zh: n. 图像；影像；n. 公众形象；n. 脑海中的形象
example1_en: The camera captured a sharp image of the bird.
example1_zh: 相机拍下了那只鸟的清晰影像。
example2_en: Companies increasingly use social media to improve their public image and build stronger relationships with customers.
example2_zh: 企业越来越多地利用社交媒体改善公众形象，并加强与客户的联系。

meanings_zh: n. 想象力；想象
example1_en: With a little imagination, this box becomes a spaceship.
example1_zh: 只需一点想象力，这个盒子就能变成宇宙飞船。
example2_en: Creative activities encourage children to use their imagination and approach unfamiliar problems from different perspectives.
example2_zh: 创意活动鼓励儿童运用想象力，从不同角度处理陌生的问题。

meanings_zh: v. 想象；设想；v. 猜想；认为
example1_en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
example1_zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。
example2_en: Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 城市规划者在设计新社区之前，必须设想未来居民将如何使用公共空间。

meanings_zh: n. 重要性
example1_en: Losing my keys taught me the importance of a spare.
example1_zh: 丢了钥匙后，我才明白备用钥匙有多重要。
example2_en: Schools should emphasise the importance of critical thinking rather than focusing only on examination results.
example2_zh: 学校应强调批判性思维的重要性，而不是只关注考试成绩。

meanings_zh: adj. 重要的；重大的；adj. 有影响力的；有地位的
example1_en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
example1_zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。
example2_en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可能的；adj. 极难应付的
example1_en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
example1_zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
example2_zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。

meanings_zh: n. 印象；感受；n. 模仿表演；n. 压痕；印记
example1_en: Her warm welcome gave me a good first impression.
example1_zh: 她热情的欢迎给我留下了良好的第一印象。
example2_en: The appearance of public spaces can strongly influence visitors' overall impression of a city.
example2_zh: 公共空间的面貌会显著影响游客对城市的整体印象。

meanings_zh: v. 改善；提高；变好
example1_en: My cooking has improved since I started practising daily.
example1_zh: 自从开始每天练习，我的厨艺进步了。
example2_en: Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 投资教师培训可以改善教育成果，尤其是在服务弱势社区的学校中。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……里面；在……中；prep. 在……期间；在……之后；adv. 在里面；进入；在家
example1_en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
example1_zh: 你的钥匙在门边的碗里。
example2_en: Investment in public libraries can help reduce educational inequality and strengthen connections within local communities.
example2_zh: 对公共图书馆的投资有助于减少教育不平等，并加强当地社区内部的联系。

meanings_zh: v. 包括；包含；v. 使加入；把…列入
example1_en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
example1_zh: 这个价格包含早餐和一条干净毛巾吗？
example2_en: Urban development plans should include affordable housing and reliable public transport to support low-income residents.
example2_zh: 城市发展规划应包含经济适用住房和可靠的公共交通，以支持低收入居民。

meanings_zh: v. 增加；提高；n. 增加；增长
example1_en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
example1_zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。
example2_en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
example2_zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

meanings_zh: adj. 印度的；印度人的；n. 印度人
example1_en: We cooked an Indian curry for dinner last night.
example1_zh: 我们昨晚做了一道印度咖喱当晚餐。
example2_en: Indian cities face growing pressure to expand public transport as urban populations continue to increase.
example2_zh: 随着城市人口持续增加，印度城市面临着扩大公共交通的日益增长的压力。

meanings_zh: n. 工业；制造业；n. 行业；n. 勤奋；勤勉
example1_en: The fishing industry provides jobs for many local families.
example1_zh: 渔业为当地许多家庭提供了工作。
example2_en: Investment in cleaner technology could help heavy industry reduce emissions without significantly lowering production levels.
example2_zh: 投资更清洁的技术可帮助重工业减少排放，同时不显著降低生产水平。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；影响力；v. 影响
example1_en: My older sister had a strong influence on me.
example1_zh: 姐姐对我有很大的影响。
example2_en: Advertising can influence children's food preferences, which makes responsible marketing particularly important for public health.
example2_zh: 广告会影响儿童的食物偏好，因此负责任的营销对公众健康尤为重要。

meanings_zh: adj. 非正式的；随意的；adj. 口语化的；非正式语体的；adj. 非官方的；非正规的
example1_en: We had an informal chat over tea this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午，我们边喝茶边随意聊了聊。
example2_en: Informal learning outside the classroom allows children to develop practical skills through play and everyday experiences.
example2_zh: 课堂外的非正规学习让儿童通过玩耍和日常经历培养实用技能。

meanings_zh: n. 信息；资料
example1_en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
example1_zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。
example2_en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。

meanings_zh: n. 配料；食材；n. 要素；因素
example1_en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
example1_zh: 鲜姜是这道汤的主要食材。
example2_en: Public trust is an essential ingredient in the successful implementation of environmental policies.
example2_zh: 公众信任是成功实施环境政策的必要因素。

meanings_zh: n. 身体损伤；受伤
example1_en: His knee injury kept him away from football practice.
example1_zh: 他的膝伤使他无法参加足球训练。
example2_en: Employers should provide regular safety training to reduce the risk of injury among workers operating heavy machinery.
example2_zh: 雇主应定期提供安全培训，以降低操作重型机械的工人受伤的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 墨水；油墨；v. 给…上墨
example1_en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
example1_zh: 蓝色墨水从钢笔里漏出来，沾到了我的袖子上。
example2_en: Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 昆虫
example1_en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
example1_zh: 一只绿色的小昆虫落在了我的袖子上。
example2_en: Many insect species pollinate crops, making their protection essential for food production and healthy ecosystems.
example2_zh: 许多昆虫物种为农作物授粉，因此保护它们对粮食生产和健康的生态系统至关重要。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……里面；向……里面；adv. 在里面；往里面；n. 里面；内部
example1_en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
example1_zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。
example2_en: Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.
example2_zh: 建筑物内部的空气质量值得更多关注，因为许多人一天中的大部分时间都在室内度过。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓舞；激励；v. 赋予灵感；启发；v. 激起；唤起
example1_en: Our coach inspired us to try again after losing.
example1_zh: 输掉比赛后，教练鼓励我们再试一次。
example2_en: Teachers who connect lessons with real problems can inspire students to pursue careers in science.
example2_zh: 将课程与实际问题联系起来的教师能够激励学生投身科学事业。

meanings_zh: adv. 代替；反而
example1_en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆关门了，于是我们改为回家。
example2_en: Instead of expanding roads, cities should invest in public transport to reduce congestion and pollution.
example2_zh: 城市应投资公共交通，而不是拓宽道路，以减少拥堵和污染。

meanings_zh: n. 指示；操作说明；n. 命令；指令；n. 指导；教学
example1_en: The instructor gave one clear instruction: hold the rope tightly.
example1_zh: 教练给出了一条明确指示：紧紧抓住绳子。
example2_en: Students often benefit from practical instruction that connects classroom theory with everyday problems.
example2_zh: 将课堂理论与日常问题联系起来的实践教学往往能让学生受益。

meanings_zh: n. 教练；指导教师；n. 大学讲师（美国）
example1_en: Our swimming instructor showed us how to breathe properly.
example1_zh: 我们的游泳教练教我们如何正确呼吸。
example2_en: A qualified instructor can help older adults exercise safely and develop confidence in their physical abilities.
example2_zh: 合格的教练能帮助老年人安全锻炼，并增强他们对自身体能的信心。

meanings_zh: n. 乐器；n. 仪器；器械；n. 手段；工具
example1_en: My sister plays a different instrument at each rehearsal.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每次排练都演奏不同的乐器。
example2_en: Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 学习乐器可以增强专注力，并促进不同背景的儿童之间的合作。

meanings_zh: n. 智力；理解力；n. 情报；情报工作
example1_en: Her intelligence helped her solve the puzzle quickly.
example1_zh: 她凭借聪明才智很快解开了这道谜题。
example2_en: Traditional examinations may measure memory more effectively than intelligence, creativity, or practical problem-solving skills.
example2_zh: 传统考试对记忆力的衡量，可能比对智力、创造力或实际解决问题能力的衡量更有效。

meanings_zh: n. 兴趣；关注；n. 利息；v. 使感兴趣
example1_en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
example1_zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。
example2_en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。

meanings_zh: adj. 感兴趣的；adj. 有利害关系的
example1_en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
example1_zh: 我姐姐对学习种菜很感兴趣。
example2_en: Students who are interested in science should have regular opportunities to conduct practical experiments.
example2_zh: 对科学感兴趣的学生应该经常有机会开展实际实验。

meanings_zh: adj. 有趣的；引人关注的
example1_en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
example1_zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。
example2_en: The survey revealed an interesting connection between access to green spaces and residents' overall satisfaction with urban life.
example2_zh: 这项调查揭示了绿地可达性与居民对城市生活的总体满意度之间一种值得关注的联系。

meanings_zh: adj. 国际的；跨国的；n. 国际比赛；国家队选手
example1_en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
example2_zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 互联网；因特网
example1_en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
example1_zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。
example2_en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
example2_zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。

meanings_zh: n. 面试；面谈；n. 采访；访谈；v. 面试；采访
example1_en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
example1_zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。
example2_en: Researchers should interview residents from diverse backgrounds to understand how housing policies affect different social groups.
example2_zh: 研究人员应访谈不同背景的居民，了解住房政策如何影响不同社会群体。

meanings_zh: prep. 进入；到……里面；prep. 变成；prep. 对……很感兴趣
example1_en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
example1_zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。
example2_en: Converting unused offices into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
example2_zh: 将闲置办公室改造成经济适用住房，可帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。

meanings_zh: v. 介绍；引见；v. 引进；推行；v. 使初次了解
example1_en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
example1_zh: 让我把你介绍给我的新邻居。
example2_en: Schools should introduce practical financial education to help students manage money responsibly in adult life.
example2_zh: 学校应引入实用的理财教育，帮助学生成年后负责任地管理财务。

meanings_zh: n. 介绍；引言；入门；n. 引进；首次采用
example1_en: After a brief introduction, we started cooking together.
example1_zh: 简短介绍之后，我们开始一起做饭。
example2_en: The introduction of electric buses could reduce air pollution in densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 引入电动公交车可以减少人口密集城区的空气污染。

meanings_zh: v. 发明；创造；v. 编造；虚构
example1_en: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
example1_zh: 我姐姐发明了一种巧妙的摘苹果工具。
example2_en: Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。

meanings_zh: n. 发明物；n. 发明；创造；n. 虚构的事；编造
example1_en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
example1_zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。
example2_en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
example2_zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。

meanings_zh: n. 发明家；发明者
example1_en: The inventor showed us a lamp powered by sunlight.
example1_zh: 这位发明家向我们展示了一盏太阳能灯。
example2_en: Inventors often need financial support to turn promising ideas into practical technologies that benefit society.
example2_zh: 发明者往往需要资金支持，才能把有前景的想法转化为造福社会的实用技术。

meanings_zh: v. 邀请；v. 征求；引起
example1_en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
example1_zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。
example2_en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
example2_zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。

meanings_zh: n. 爱尔兰（国家）；n. 爱尔兰岛
example1_en: We explored the west coast of Ireland by bicycle.
example1_zh: 我们骑自行车游览了爱尔兰西海岸。
example2_en: Ireland attracts international students through its English-speaking universities and opportunities to experience a different culture.
example2_zh: 爱尔兰凭借其英语授课的大学和体验不同文化的机会吸引国际学生。

meanings_zh: n. 岛；岛屿
example1_en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。
example2_en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
example2_zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。

meanings_zh: adj. 意大利的；意大利语的；n. 意大利语；n. 意大利人
example1_en: We cooked Italian pasta with tomatoes and fresh basil.
example1_zh: 我们用番茄和新鲜罗勒做了意大利面。
example2_en: Studying Italian architecture can help students understand how historical buildings influence contemporary urban design.
example2_zh: 研究意大利建筑可以帮助学生理解历史建筑如何影响当代城市设计。

meanings_zh: n. 一件物品；一件商品；n. 项目；条目；一则消息
example1_en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
example1_zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。
example2_en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
example2_zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。

meanings_zh: det. 它的
example1_en: The dog is playing with its ball.
example1_zh: 这只狗正在玩它的球。
example2_en: Every plant needs light for its growth.
example2_zh: 每株植物的生长都需要光。

meanings_zh: n. 夹克；短外套；n. 书籍护封；保护套
example1_en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
example1_zh: 我抓起外套，才走进寒冷的室外。
example2_en: A durable jacket made from recycled materials can offer consumers a more sustainable clothing choice.
example2_zh: 用再生材料制成的耐穿夹克可以为消费者提供更可持续的服装选择。

meanings_zh: n. 一月
example1_en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
example1_zh: 我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。
example2_en: Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.
example2_zh: 许多人在一月设定健康目标，但保持新习惯需要持续的支持。

meanings_zh: n. 日本
example1_en: We travelled around Japan by train during our holiday.
example1_zh: 假期里，我们乘火车游览了日本。
example2_en: Japan has invested in earthquake-resistant buildings to reduce the risks associated with living in a seismically active region.
example2_zh: 日本投资建设抗震建筑，以降低生活在地震活跃地区所带来的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 广口瓶；罐子；v. 使不快；显得不协调；v. 震动；使震痛
example1_en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
example1_zh: 她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。
example2_en: Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
example2_zh: 重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。

meanings_zh: n. 爵士乐
example1_en: We listened to jazz while cooking dinner together.
example1_zh: 我们一起做晚饭时听了爵士乐。
example2_en: Community jazz festivals can attract visitors while giving local musicians valuable opportunities to perform.
example2_zh: 社区爵士音乐节既能吸引游客，也能为当地音乐人提供宝贵的演出机会。

meanings_zh: n. 牛仔裤
example1_en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
example1_zh: 这条牛仔裤洗后还没干。
example2_en: Allowing employees to wear jeans may create a more relaxed workplace without necessarily reducing professional standards.
example2_zh: 允许员工穿牛仔裤可能营造更轻松的工作环境，而不一定降低职业标准。

meanings_zh: n. 工作；职位；n. 任务；活儿
example1_en: My sister found a job at the local library.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。
example2_en: Access to practical training can help young people secure a job in a competitive labour market.
example2_zh: 获得实用技能培训能帮助年轻人在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中找到工作。

meanings_zh: v. 慢跑；n. 慢跑；v. 轻碰；轻撞
example1_en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早饭前都绕着公园慢跑。
example2_en: People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.
example2_zh: 经常慢跑的人无需昂贵的器材或健身房会员资格，也能改善心血管健康。

meanings_zh: v. 加入；参加；v. 连接；接合；v. 与……会合；一起做
example1_en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
example1_zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？
example2_en: Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
example2_zh: 加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。

meanings_zh: n. 笑话；玩笑；v. 开玩笑
example1_en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
example1_zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。
example2_en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
example2_zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行；行程；n. 发展历程；v. 旅行
example1_en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
example1_zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_en: Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 改善铁路服务可以缩短每日通勤时间，并鼓励通勤者不开车出门。

meanings_zh: n. 喜悦；欢乐；n. 令人高兴的人或事
example1_en: The children jumped for joy when the snow began.
example1_zh: 开始下雪时，孩子们高兴得跳了起来。
example2_en: Community gardens can bring joy to residents while strengthening social connections and encouraging healthier lifestyles.
example2_zh: 社区花园既能给居民带来欢乐，也能加强社会联系并鼓励更健康的生活方式。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜悦的；令人高兴的
example1_en: We heard joyful laughter coming from the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们听到厨房里传来欢快的笑声。
example2_en: Community festivals create joyful shared experiences that can strengthen social connections among residents of different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 社区节庆活动创造共同的欢乐体验，有助于加强不同背景居民之间的社会联系。

meanings_zh: v. 判断；评价；n. 法官；n. 裁判；评委
example1_en: Don't judge the soup until you have tasted it.
example1_zh: 先尝尝这汤，再评价它。
example2_en: Schools should judge students on a range of abilities rather than relying entirely on examination results.
example2_zh: 学校应根据学生的多方面能力作出评价，而不是完全依赖考试成绩。

meanings_zh: n. 果汁；蔬菜汁
example1_en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
example1_zh: 她把鲜橙汁挤进了玻璃杯里。
example2_en: Although fruit juice contains vitamins, eating whole fruit usually provides more fibre and helps limit sugar intake.
example2_zh: 虽然果汁含有维生素，但吃完整的水果通常能摄入更多膳食纤维，并有助于限制糖分摄入。

meanings_zh: n. 七月
example1_en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
example1_zh: 我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。
example2_en: In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.
example2_zh: 在许多北方国家，旅游业在七月达到高峰，创造了季节性岗位，却也增加了当地公共服务的压力。

meanings_zh: v. 跳；跳过；v. 猛增；骤升；n. 跳跃；猛增
example1_en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
example1_zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。
example2_en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
example2_zh: 在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。

meanings_zh: n. 六月
example1_en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
example1_zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。
example2_en: The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
example2_zh: 社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。

meanings_zh: adj. 职位较低的；初级的；adj. 青少年的；年少的；n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
example1_en: Our junior chef prepares vegetables before the restaurant opens.
example1_zh: 我们餐厅的初级厨师在开门营业前准备蔬菜。
example2_en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
example2_zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

meanings_zh: adv. 仅仅；只是；adv. 刚刚；正好；adj. 公正的；正当的
example1_en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
example1_zh: 我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。
example2_en: A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
example2_zh: 一个公正的社会应确保所有儿童都能获得优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。

meanings_zh: v. 保留；保存；v. 保持；使保持；v. 继续；反复做
example1_en: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
example1_zh: 雨停之前，你可以继续留着这把伞用。
example2_en: Governments should keep public transport affordable to encourage residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 政府应使公共交通保持价格实惠，鼓励居民不开私家车出行。

meanings_zh: n. 钥匙；n. 关键；秘诀；adj. 关键的；主要的
example1_en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我把家门钥匙放在外套口袋里了。
example2_en: Access to reliable information is key to helping consumers make informed decisions about their health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息是帮助消费者就自身健康作出明智决定的关键。

meanings_zh: n. 电脑键盘；n. 乐器键盘；电子键盘乐器
example1_en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
example1_zh: 开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。
example2_en: Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.
example2_zh: 行动不便的学生可能受益于经过改装的键盘，从而更方便地参与数字化学习。

meanings_zh: v. 踢；n. 踢；踢击
example1_en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
example1_zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。
example2_en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
example2_zh: 孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。

meanings_zh: n. 小孩；孩子；v. 开玩笑；戏弄；n. 小山羊
example1_en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
example1_zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。
example2_en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
example2_zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。

meanings_zh: v. 杀死；使死亡；v. 使终止；扼杀
example1_en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
example1_zh: 这种肥皂有助于杀灭手上的病菌。
example2_en: Excessive use of pesticides can kill beneficial insects and disrupt the natural balance of agricultural ecosystems.
example2_zh: 过量使用农药会杀死益虫，破坏农业生态系统的自然平衡。

meanings_zh: n. 千克；公斤
example1_en: Could I have half a kilo of tomatoes, please?
example1_zh: 请给我半公斤西红柿，好吗？
example2_en: Comparing food prices per kilo can help households manage their budgets and make more economical purchasing decisions.
example2_zh: 比较食品每公斤的价格，有助于家庭管理预算，作出更经济的购买决定。

meanings_zh: n. 千克；公斤
example1_en: The bag weighs one kilogram.
example1_zh: 这个袋子重一千克。
example2_en: We bought two kilograms of apples.
example2_zh: 我们买了两公斤苹果。

meanings_zh: n. 千克；公斤
example1_en: We bought a kilogramme of apples at the market.
example1_zh: 我们在市场买了一公斤苹果。
example2_en: Producing a kilogramme of beef generally requires more water than producing the same weight of vegetables.
example2_zh: 生产一公斤牛肉通常比生产同等重量的蔬菜需要更多的水。

meanings_zh: n. 千米；公里
example1_en: The nearest bus stop is about a kilometre away.
example1_zh: 最近的公交车站大约在一公里外。
example2_en: Building safe cycle lanes within a kilometre of schools could encourage more children to cycle daily.
example2_zh: 在学校周边一公里内修建安全的自行车道，可以鼓励更多孩子每天骑车。

meanings_zh: adj. 善良的；体贴的；n. 种类
example1_en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
example1_zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

meanings_zh: n. 善良；体贴；n. 善举；好意
example1_en: Her kindness made our new neighbour feel welcome.
example1_zh: 她的体贴让新邻居感受到了欢迎。
example2_en: Schools can encourage kindness by giving students opportunities to support classmates who face personal difficulties.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生有机会帮助遇到个人困难的同学，从而培养他们的善意。

meanings_zh: n. 国王
example1_en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
example1_zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。
example2_en: In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
example2_zh: 在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

meanings_zh: n. 王国；n. 生物分类中的界
example1_en: The old castle once guarded the entrance to the kingdom.
example1_zh: 这座古堡曾经守卫着王国的入口。
example2_en: Tourism in the small kingdom provides employment, but increasing visitor numbers place pressure on historic buildings.
example2_zh: 旅游业为这个小王国提供了就业机会，但游客数量增长也给历史建筑带来了压力。

meanings_zh: n. 厨房
example1_en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
example1_zh: 厨房里飘着新鲜面包和烤蔬菜的香味。
example2_en: Shared kitchen facilities can encourage social interaction among students living in university accommodation away from home.
example2_zh: 共用厨房设施能促进离家住在大学宿舍的学生之间的社交互动。

meanings_zh: n. 风筝；n. 鸢
example1_en: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
example1_zh: 我们在风大的海滩上放了一只色彩鲜艳的风筝。
example2_en: Outdoor activities such as flying kites offer families affordable recreation and encourage children to spend time away from screens.
example2_zh: 放风筝等户外活动为家庭提供了经济实惠的娱乐方式，也鼓励孩子暂时远离屏幕。

meanings_zh: n. 小猫
example1_en: The kitten is sleeping in a basket.
example1_zh: 小猫正在篮子里睡觉。
example2_en: We gave the hungry kitten some milk.
example2_zh: 我们给了那只饥饿的小猫一些牛奶。

meanings_zh: n. 膝盖；膝关节
example1_en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
example1_zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。
example2_en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
example2_zh: 经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。

meanings_zh: n. 刀；餐刀
example1_en: Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
example1_zh: 用一把锋利的刀把面包切成片。
example2_en: Learning to use a kitchen knife safely is an important part of practical food education.
example2_zh: 学习安全使用菜刀是实用饮食教育的重要组成部分。

meanings_zh: v. 知道；懂得；v. 认识；熟悉
example1_en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
example1_zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？
example2_en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
example2_zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。

meanings_zh: n. 知识；学识；n. 知晓；了解
example1_en: My grandfather shared his knowledge of birds with me.
example1_zh: 祖父和我分享了他对鸟类的了解。
example2_en: Schools should help students apply their knowledge to practical problems rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生运用知识解决实际问题，而不只是记忆事实。

meanings_zh: n. 劳动
example1_en: The project took a lot of labour.
example1_zh: 这个项目投入了大量劳动。
example2_en: We learn to respect labour and workers.
example2_zh: 我们学习尊重劳动和劳动者。

meanings_zh: n. 缺乏；不足；v. 缺少；没有
example1_en: A lack of sleep made me tired all morning.
example1_zh: 睡眠不足让我整个上午都很疲惫。
example2_en: Many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with practical science lessons.
example2_zh: 许多乡村学校缺少为学生开设科学实践课所需的资源。

meanings_zh: n. 梯子；n. 晋升阶梯；等级体系
example1_en: She climbed the ladder to pick apples from the tree.
example1_zh: 她爬上梯子，摘树上的苹果。
example2_en: Access to professional training can help young employees move up the career ladder more quickly.
example2_zh: 获得专业培训的机会可以帮助年轻员工更快地晋升。

meanings_zh: n. 女士；夫人
example1_en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
example1_zh: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。
example2_en: An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.
example2_zh: 会上，一位年长女士讲述了新公交线路如何改善她的日常生活。

meanings_zh: n. 湖；湖泊
example1_en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
example1_zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。
example2_en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
example2_zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。

meanings_zh: n. 灯
example1_en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
example1_zh: 她打开了床边的灯。
example2_en: Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
example2_zh: 对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。

meanings_zh: n. 陆地；土地；v. 着陆；降落；使着陆；v. 成功获得
example1_en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
example1_zh: 在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。
example2_en: Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
example2_zh: 保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 风景；地貌；n. 局面；格局；v. 对……进行景观美化
example1_en: Snow covered the landscape beyond our small wooden cabin.
example1_zh: 白雪覆盖了我们小木屋外的山野。
example2_en: Large wind farms can alter the rural landscape, although they provide an important source of clean energy.
example2_zh: 大型风电场虽然是重要的清洁能源来源，却可能改变乡村景观。

meanings_zh: n. 山体滑坡；n. 压倒性胜利
example1_en: A landslide blocked the road after last night's rain.
example1_zh: 昨晚下雨后，一场山体滑坡堵住了道路。
example2_en: Removing trees from steep hillsides can increase the risk of landslides during periods of heavy rainfall.
example2_zh: 砍伐陡峭山坡上的树木，会增加强降雨期间发生山体滑坡的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 语言；n. 措辞；表达方式
example1_en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
example1_zh: 邻居教我一点她的语言。
example2_en: Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
example2_zh: 学习外语可以拓宽学生的文化视野，并改善他们未来的就业前景。

meanings_zh: n. 笔记本电脑
example1_en: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
example1_zh: 我的笔记本电脑正好能放进背包前面的隔层。
example2_en: Providing every student with a laptop may improve access to learning resources, but technical support remains essential.
example2_zh: 为每位学生配备笔记本电脑或许能改善学习资源的获取，但技术支持仍然必不可少。

meanings_zh: adj. 大的；大量的
example1_en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 一只大狗正睡在厨房门旁。
example2_en: Large cities often offer better employment opportunities, although high housing costs can reduce residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 大城市通常提供更好的就业机会，但高昂的住房成本可能降低居民的生活质量。

meanings_zh: adj. 最后的；最近过去的；v. 持续；够用；耐用；adv. 最后；上次
example1_en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
example1_zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。
example2_en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

meanings_zh: adj. 迟到的；晚期的；adv. 迟；晚；adj. 已故的
example1_en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
example1_zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。
example2_en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
example2_zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。

meanings_zh: adv. 后来；稍后；adj. 较晚的；后期的
example1_en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
example1_zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。
example2_en: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
example2_zh: 养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。

meanings_zh: v. 笑；发笑；n. 笑；笑声
example1_en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
example1_zh: 宝宝滑稽的舞蹈让吃晚饭的每个人都笑了。
example2_en: People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
example2_zh: 经常一起欢笑的人可能建立更牢固的社会联系，并更好地应对日常压力。

meanings_zh: n. 法律；法规；n. 法学；n. 定律；规律
example1_en: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
example1_zh: 法律要求驾驶员在红灯前停车。
example2_en: Governments should enforce environmental laws consistently to prevent businesses from gaining advantages through harmful practices.
example2_zh: 政府应始终如一地执行环境法律，防止企业通过有害行为获取优势。

meanings_zh: n. 律师
example1_en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
example1_zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。
example2_en: Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
example2_zh: 能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。

meanings_zh: v. 放置；铺设；v. 产卵；下蛋；adj. 非专业的；非神职的
example1_en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
example1_zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。
example2_en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
example2_zh: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。

meanings_zh: n. 层；层次；v. 分层放置
example1_en: A thin layer of dust covered the shelf.
example1_zh: 架子上覆盖着薄薄的一层灰尘。
example2_en: Adding an extra layer of insulation can significantly reduce energy consumption in older homes.
example2_zh: 增加一层保温材料可以显著降低老旧住宅的能源消耗。

meanings_zh: adj. 懒惰的；不愿出力的；adj. 悠闲的；懒洋洋的
example1_en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我懒得做饭。
example2_en: Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.
example2_zh: 不应一概认为做作业有困难的学生懒惰，因为这可能涉及学习障碍。

meanings_zh: v. 带领；引导；导致；n. 领先地位；优势；n. 铅
example1_en: Our guide led us safely through the forest.
example1_zh: 向导带着我们安全地穿过了森林。
example2_en: Poor access to public transport can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通不便可能导致人们更加依赖私家车。

meanings_zh: n. 叶子
example1_en: A green leaf fell from the tree.
example1_zh: 一片绿叶从树上落了下来。
example2_en: Each leaf collects light for the plant.
example2_zh: 每片叶子都为植物吸收光。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；学会；v. 得知；获悉
example1_en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
example1_zh: 我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。
example2_en: Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
example2_zh: 与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。

meanings_zh: det. 最少的；最小量的；adv. 最少；程度最低；pron. 最少量；最小程度
example1_en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
example1_zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。
example2_en: Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.
example2_zh: 与私家车出行相比，公共交通的人均污染通常最少。

meanings_zh: v. 离开；出发；v. 留下；忘带；n. 休假；假期
example1_en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
example1_zh: 我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。
example2_en: Paid parental leave allows new parents to care for their children without immediately returning to work.
example2_zh: 带薪育儿假让新手父母能够照顾孩子，而不必立即重返工作岗位。

meanings_zh: n. 讲座；大学课堂讲授；v. 讲课；作讲座；v. 训斥；说教
example1_en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
example1_zh: 讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。
example2_en: Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
example2_zh: 大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。

meanings_zh: n. 腿；n. 家具的腿；支脚；n. 一段行程
example1_en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
example1_zh: 走了很长一段路回家后，我的双腿很累。
example2_en: Regular walking strengthens the muscles in our legs and can improve health without expensive equipment.
example2_zh: 经常步行能增强腿部肌肉，无需昂贵器材就能改善健康。

meanings_zh: v. 借出；贷出；v. 给予；增添
example1_en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
example1_zh: 你能把雨伞借给我用到明天吗？
example2_en: Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
example2_zh: 地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。

meanings_zh: n. 长度；n. 持续时间
example1_en: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
example1_zh: 我们买椅子之前量了桌子的长度。
example2_en: The length of the school day can affect both student concentration and family routines.
example2_zh: 每天在校时间的长短既会影响学生的注意力，也会影响家庭的日常安排。

meanings_zh: det. 更少的；adv. 较少地；更不；pron. 更少的量
example1_en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
example1_zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。
example2_en: Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
example2_zh: 家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。

meanings_zh: n. 课；一节课；n. 教训；经验
example1_en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
example1_zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。
example2_en: A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
example2_zh: 以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。

meanings_zh: n. 信；信函；n. 字母
example1_en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。
example2_en: Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
example2_zh: 撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。

meanings_zh: n. 水平；程度；高度；adj. 平坦的；同高的；v. 使平坦；使相等
example1_en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
example1_zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。
example2_en: Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 提高公共交通服务水平可以鼓励更多居民不开私家车出行。

meanings_zh: n. 图书馆员
example1_en: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
example1_zh: 图书馆员帮我找到了一本关于鸟类的书。
example2_en: School librarians support independent learning by teaching students how to locate reliable sources and evaluate information.
example2_zh: 学校图书馆员通过教授学生如何寻找可靠来源并评估信息，来支持自主学习。

meanings_zh: n. 图书馆；藏书室；n. 资料库；收藏
example1_en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
example1_zh: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。
example2_en: Public libraries support lifelong learning by providing free access to books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供书籍、数字资源和安静的学习空间来支持终身学习。

meanings_zh: v. 舔；n. 舔；舔一下
example1_en: The puppy licked my hand and wagged its tail.
example1_zh: 小狗舔了舔我的手，摇着尾巴。
example2_en: Visitors should not allow wild animals to lick their hands, as close contact may spread infections.
example2_zh: 游客不应让野生动物舔自己的手，因为近距离接触可能传播感染。

meanings_zh: v. 躺；平放；v. 说谎；n. 谎言
example1_en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
example1_zh: 我喜欢午饭后躺在草地上。
example2_en: Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.
example2_zh: 就环保效益撒谎的广告会损害公众信任，并阻碍真正可持续的购买决策。

meanings_zh: n. 生活；人生；n. 生命；生存；n. 寿命；使用期限
example1_en: Life feels quieter since we moved to the countryside.
example1_zh: 自从搬到乡下，我们的生活感觉更安静了。
example2_en: Access to affordable housing can significantly improve the quality of life in large cities.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的住房可以显著提高大城市居民的生活质量。

meanings_zh: v. 举起；抬高；n. 电梯；n. 搭便车
example1_en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子抬到架子上吗？
example2_en: Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 在较老的公共建筑中安装电梯，可以方便轮椅使用者和行动不便的人进出。

meanings_zh: n. 光；光线；灯；adj. 轻的；明亮的；浅色的；v. 点燃；照亮
example1_en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
example1_zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。
example2_en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
example2_zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。

meanings_zh: v. 喜欢；喜爱；prep. 像；与……相似；prep. 例如；比如
example1_en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
example1_zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。
example2_en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
example2_zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。

meanings_zh: n. 线；线条；n. 一排；队伍；n. 线路；路线
example1_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
example1_zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
example2_en: Extending the railway line could connect rural communities with employment opportunities in nearby cities.
example2_zh: 延长铁路线可以让农村社区的居民获得附近城市的就业机会。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；连接；n. 链接；v. 连接；联系起来
example1_en: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
example1_zh: 这座新桥连接了这些村庄。
example2_en: Researchers have identified a strong link between regular physical activity and improved mental health.
example2_zh: 研究人员发现，经常运动与心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。

meanings_zh: n. 狮子
example1_en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
example1_zh: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。
example2_en: Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.
example2_zh: 保护狮子需要大片栖息地，让它们能够自然捕猎而不与农民发生冲突。

meanings_zh: n. 液体；adj. 液态的；adj. 易变现的；流动的
example1_en: She poured the warm liquid carefully into a glass.
example1_zh: 她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。
example2_en: Scientists analyse liquid samples from rivers to identify pollutants and assess potential risks to public health.
example2_zh: 科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。

meanings_zh: n. 清单；名单；v. 列出
example1_en: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
example1_zh: 出门前，我列了一张购物清单。
example2_en: The report lists several practical measures that cities can adopt to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 这份报告列出了城市可以采取的几项缓解交通拥堵的实用措施。

meanings_zh: v. 听；倾听；v. 听从；听取
example1_en: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
example1_zh: 每天晚上做饭时，我都会听音乐。
example2_en: Local authorities should listen to residents before making decisions that significantly affect their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 地方政府在作出对社区有重大影响的决定前，应听取居民的意见。

meanings_zh: n. 听者；听众
example1_en: My sister is a patient listener when I feel worried.
example1_zh: 我感到担忧时，姐姐总会耐心倾听。
example2_en: A good listener can help colleagues resolve disagreements by understanding different perspectives before offering advice.
example2_zh: 善于倾听的人会先理解不同观点再提出建议，从而帮助同事解决分歧。

meanings_zh: adj. 文学的；与文学有关的；adj. 书面语的；有文学色彩的
example1_en: Our local library hosts a literary festival each spring.
example1_zh: 我们当地的图书馆每年春天都会举办文学节。
example2_en: Studying literary works from different cultures can help students understand perspectives beyond their own experiences.
example2_zh: 学习不同文化的文学作品可以帮助学生理解自身经历之外的观点。

meanings_zh: n. 文学；文学作品；n. 文献；资料
example1_en: My sister studies literature and always recommends wonderful novels.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学文学，总能推荐很棒的小说。
example2_en: A review of the scientific literature suggests that regular exercise can improve mental health.
example2_zh: 对科学文献的综述表明，经常运动可以改善心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 乱扔的垃圾；v. 乱扔垃圾；使杂乱；n. 一窝幼崽
example1_en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。
example2_en: Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.
example2_zh: 减少城市公园里乱扔的垃圾，需要设置便于使用的垃圾桶，并持续开展公众教育活动。

meanings_zh: adj. 小的；年幼的；det. 很少的；几乎没有的；adv. 很少；略微
example1_en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。
example2_en: Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
example2_zh: 许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。

meanings_zh: v. 居住；生活；活着；adj. 现场直播的；现场的；adj. 活的
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。
example2_en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
example2_zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。

meanings_zh: adj. 活泼的；热闹的；adj. 生动有趣的；热烈的
example1_en: The lively puppy chased a ball around the garden.
example1_zh: 那只活泼的小狗在花园里追着球跑。
example2_en: Lively classroom discussions can encourage students to consider different perspectives and develop critical thinking skills.
example2_zh: 热烈的课堂讨论能鼓励学生考虑不同观点，并培养批判性思维能力。

meanings_zh: adj. 当地的；本地的；n. 当地人；adj. 局部的
example1_en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。
example2_en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
example2_zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。

meanings_zh: v. 锁上；锁定；n. 锁；n. 一绺头发
example1_en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
example1_zh: 上楼前请把后门锁好。
example2_en: Employees should lock their computers whenever they leave their desks to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information.
example2_zh: 员工离开办公桌时应锁定电脑，以防机密信息被未经授权的人查看。

meanings_zh: n. 储物柜；带锁小柜
example1_en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
example1_zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。
example2_en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
example2_zh: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。

meanings_zh: n. 伦敦（英国首都）
example1_en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring London by bus.
example1_zh: 我们在一个下雨的下午乘公交车游览了伦敦。
example2_en: London attracts international students because its universities offer diverse courses and access to extensive cultural resources.
example2_zh: 伦敦吸引着国际学生，因为当地大学提供多样的课程和丰富的文化资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；adj. 偏僻的；荒凉的
example1_en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
example1_zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。
example2_en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
example2_zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 长的；长时间的；adv. 长时间地；很久；v. 渴望；盼望
example1_en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
example1_zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。
example2_en: Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
example2_zh: 长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。

meanings_zh: adj. 长期的
example1_en: We need a long-term plan for our garden.
example1_zh: 我们需要为花园制定一个长期规划。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can bring long-term benefits to both local economies and the environment.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以为地方经济和环境带来长期效益。

meanings_zh: v. 丢失；遗失；v. 失去；减少；v. 输掉；失败
example1_en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
example1_zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。
example2_en: Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
example2_zh: 大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。

meanings_zh: adj. 迷路的；丢失的；adj. 困惑的；不知所措的；v. 丢失；失去；输掉
example1_en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
example1_zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。
example2_en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
example2_zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。

meanings_zh: n. 荷花；莲花
example1_en: A pink lotus grows in the pond.
example1_zh: 池塘里长着一朵粉色荷花。
example2_en: The lotus is a symbol used in Chinese art.
example2_zh: 荷花是中国艺术中常用的象征。

meanings_zh: adj. 响亮的；大声的；adv. 大声地
example1_en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
example1_zh: 一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。
example2_en: Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
example2_zh: 经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。

meanings_zh: v. 爱；热爱；非常喜欢；n. 爱；爱情；热爱
example1_en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。
example2_en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供多样化的图书和安排定期参观图书馆，培养孩子对阅读的热爱。

meanings_zh: adj. 美丽的；可爱的；adj. 令人愉快的；友善的
example1_en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。
example2_en: Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
example2_zh: 保护美丽的海岸景观既能吸引游客，也能为当地居民提供宝贵的户外休闲空间。

meanings_zh: n. 恋人；情人；n. 爱好者
example1_en: The two lovers walked hand in hand beside the river.
example1_zh: 这对恋人手牵着手沿河散步。
example2_en: Public gardens offer nature lovers valuable opportunities to observe wildlife without leaving the city.
example2_zh: 公共花园为自然爱好者提供了不出城就能观察野生动物的宝贵机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 低的；少的；adj. 情绪低落的；adv. 在低处；低声地
example1_en: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
example1_zh: 这个低矮的架子很方便孩子们取东西。
example2_en: Low wages can prevent essential workers from finding affordable housing close to their places of employment.
example2_zh: 低工资可能让从事必要服务的劳动者难以在工作地点附近找到负担得起的住房。

meanings_zh: adj. 较低的；较下方的；v. 降低；放下
example1_en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
example1_zh: 把重碗放在下面那层架子上。
example2_en: Governments can lower transport costs by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling routes.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过投资可靠的公交服务和安全的自行车道来降低交通成本。

meanings_zh: adv. 幸好；幸运地
example1_en: My bag fell open, but luckily nothing dropped out.
example1_zh: 我的包掉下来摔开了，幸好没有东西掉出来。
example2_en: The storm damaged several classrooms, but luckily the school had already moved its students to a safer building.
example2_zh: 暴风雨损坏了几间教室，但幸好学校已将学生转移到一栋更安全的建筑中。

meanings_zh: adj. 幸运的；侥幸的；adj. 被认为带来好运的
example1_en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
example1_zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。
example2_en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
example2_zh: 虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。

meanings_zh: n. 行李
example1_en: Our luggage barely fitted into the small taxi.
example1_zh: 我们的行李勉强塞进了那辆小出租车。
example2_en: Providing secure luggage storage at railway stations can encourage tourists to explore nearby attractions on foot.
example2_zh: 在火车站提供安全的行李寄存服务，可以鼓励游客步行游览附近景点。

meanings_zh: n. 午餐；v. 吃午餐
example1_en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。
example2_en: Providing nutritious school lunches can improve children's concentration and support healthier eating habits over time.
example2_zh: 提供营养丰富的学校午餐可以提高儿童的专注力，并帮助他们逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 机器；机械装置；v. 用机器加工
example1_en: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
example1_zh: 洗衣机在最后脱水时剧烈晃动，声音很大。
example2_en: A modern machine can perform repetitive tasks efficiently, allowing workers to focus on more complex problems.
example2_zh: 现代机器能高效完成重复性任务，让工人专注于更复杂的问题。

meanings_zh: adj. 生气的；愤怒的；adj. 疯狂的；不理智的；adj. 痴迷的；极喜爱的
example1_en: Dad was mad because I broke his favourite cup.
example1_zh: 爸爸很生气，因为我打碎了他最喜欢的杯子。
example2_en: Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.
example2_zh: 虽然一些居民热衷足球，但公共体育资金应支持更广泛的活动。

meanings_zh: n. 女士；夫人（尊称）
example1_en: Would you like a table by the window, madam?
example1_zh: 女士，您想坐靠窗的桌子吗？
example2_en: In formal customer service settings, staff may address a female customer as madam to show respect.
example2_zh: 在正式的客户服务场合，工作人员可能用madam称呼女性顾客，以示尊重。

meanings_zh: n. 杂志；期刊
example1_en: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
example1_zh: 她在车站买了一本园艺杂志。
example2_en: A specialist magazine can provide practical career advice that general news websites may not offer.
example2_zh: 专业杂志可以提供综合新闻网站未必能提供的实用职业建议。

meanings_zh: n. 魔法；魔术；n. 魅力；奇妙之处；adj. 有魔力的；魔术的
example1_en: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
example1_zh: 他表演魔术时，孩子们笑了起来。
example2_en: Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.
example2_zh: 虽然技术能够改善教育，但它不是解决学校所有问题的神奇办法。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；最重要的；n. 主管道；干线
example1_en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
example1_zh: 正门就在那家小咖啡馆旁边。
example2_en: One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.
example2_zh: 人们迁往城市的一个主要原因是城市提供的就业机会更多。

meanings_zh: v. 维持；保持；v. 保养；维护；v. 坚持声称
example1_en: Regular walks help me maintain a healthy weight.
example1_zh: 经常散步帮助我保持健康的体重。
example2_en: Governments must maintain essential public services while responding to growing pressure on national budgets.
example2_zh: 政府必须在应对国家预算压力不断增大的同时，维持基本公共服务。

meanings_zh: v. 制作；制造；v. 使；迫使；n. 品牌；型号
example1_en: We made a small table from leftover pieces of wood.
example1_zh: 我们用剩下的木料做了一张小桌子。
example2_en: Schools can make science more accessible by allowing students to conduct simple experiments with everyday materials.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生用日常材料做简单实验，使科学更容易理解。

meanings_zh: n. 购物中心
example1_en: We spent the rainy afternoon browsing in the mall.
example1_zh: 下雨的下午，我们一直在购物中心闲逛。
example2_en: A new shopping mall may create jobs, but it can also threaten small independent retailers.
example2_zh: 新的购物中心可能创造就业机会，但也可能威胁独立小零售商的生存。

meanings_zh: n. 成年男子；男人；n. 人类；v. 为…配备人员；值守
example1_en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
example1_zh: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。
example2_en: Additional volunteers are needed to man information desks during the city's annual cultural festival.
example2_zh: 该市举办一年一度的文化节期间，需要更多志愿者在咨询台值守。

meanings_zh: adj. 人造的；人为的
example1_en: We walked around a man-made lake near the airport.
example1_zh: 我们绕着机场附近的一个人工湖散步。
example2_en: Man-made barriers such as dams can disrupt river ecosystems by preventing fish from reaching their breeding grounds.
example2_zh: 水坝等人工屏障会阻碍鱼类到达繁殖地，从而破坏河流生态系统。

meanings_zh: v. 设法做到；v. 管理；经营；v. 应付；支撑下去
example1_en: I managed to carry all the bags upstairs.
example1_zh: 我总算把所有袋子都提上了楼。
example2_en: Many students manage to balance academic demands with paid employment by planning their weekly schedules carefully.
example2_zh: 许多学生通过仔细安排每周日程，设法兼顾学业要求与有薪工作。

meanings_zh: n. 经理；管理者
example1_en: The manager helped a new employee arrange the shelves.
example1_zh: 经理帮一位新员工整理了货架。
example2_en: An effective manager encourages open communication and ensures that employees have sufficient resources to complete their tasks.
example2_zh: 高效的管理者鼓励开放沟通，并确保员工有充足的资源完成任务。

meanings_zh: n. 人类
example1_en: This museum explores how mankind learned to grow food.
example1_zh: 这座博物馆展示人类如何学会种植粮食。
example2_en: Climate change presents a challenge to mankind that requires sustained cooperation across national borders.
example2_zh: 气候变化给人类带来了挑战，需要各国持续开展跨境合作。

meanings_zh: n. 方式；方法；n. 举止；态度；n. 礼貌；礼仪
example1_en: She answered my questions in a calm manner.
example1_zh: 她平静地回答了我的问题。
example2_en: Schools should teach children to express disagreement in a respectful manner while encouraging independent thinking.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子以尊重他人的方式表达不同意见，同时鼓励独立思考。

meanings_zh: n. 地图；v. 绘制地图；标出分布
example1_en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
example1_zh: 出发前，我们把地图铺在桌上。
example2_en: Researchers use satellite images to map changes in forest cover and identify areas needing urgent protection.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用卫星图像绘制森林覆盖变化图，并确定急需保护的区域。

meanings_zh: n. 马拉松赛跑
example1_en: The city marathon starts early on Sunday.
example1_zh: 城市马拉松星期日一早开始。
example2_en: Running a marathon requires careful training.
example2_zh: 跑马拉松需要认真训练。

meanings_zh: n. 大理石；n. 弹珠
example1_en: The cool marble floor felt smooth under my feet.
example1_zh: 凉凉的大理石地板踩在脚下很光滑。
example2_en: Although marble enhances the appearance of public buildings, extracting it can damage surrounding landscapes and habitats.
example2_zh: 虽然大理石能提升公共建筑的外观，但开采它可能破坏周围景观和栖息地。

meanings_zh: v. 齐步行进；坚定地走；n. 游行；行军；n. 进行曲
example1_en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
example1_zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。
example2_en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。

meanings_zh: n. 痕迹；记号；n. 分数；成绩；v. 做标记；批改评分
example1_en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
example1_zh: 你的湿杯子在桌上留下了一道印子。
example2_en: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
example2_zh: 教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。

meanings_zh: n. 集市；市场；n. 市场需求；交易领域；v. 推销；营销
example1_en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。
example2_en: Companies increasingly market environmentally friendly products to consumers who want to reduce their impact on the planet.
example2_zh: 企业越来越多地向希望减轻自身环境影响的消费者推销环保产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 已婚的；adj. 婚姻的；夫妻生活的
example1_en: My sister is married and lives near the coast.
example1_zh: 我姐姐已婚，住在海岸附近。
example2_en: Affordable housing can help newly married couples establish independent households without placing excessive pressure on their finances.
example2_zh: 可负担的住房有助于新婚夫妇独立成家，而不会给他们带来过重的经济压力。

meanings_zh: v. 与……结婚；结婚；v. 为……主持婚礼
example1_en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
example1_zh: 我表姐计划明年春天与伴侣结婚。
example2_en: Many young adults choose to marry later because they want financial stability before starting a family.
example2_zh: 许多年轻人选择晚婚，因为他们希望在组建家庭前拥有稳定的经济基础。

meanings_zh: n. 火星
example1_en: Mars is known as the Red Planet.
example1_zh: 火星被称为红色星球。
example2_en: Scientists use rovers to study Mars.
example2_zh: 科学家使用探测车研究火星。

meanings_zh: v. 掌握；精通；n. 大师；能手；adj. 主要的；总的
example1_en: After weeks of practice, Hana finally mastered the dance.
example1_zh: 经过数周练习，哈娜终于熟练掌握了这支舞。
example2_en: Students need opportunities to master practical skills rather than simply memorise information for examinations.
example2_zh: 学生需要掌握实用技能的机会，而不只是为考试背诵知识。

meanings_zh: n. 垫子；席子；v. 使缠结成团
example1_en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering.
example1_zh: 进门前请在垫子上擦擦鞋。
example2_en: Placing a rubber mat near each entrance can help prevent slips in busy public buildings.
example2_zh: 在每个入口附近放置橡胶垫，有助于防止人们在繁忙的公共建筑内滑倒。

meanings_zh: n. 比赛；v. 相配；匹配；比得上；n. 火柴
example1_en: We watched a football match at the local park.
example1_zh: 我们在附近的公园看了一场足球比赛。
example2_en: Training programmes should match the skills taught in colleges with the needs of local employers.
example2_zh: 培训项目应使院校教授的技能与当地雇主的需求相匹配。

meanings_zh: n. 数学
example1_en: We used coloured blocks to practise maths after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们用彩色积木练习数学。
example2_en: Strong maths skills help students interpret financial information and make informed decisions in everyday life.
example2_zh: 扎实的数学技能有助于学生理解财务信息，并在日常生活中作出明智决定。

meanings_zh: n. 事情；问题；v. 要紧；有关系；n. 物质
example1_en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。
example2_en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
example2_zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。

meanings_zh: n. 五月
example1_en: Our school sports day is in May.
example1_zh: 我们学校的运动会在五月。
example2_en: The weather becomes warmer in May.
example2_zh: 五月天气变得更暖和。

meanings_zh: adv. 也许；可能
example1_en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
example1_zh: 如果天气好转，也许我们可以去野餐。
example2_en: Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.
example2_zh: 也许城市可以通过提供更便宜的公共交通，而非修建更多道路，来缓解交通拥堵。

meanings_zh: pron. 我（宾格）
example1_en: Please help me with this box.
example1_zh: 请帮我搬这个箱子。
example2_en: My teacher gave me a new book.
example2_zh: 老师给了我一本新书。

meanings_zh: n. 一餐；一顿饭
example1_en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
example1_zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。
example2_en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
example2_zh: 提供健康的学校餐食能提高儿童的专注力，并促进他们的身体发育。

meanings_zh: v. 意思是；意味着；打算；adj. 刻薄的；吝啬的；n. 平均值
example1_en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
example1_zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。
example2_en: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
example2_zh: 能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。

meanings_zh: n. 意思；含义；n. 意义；价值
example1_en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
example1_zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？
example2_en: Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.
example2_zh: 志愿服务既能让人感到生活有意义，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。

meanings_zh: v. 测量；衡量；n. 措施；办法；n. 衡量标准
example1_en: We measured the window before buying new curtains.
example1_zh: 我们买新窗帘前量了窗户的尺寸。
example2_en: Governments should introduce effective measures to reduce air pollution without placing excessive costs on low-income households.
example2_zh: 政府应采取有效措施减少空气污染，同时避免让低收入家庭承担过高费用。

meanings_zh: n. 测量；n. 测量值；尺寸
example1_en: We took careful measurements before buying the new curtains.
example1_zh: 买新窗帘之前，我们仔细量了尺寸。
example2_en: Accurate measurement of air pollution helps governments assess whether environmental policies are protecting public health.
example2_zh: 准确测量空气污染程度有助于政府评估环境政策是否在保护公众健康。

meanings_zh: n. 肉；食用肉类
example1_en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
example1_zh: 我们把生肉和蔬菜分开放在冰箱里。
example2_en: Reducing meat consumption may lower the environmental impact of food production in many countries.
example2_zh: 在许多国家，减少肉类消费可能降低食品生产对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 奖牌；勋章
example1_en: She proudly showed us her first swimming medal.
example1_zh: 她自豪地向我们展示了她的第一枚游泳奖牌。
example2_en: Winning an international medal can encourage young athletes to pursue sport as a professional career.
example2_zh: 赢得国际赛事奖牌能鼓励年轻运动员将体育作为职业来追求。

meanings_zh: adj. 医学的；医疗的；n. 体格检查
example1_en: The hotel called for medical help when a guest fainted.
example1_zh: 一位客人晕倒后，酒店呼叫了医疗救助。
example2_en: Governments should improve access to medical services in rural areas where hospitals are often far away.
example2_zh: 政府应改善农村地区的医疗服务可及性，因为那里的医院往往距离很远。

meanings_zh: n. 药；药物；n. 医学；医术
example1_en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
example1_zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。
example2_en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
example2_zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。

meanings_zh: adj. 中等的；n. 媒介；传播手段
example1_en: Cook the vegetables over medium heat until soft.
example1_zh: 用中火把蔬菜煮软。
example2_en: Film is an effective medium for exploring social issues and encouraging discussion among young people.
example2_zh: 电影是探索社会问题并促进年轻人讨论的有效媒介。

meanings_zh: v. 遇见；会面；结识；v. 满足；达到
example1_en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。
example2_en: Public transport services must meet the needs of residents who cannot afford private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通服务必须满足那些买不起私家车的居民的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 会议；n. 会面；碰面
example1_en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。
example2_en: Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.
example2_zh: 教师与家长定期会面有助于及早发现学习困难。

meanings_zh: v. 融化；使熔化；v. 使心软；使感动
example1_en: The butter melted quickly in the warm pan.
example1_zh: 黄油在温热的平底锅里很快就化了。
example2_en: As global temperatures rise, mountain glaciers melt faster, threatening freshwater supplies for communities downstream.
example2_zh: 随着全球气温上升，山地冰川融化加快，威胁着下游社区的淡水供应。

meanings_zh: n. 成员；会员
example1_en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
example1_zh: 每位俱乐部成员都带了一道菜与大家分享。
example2_en: Every member of a community can contribute to protecting local green spaces through regular volunteer work.
example2_zh: 社区中的每一位成员都可以通过定期参与志愿服务，为保护当地绿地出力。

meanings_zh: n. 记忆力；记忆；n. 回忆；n. 计算机内存
example1_en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
example1_zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。
example2_en: Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼可能改善记忆力，帮助老年人更长久地保持独立生活的能力。

meanings_zh: v. 提到；说起；n. 提及
example1_en: Did you mention the broken window to the landlord?
example1_zh: 你向房东提过那扇坏了的窗户吗？
example2_en: Reports on urban transport often mention congestion but overlook the needs of people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 城市交通报告经常提到拥堵，却忽视行动不便人群的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 菜单；n. 计算机菜单；选项列表
example1_en: There are several vegetarian dishes on the menu.
example1_zh: 菜单上有几道素菜。
example2_en: Displaying nutritional information on a restaurant menu may help customers make healthier choices when eating out.
example2_zh: 在餐厅菜单上标注营养信息，可能有助于顾客外出就餐时做出更健康的选择。

meanings_zh: n. 脏乱；杂乱；n. 困境；混乱局面；v. 弄乱；弄糟
example1_en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
example1_zh: 我们烤完饼干后，厨房一片狼藉。
example2_en: Without clear responsibilities, a community project can quickly become a mess, wasting both time and resources.
example2_zh: 如果职责不清，社区项目很快就可能陷入混乱，既浪费时间又浪费资源。

meanings_zh: n. 消息；口信；n. 主旨；寓意；v. 给……发消息
example1_en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
example1_zh: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。
example2_en: Public health campaigns need a clear message that people from different backgrounds can easily understand.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传需要传达清晰的信息，让不同背景的人都能轻松理解。

meanings_zh: n. 米；公尺
example1_en: The table is one meter long.
example1_zh: 这张桌子一米长。
example2_en: He can jump more than a meter.
example2_zh: 他能跳过一米多远。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；办法；n. 条理；系统性
example1_en: This method keeps my herbs fresh for several days.
example1_zh: 这个方法能让我的香草保鲜好几天。
example2_en: Teachers should adapt their teaching methods to meet the varied needs of students in mixed-ability classrooms.
example2_zh: 教师应调整教学方法，以满足能力水平不同的学生的多样化需求。

meanings_zh: n. 米；公尺；n. 诗歌格律
example1_en: This shelf is just over a metre long.
example1_zh: 这个架子长一米多一点。
example2_en: Raising coastal barriers by one metre could help protect nearby homes from increasingly severe flooding.
example2_zh: 将海岸屏障加高一米，有助于保护附近住宅免受日益严重的洪水侵袭。

meanings_zh: n. 地铁；地铁系统
example1_en: We took the metro to the museum this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午，我们乘地铁去了博物馆。
example2_en: Expanding the metro could reduce traffic congestion by providing residents with a reliable alternative to private cars.
example2_zh: 扩建地铁能为居民提供可靠的私家车替代出行方式，从而缓解交通拥堵。

meanings_zh: n. 墨西哥
example1_en: We explored ancient ruins during our holiday in Mexico.
example1_zh: 我们在墨西哥度假期间探访了古代遗址。
example2_en: Tourism in Mexico creates employment, but popular coastal destinations also face pressure on water supplies and natural habitats.
example2_zh: 墨西哥的旅游业创造了就业机会，但热门沿海旅游地的供水和自然栖息地也面临压力。

meanings_zh: n. 显微镜
example1_en: We examined a drop of pond water under the microscope.
example1_zh: 我们用显微镜观察了一滴池塘水。
example2_en: Using a microscope allows students to observe cell structures that are invisible to the naked eye.
example2_zh: 使用显微镜能让学生观察到肉眼无法看见的细胞结构。

meanings_zh: n. 英里
example1_en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
example1_zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。
example2_en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
example2_zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。

meanings_zh: n. 奶；牛奶；v. 挤奶
example1_en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
example1_zh: 我往麦片上倒了些冷牛奶。
example2_en: Milk provides calcium and protein, although people with certain dietary needs may choose suitable alternatives.
example2_zh: 牛奶提供钙和蛋白质，但有特殊饮食需求的人可以选择合适的替代品。

meanings_zh: n. 头脑；心智；思维；v. 介意；反对；v. 留意；小心；照看
example1_en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
example1_zh: 你介意离开前把窗户关上吗？
example2_en: Regular physical activity can benefit both the body and the mind by reducing stress and improving concentration.
example2_zh: 规律的体育活动能减轻压力、提高专注力，从而有益于身心健康。

meanings_zh: pron. 我的；我的东西
example1_en: The blue umbrella is mine.
example1_zh: 这把蓝色雨伞是我的。
example2_en: Your drawing is different from mine.
example2_zh: 你的画和我的不一样。

meanings_zh: n. 分钟；片刻；n. 会议记录；adj. 极小的；微细的
example1_en: Wait a minute while I find my keys.
example1_zh: 等一下，我找找钥匙。
example2_en: Even a minute of regular classroom discussion can encourage students to reflect on what they have learned.
example2_zh: 即使每次只进行一分钟的常规课堂讨论，也能鼓励学生反思所学内容。

meanings_zh: n. 镜子；v. 反映；与……相似
example1_en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
example1_zh: 他离开前照镜子检查了一下头发。
example2_en: Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.
example2_zh: 消费者支出的变化往往反映更广泛的经济趋势，在金融形势不明朗时期尤其如此。

meanings_zh: v. 错过；未赶上；v. 想念；v. 未击中；未察觉
example1_en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
example1_zh: 快点，否则我们会错过末班公交车。
example2_en: Students who miss several lessons may need additional support to keep up with their classmates.
example2_zh: 缺了几节课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的进度。

meanings_zh: adj. 找不到的；失踪的；adj. 缺少的；缺失的
example1_en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们发现那只找不到的小猫正在沙发后面睡觉。
example2_en: Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.
example2_zh: 数据缺失会削弱研究结果的可靠性，并导致政策制定者得出不准确的结论。

meanings_zh: n. 错误；失误；v. 认错；误以为
example1_en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。
example2_en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
example2_zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。

meanings_zh: v. 混合；拌和；n. 混合物；组合；v. 交往；相处
example1_en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
example1_zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。
example2_en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
example2_zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 混合物；混合体
example1_en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
example1_zh: 搅拌混合物，直到它变得顺滑绵密。
example2_en: Successful cities offer a mixture of affordable housing, reliable transport, and accessible public spaces.
example2_zh: 成功的城市兼具可负担的住房、可靠的交通和方便使用的公共空间。

meanings_zh: adj. 可移动的；流动的；adj. 移动通信的；n. 手机
example1_en: The mobile library visits our village every Friday morning.
example1_zh: 流动图书馆每周五早晨来我们村。
example2_en: Mobile clinics can improve access to basic healthcare for people living in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 流动诊所可以让偏远农村社区的居民更容易获得基本医疗服务。

meanings_zh: adj. 现代的；近代的；adj. 新式的；时髦的
example1_en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓有一间新式厨房，窗户很大。
example2_en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
example2_zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。

meanings_zh: n. 片刻；一会儿；n. 时刻；时机
example1_en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
example1_zh: 等一会儿，我穿上鞋就好。
example2_en: The opening of the new railway marked a significant moment in the region's economic development.
example2_zh: 新铁路的开通标志着该地区经济发展中的一个重要时刻。

meanings_zh: n. 星期一
example1_en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
example1_zh: 我们通常在星期一去市场买新鲜水果。
example2_en: Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.
example2_zh: 许多员工觉得星期一早上压力很大，因为他们必须处理周末积压的任务。

meanings_zh: n. 钱；货币；n. 财富；财产
example1_en: I saved enough money to buy a new bicycle.
example1_zh: 我攒够了买一辆新自行车的钱。
example2_en: Governments should invest more money in public transport to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 政府应该向公共交通投入更多资金，以缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。

meanings_zh: n. 猴子
example1_en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
example1_zh: 一只小猴子在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。
example2_en: Protecting tropical forests helps preserve monkey populations and the complex ecosystems on which they depend.
example2_zh: 保护热带森林有助于保护猴类种群及其赖以生存的复杂生态系统。

meanings_zh: n. 月；一个月
example1_en: I put aside a little money every month.
example1_zh: 我每个月都会存下一点钱。
example2_en: Offering employees one additional day off each month could improve wellbeing without significantly reducing overall productivity.
example2_zh: 每月给员工额外一天假期，可以改善他们的身心状态，而不会显著降低整体生产效率。

meanings_zh: n. 月亮；月球；n. 天然卫星
example1_en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
example1_zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。
example2_en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
example2_zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

meanings_zh: det. 更多的；额外的；adv. 更；更加；pron. 更多；额外的数量
example1_en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
example1_zh: 请再给我的碗里添点米饭，好吗？
example2_en: Governments should invest more resources in preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
example2_zh: 政府应加大对预防保健的资源投入，以长期减轻医院的压力。

meanings_zh: n. 苔藓
example1_en: Thick green moss covered the stones beside the stream.
example1_zh: 溪边的石头上覆盖着厚厚的绿色苔藓。
example2_en: Moss helps forest ecosystems retain moisture and provides a habitat for many tiny organisms.
example2_zh: 苔藓有助于森林生态系统保持水分，并为许多微小生物提供栖息地。

meanings_zh: det. 大多数的；最多的；pron. 大多数；最大部分；adv. 最；非常
example1_en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
example1_zh: 这里大多数商店在我们下班前就关门了。
example2_en: Most urban residents would benefit from reliable public transport that connects residential areas with major employment centres.
example2_zh: 大多数城市居民都会受益于连接住宅区与主要就业中心的可靠公共交通。

meanings_zh: n. 母亲；妈妈；v. 像母亲般照顾
example1_en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
example1_zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。
example2_en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
example2_zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。

meanings_zh: n. 座右铭；格言
example1_en: My grandmother's motto was always to help others first.
example1_zh: 我祖母的座右铭是始终先帮助别人。
example2_en: A school's motto can express shared values, but daily teaching practices must also reflect those principles.
example2_zh: 学校的校训可以表达共同价值观，但日常教学实践也必须体现这些原则。

meanings_zh: v. 逐渐增加；加剧；v. 安装；固定；v. 组织开展；发起
example1_en: Dirty dishes mounted up while our dishwasher was broken.
example1_zh: 洗碗机坏了，脏碗碟越积越多。
example2_en: As pressure mounts to reduce emissions, governments must expand renewable energy production and improve energy efficiency.
example2_zh: 随着减排压力不断增加，各国政府必须扩大可再生能源生产并提高能源效率。

meanings_zh: n. 山；高山；n. 大量；一大堆
example1_en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
example1_zh: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆盖。
example2_en: Mountain communities often face higher transport costs because steep terrain makes road construction more difficult.
example2_zh: 山区社区往往面临更高的运输成本，因为陡峭的地形增加了修路的难度。

meanings_zh: n. 老鼠；n. 鼠标
example1_en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
example1_zh: 早饭前，一只小老鼠溜到了橱柜后面。
example2_en: Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.
example2_zh: 长时间使用鼠标可能引起手腕不适，因此办公室职员应定时休息。

meanings_zh: n. 嘴；口腔；n. 河口；入口；v. 用口形无声地说
example1_en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
example1_zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。
example2_en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
example2_zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。

meanings_zh: v. 移动；搬家；v. 使感动；n. 行动；举措
example1_en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
example1_zh: 你能把这把椅子挪到靠窗一点的位置吗？
example2_en: The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.
example2_zh: 扩大公共交通的决定是缓解城市拥堵的一项积极举措。

meanings_zh: n. 移动；动作；n. 社会运动；n. 乐章
example1_en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
