example1_zh: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。
example2_en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
example2_zh: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。

meanings_zh: n. 电影
example1_en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。
example2_en: Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.
example2_zh: 电影可以向观众介绍陌生文化，不过有时也会强化刻板印象，而非打破它们。

meanings_zh: title 先生
example1_en: Mr Li is our English teacher.
example1_zh: 李老师是我们的英语老师。
example2_en: Please ask Mr Brown for help.
example2_zh: 请向布朗先生求助。

meanings_zh: title 夫人；太太
example1_en: Mrs Chen is our neighbour.
example1_zh: 陈太太是我们的邻居。
example2_en: I met Mrs Smith at the school gate.
example2_zh: 我在校门口遇到了史密斯太太。

meanings_zh: title 女士
example1_en: Ms Wang teaches us science.
example1_zh: 王老师教我们科学。
example2_en: Please give the form to Ms Green.
example2_zh: 请把表格交给格林女士。

meanings_zh: det. 许多；大量；pron. 很多；大量；adv. 很；非常；更为
example1_en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们剩下的早餐牛奶不多了。
example2_en: Investing in preventive healthcare can be much more economical than treating illnesses after they become severe.
example2_zh: 投资预防性医疗可能比在疾病变得严重后再治疗经济得多。

meanings_zh: n. 骡子
example1_en: The mule carried bags up the mountain.
example1_zh: 骡子把袋子驮上了山。
example2_en: A mule is strong and sure-footed.
example2_zh: 骡子强壮而且脚步稳健。

meanings_zh: n. 妈妈
example1_en: My mum is cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我妈妈正在做晚饭。
example2_en: Mum helps me get ready for school.
example2_zh: 妈妈帮我做好上学的准备。

meanings_zh: n. 博物馆
example1_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example1_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
example2_en: Museums can help young people understand local history by connecting everyday objects with the lives of previous generations.
example2_zh: 博物馆可以将日常物品与前人的生活联系起来，帮助年轻人了解当地历史。

meanings_zh: n. 蘑菇；v. 迅速增长；迅速涌现
example1_en: I added sliced mushrooms to the soup for lunch.
example1_zh: 我在午餐的汤里加了切片蘑菇。
example2_en: Online learning platforms have mushroomed as demand for flexible and affordable education has increased worldwide.
example2_zh: 随着全球对灵活且价格可负担的教育需求上升，在线学习平台迅速涌现。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐；乐曲；n. 乐谱
example1_en: Soft music drifted through the kitchen while we cooked.
example1_zh: 我们做饭时，轻柔的音乐在厨房里飘荡。
example2_en: Learning music at school can develop children's creativity and provide opportunities for cooperation through group performances.
example2_zh: 在学校学习音乐可以培养儿童的创造力，并通过集体表演提供合作机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 音乐的；有音乐天赋的；n. 音乐剧；歌舞片；adj. 悦耳的
example1_en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
example1_zh: 他把乐器放在沙发旁边。
example2_en: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
example2_zh: 提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐家；乐手
example1_en: A musician played the violin outside the station.
example1_zh: 一位乐手在车站外拉小提琴。
example2_en: Local musicians can strengthen community identity by performing traditional songs at public festivals and cultural events.
example2_zh: 当地音乐人可以在公共节庆和文化活动中演奏传统歌曲，增强社区认同感。

meanings_zh: pron. 我自己；pron. 我亲自；我本人
example1_en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
example1_zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。
example2_en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
example2_zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。

meanings_zh: n. 谜；无法解释的事；n. 神秘感；n. 悬疑故事；推理小说
example1_en: Who left these flowers outside remains a mystery.
example1_zh: 是谁把这些花放在外面，至今还是个谜。
example2_en: Despite advances in marine research, the behaviour of many deep ocean species remains a mystery.
example2_zh: 尽管海洋研究取得了进展，许多深海物种的行为仍然是个谜。

meanings_zh: n. 名字；名称；v. 命名；说出名称；n. 名声；声誉
example1_en: What name did you choose for your new kitten?
example1_zh: 你给新来的小猫取了什么名字？
example2_en: Companies often choose a memorable name to distinguish their products in an increasingly competitive market.
example2_zh: 企业往往选择容易记住的名称，以便在竞争日益激烈的市场中突出自己的产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 狭窄的；adj. 有限的；勉强的；v. 缩小；变窄
example1_en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
example1_zh: 这条狭窄的小路只容得下我们排成一列走。
example2_en: Governments should invest in rural schools to narrow the educational gap between urban and remote communities.
example2_zh: 政府应投资乡村学校，缩小城市与偏远社区之间的教育差距。

meanings_zh: n. 国家；国民；n. 民族
example1_en: Fans across the nation celebrated the team's victory.
example1_zh: 全国各地的球迷都在庆祝这支球队获胜。
example2_en: Wealthier nations should support international efforts to improve access to clean water in poorer regions.
example2_zh: 较富裕的国家应支持国际合作，改善贫困地区的清洁用水条件。

meanings_zh: adj. 国家的；全国的；n. 某国国民
example1_en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
example1_zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。
example2_en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。

meanings_zh: adj. 天然的；自然界的；adj. 天生的；adj. 正常的；合乎常理的
example1_en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
example1_zh: 这块肥皂完全由天然原料制成。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting communities that depend on local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持生物多样性、支持依赖当地生态系统的社区至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 大自然；自然界；n. 性质；本质；n. 天性；性格
example1_en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
example1_zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。
example2_en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
example2_zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。

meanings_zh: adj. 淘气的；不听话的
example1_en: The naughty puppy dragged my slippers into the garden.
example1_zh: 那只淘气的小狗把我的拖鞋拖进了花园。
example2_en: Children described as naughty may benefit more from patient guidance than from repeated punishment.
example2_zh: 被说成淘气的孩子可能更需要耐心引导，而非反复惩罚。

meanings_zh: adj. 附近的；邻近的；adv. 在附近；不远处
example1_en: We bought fresh bread from a nearby bakery.
example1_zh: 我们从附近的一家面包店买了新鲜面包。
example2_en: Access to nearby parks encourages urban residents to exercise regularly and spend more time outdoors.
example2_zh: 附近有方便前往的公园，能鼓励城市居民经常锻炼，并增加户外活动时间。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎；差不多
example1_en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
example1_zh: 我睡过了头，差点没赶上公交车。
example2_en: Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.
example2_zh: 受访居民中近一半支持扩建公共交通系统，而不是增建道路。

meanings_zh: adj. 必要的；必需的
example1_en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
example1_zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。
example2_en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。

meanings_zh: n. 脖子；颈部；n. 瓶颈；狭长部分
example1_en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
example1_zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。
example2_en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
example2_zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。

meanings_zh: v. 需要；必须；n. 需要；需求；n. 贫困；困境
example1_en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
example1_zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。
example2_en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。

meanings_zh: adj. 消极的；不利的；adj. 否定的；阴性的；adj. 负的；小于零的
example1_en: Her negative comments made me doubt my cooking skills.
example1_zh: 她的负面评价让我怀疑自己的厨艺。
example2_en: Heavy reliance on private cars can have negative effects on air quality and public health.
example2_zh: 过度依赖私家车可能对空气质量和公众健康产生不利影响。

meanings_zh: n. 邻居；邻近的人或事物
example1_en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
example1_zh: 我们不在家时，邻居帮忙给植物浇了水。
example2_en: Shared gardens can strengthen relationships between neighbours and create a greater sense of belonging in urban communities.
example2_zh: 共享花园可以增进邻里关系，增强城市社区居民的归属感。

meanings_zh: n. 街区；附近地区；n. 街坊邻里
example1_en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
example1_zh: 我们街区刚开了一家小面包店。
example2_en: Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.
example2_zh: 投资建设社区公园可以改善居民健康，同时创造见面和社交的机会。

meanings_zh: det. 两者中无一的；pron. 两者都不；adv. 也不
example1_en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
example1_zh: 两件夹克都不合身，所以我会继续挑选。
example2_en: Neither approach can solve traffic congestion alone, so cities need a combination of investment and regulation.
example2_zh: 两种方法都无法单独解决交通拥堵，因此城市需要将投资与监管相结合。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧张的；忐忑不安的；adj. 神经的；神经系统的
example1_en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。
example2_en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
example2_zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

meanings_zh: n. 网；网状物；adj. 净的；扣除费用后的；v. 净赚；获得
example1_en: A small silver fish wriggled inside the fishing net.
example1_zh: 一条银色的小鱼在渔网里扭动。
example2_en: The company increased its net profit by reducing energy consumption rather than raising prices for customers.
example2_zh: 这家公司通过减少能源消耗而非提高售价来增加净利润。

meanings_zh: adj. 新的；新近出现的；adj. 新买的；新接触的；adj. 不熟悉的；初来乍到的
example1_en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
example1_zh: 我们的新邻居送来了一篮苹果。
example2_en: New technologies can make healthcare more accessible, but their benefits must be shared across different income groups.
example2_zh: 新技术能让医疗服务更易获得，但不同收入群体都应能享受到这些益处。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻；消息；n. 新闻节目；新闻报道
example1_en: She called her sister to share the good news.
example1_zh: 她给姐姐打电话，分享这个好消息。
example2_en: People should check several reliable sources before sharing news about health issues on social media.
example2_zh: 人们在社交媒体上分享健康问题的新闻前，应核实多个可靠来源。

meanings_zh: n. 报纸；n. 报社
example1_en: My grandfather reads the newspaper while eating breakfast.
example1_zh: 我爷爷一边吃早饭一边看报纸。
example2_en: Local newspapers provide valuable coverage of community issues that national media may overlook.
example2_zh: 地方报纸对全国性媒体可能忽略的社区问题提供了有价值的报道。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的；adj. 友善的；体贴的
example1_en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。
example2_en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
example2_zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。

meanings_zh: n. 夜晚；夜间
example1_en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。
example2_en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
example2_zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

meanings_zh: num. 九
example1_en: We packed nine apples for our picnic today.
example1_zh: 我们为今天的野餐装了九个苹果。
example2_en: The survey found that nine local schools had introduced cycling lessons to encourage more sustainable travel.
example2_zh: 调查发现，当地九所学校已开设骑行课程，以鼓励更可持续的出行。

meanings_zh: num. 十九
example1_en: Nineteen children took part in the show.
example1_zh: 十九个孩子参加了演出。
example2_en: The bus has nineteen passengers.
example2_zh: 公共汽车上有十九名乘客。

meanings_zh: pron. 没有人；n. 无名小卒
example1_en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 没人注意到睡在沙发后面的小猫。
example2_en: Nobody should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
example2_zh: 任何人都不应因家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。

meanings_zh: v. 点头；点头示意；n. 点头；点头示意
example1_en: She nodded when I offered her another cup of tea.
example1_zh: 我问她是否再来杯茶时，她点了点头。
example2_en: During group discussions, participants may nod to show understanding without necessarily agreeing with the speaker's views.
example2_zh: 在小组讨论中，参与者可能通过点头表示理解，但并不一定赞同发言者的观点。

meanings_zh: n. 噪音；响声
example1_en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
example1_zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。
example2_en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
example2_zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。

meanings_zh: pron. 一个也没有；毫无；adv. 毫不；一点也不
example1_en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
example1_zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。
example2_en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
example2_zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。

meanings_zh: n. 面条
example1_en: I would like a bowl of noodles.
example1_zh: 我想要一碗面条。
example2_en: This noodle soup smells delicious.
example2_zh: 这碗面汤闻起来很香。

meanings_zh: n. 中午；正午
example1_en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我们明天中午在图书馆外见吧。
example2_en: Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.
example2_zh: 户外工作者应避免在正午前后进行高强度体力活动，此时气温可能很高，阳光也可能特别强烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 正常的；通常的；n. 常态；正常水平
example1_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
example1_zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。
example2_en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。

meanings_zh: n. 北；北方；北部；adj. 北部的；朝北的；adv. 向北；在北方
example1_en: The north of the island gets snow every winter.
example1_zh: 这座岛的北部每年冬天都会下雪。
example2_en: Investment in rail connections could help towns in the north attract businesses and create more local jobs.
example2_zh: 投资铁路连接设施可以帮助北部城镇吸引企业，并创造更多本地就业岗位。

meanings_zh: adj. 北部的；北方的
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet northern village.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母住在北方一个安静的村庄。
example2_en: Northern regions often face higher heating costs, making energy efficiency particularly important for local households.
example2_zh: 北部地区的供暖费用往往较高，因此提高能源效率对当地家庭尤其重要。

meanings_zh: n. 鼻子；n. 飞机等的前端
example1_en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
example1_zh: 我的鼻子在冷风中冻红了。
example2_en: Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.
example2_zh: 戴口罩遮住口鼻可以减少吸入空气中的灰尘。

meanings_zh: n. 便条；笔记；v. 注意到；记下；n. 音符；单音
example1_en: I left a note beside your breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 我在你的早餐碗旁留了一张便条。
example2_en: Students who take notes in their own words may develop a deeper understanding of complex material.
example2_zh: 用自己的话记笔记的学生可能会对复杂的学习材料形成更深入的理解。

meanings_zh: n. 笔记本；笔记簿；n. 笔记本电脑
example1_en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
example1_zh: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。
example2_en: Keeping a notebook during fieldwork allows researchers to record observations that photographs alone may not capture.
example2_zh: 实地研究时使用笔记本，有助于研究人员记录仅靠照片可能无法捕捉的观察结果。

meanings_zh: pron. 没有任何东西；毫无；adv. 毫不；一点也不
example1_en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
example1_zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。
example2_en: Without affordable public transport, some residents have nothing to rely on except their own cars.
example2_zh: 如果没有价格合理的公共交通，一些居民除了自己的汽车便无可依靠。

meanings_zh: v. 注意到；察觉；n. 通知；告示；n. 提前通知
example1_en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
example1_zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？
example2_en: Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.
example2_zh: 城市限制中心区域的交通时，居民常会察觉空气质量有所改善。

meanings_zh: n. 长篇小说；adj. 新颖的；新奇的
example1_en: I finished the novel on the train yesterday.
example1_zh: 我昨天在火车上读完了这部长篇小说。
example2_en: Schools can use historical novels to help students understand how ordinary people experienced major social changes.
example2_zh: 学校可以利用历史小说，帮助学生理解普通人如何经历重大的社会变革。

meanings_zh: n. 十一月
example1_en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
example1_zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。
example2_en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
example2_zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。

meanings_zh: adv. 现在；如今；adv. 马上；立刻；conj. 既然；由于
example1_en: We live near the station now, so walking is easy.
example1_zh: 我们现在住在车站附近，步行过去很方便。
example2_en: Now that online courses are widely available, more adults can continue their education while working.
example2_zh: 既然在线课程已广泛普及，更多成年人就能在工作的同时继续接受教育。

meanings_zh: adv. 如今；现今
example1_en: Nowadays, I usually pay for groceries with my phone.
example1_zh: 如今，我买食品杂货通常用手机付款。
example2_en: Nowadays, many employees expect flexible working arrangements that allow them to balance professional and family responsibilities.
example2_zh: 如今，许多员工希望有灵活的工作安排，以便兼顾工作和家庭责任。

meanings_zh: n. 数；数字；号码；n. 数量；v. 给…编号；总计
example1_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
example1_zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。
example2_en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
example2_zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。

meanings_zh: n. 护士；v. 护理；照料
example1_en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
example1_zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。
example2_en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
example2_zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。

meanings_zh: n. 坚果；n. 螺母；螺帽
example1_en: She cracked a nut and shared the kernel with me.
example1_zh: 她敲开一颗坚果，把果仁分给我吃。
example2_en: Nuts provide useful nutrients, although schools must consider food allergies when planning meals for children.
example2_zh: 坚果能提供有益的营养物质，但学校为儿童安排餐食时必须考虑食物过敏问题。

meanings_zh: adv. ……点钟（整点）
example1_en: Please meet me outside the library at three o'clock.
example1_zh: 请三点整在图书馆外面和我见面。
example2_en: Starting school at nine o'clock rather than earlier may help teenagers concentrate better during morning lessons.
example2_zh: 将上学时间定在九点而非更早，可能有助于青少年在上午上课时更专注。

meanings_zh: n. 物体；东西；v. 反对；n. 目的；目标
example1_en: A shiny object was lying beneath the sofa.
example1_zh: 沙发下面有个闪闪发亮的东西。
example2_en: Many residents object to the proposed airport expansion because it could increase noise pollution.
example2_zh: 许多居民反对拟议中的机场扩建，因为这可能加剧噪声污染。

meanings_zh: n. 某次；场合；n. 特殊活动；盛会；n. 机会；时机
example1_en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
example1_zh: 我见过你姐姐好几次。
example2_en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
example2_zh: 社区节庆让不同背景的居民有机会分享传统、建立友谊。

meanings_zh: n. 海洋；大洋
example1_en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
example1_zh: 我们看着太阳从海面上升起。
example2_en: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
example2_zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。

meanings_zh: n. 十月
example1_en: Our local swimming pool will open again in October.
example1_zh: 我们当地的游泳池将在十月重新开放。
example2_en: The university begins its annual community research programme in October, giving students opportunities to investigate local environmental issues.
example2_zh: 这所大学每年十月启动社区研究项目，让学生有机会调查当地环境问题。

meanings_zh: adv. 离开；脱离；prep. 从……离开；离开……表面；adj. 关闭的；不工作的
example1_en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
example1_zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。
example2_en: Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.
example2_zh: 关闭公共建筑内不必要的照明可以减少耗电量并降低运营成本。

meanings_zh: v. 主动提供；提议；n. 提议；录用或录取通知；v. 出价
example1_en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
example1_zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。
example2_en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
example2_zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。

meanings_zh: n. 办公室；办公楼；n. 办事处；服务处；n. 公职；官职
example1_en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
example1_zh: 我把伞落在办公室的桌子下面了。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to divide their time between the office and home.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排让员工能够把工作时间分配在办公室和家中。

meanings_zh: n. 警察；警官；n. 军官；n. 官员；主管人员
example1_en: A police officer helped us find the station.
example1_zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。
example2_en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
example2_zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。

meanings_zh: adj. 官方的；正式的；n. 官员；高级职员
example1_en: We checked the official website before booking our tickets.
example1_zh: 我们订票前查看了官方网站。
example2_en: Official statistics indicate that investment in public transport has increased steadily over the past decade.
example2_zh: 官方统计数据显示，过去十年公共交通投资持续增长。

meanings_zh: n. 石油；原油；n. 油；食用油；润滑油；v. 给…加润滑油
example1_en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
example1_zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。
example2_en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
example2_zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。

meanings_zh: adj. 年老的；古老的；旧的；adj. ……岁的；有……年历史的；adj. 以前的；原来的
example1_en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
example1_zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。
example2_en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
example2_zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。

meanings_zh: n. 奥林匹克运动会
example1_en: Our family watched the Olympics together after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们全家晚饭后一起观看了奥运会。
example2_en: Hosting the Olympics can improve transport infrastructure, but governments must consider the long-term costs of maintaining sports facilities.
example2_zh: 举办奥运会可以改善交通基础设施，但政府必须考虑维护体育设施的长期成本。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上；prep. 在某日；关于；adv. 开着；运行中
example1_en: Your keys are on the table beside the door.
example1_zh: 你的钥匙在门旁的桌子上。
example2_en: Installing solar panels on public buildings can reduce energy costs and demonstrate a government's commitment to sustainability.
example2_zh: 在公共建筑上安装太阳能板可以降低能源成本，并展现政府对可持续发展的重视。

meanings_zh: adv. 一次；adv. 曾经；从前；conj. 一旦；当……之后
example1_en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
example1_zh: 我每两周给这株小仙人掌浇一次水。
example2_en: Once reliable public transport becomes available, more commuters may choose to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 一旦有了可靠的公共交通，更多通勤者可能会选择不开车出门。

meanings_zh: num. 一；一个；pron. 一个；某个事物；pron. 任何人；人们
example1_en: There is only one apple left in the bowl.
example1_zh: 碗里只剩一个苹果了。
example2_en: One major benefit of public transport is that it reduces the demand for parking spaces in cities.
example2_zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能减少城市对停车位的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 洋葱
example1_en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
example1_zh: 切这个洋葱又让我流眼泪了。
example2_en: Growing onions and other vegetables locally can shorten supply chains and provide communities with fresher produce.
example2_zh: 在本地种植洋葱等蔬菜可以缩短供应链，为社区提供更新鲜的农产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 网上的；联网的；adv. 在网上；联网地
example1_en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我在网上订了我们的火车票。
example2_en: Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.
example2_zh: 网络课程可以扩大受教育的机会，尤其有利于远离大学的学习者。

meanings_zh: prep. 到……上面
example1_en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
example1_zh: 猫跳到我旁边的沙发上。
example2_en: Moving freight onto trains could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from the transport sector.
example2_zh: 将货物转移到火车上运输，可以缓解道路拥堵并降低运输业的排放。

meanings_zh: adj. 敞开的；营业的；v. 打开；开办；开始营业；adj. 坦诚的；愿意接受的
example1_en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
example1_zh: 让窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。
example2_en: Governments should remain open to public feedback when developing policies that affect access to essential services.
example2_zh: 政府制定影响基本服务获取的政策时，应保持开放态度，听取公众反馈。

meanings_zh: n. 歌剧；歌剧艺术
example1_en: We watched an opera at the theatre last night.
example1_zh: 我们昨晚在剧院看了一部歌剧。
example2_en: Public funding for opera can preserve artistic traditions while making performances accessible to a wider audience.
example2_zh: 为歌剧提供公共资助既能保护艺术传统，也能让更多观众有机会欣赏演出。

meanings_zh: v. 操作；运转；v. 经营；运营；v. 做手术
example1_en: Can you show me how to operate this printer?
example1_zh: 你能教我怎么操作这台打印机吗？
example2_en: Companies that operate in rural areas often face higher transport costs and limited access to skilled workers.
example2_zh: 在农村地区经营的公司往往面临较高的运输成本，而且难以找到技术熟练的员工。

meanings_zh: n. 意见；看法
example1_en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
example1_zh: 你觉得我们的新厨房怎么样？
example2_en: In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 在我看来，公共交通的价格应足够实惠，从而鼓励人们不开私家车出门。

meanings_zh: n. 机会；时机
example1_en: The school trip gave me an opportunity to try climbing.
example1_zh: 学校旅行让我有机会尝试攀岩。
example2_en: Public libraries provide an important opportunity for residents to develop skills without paying expensive course fees.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆为居民提供了培养技能的重要机会，无须支付昂贵的课程费用。

meanings_zh: conj. 或者；还是；conj. 否则；不然
example1_en: Would you like rice or noodles with your vegetables?
example1_zh: 蔬菜配米饭还是面条，你想选哪一种？
example2_en: Governments must improve public transport or face increasing congestion and air pollution in major cities.
example2_zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则大城市将面临日益严重的拥堵和空气污染。

meanings_zh: n. 橙；橙子；adj. 橙色的；n. 橙色
example1_en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.
example1_zh: 我剥了一个橙子，和妹妹分着吃。
example2_en: An orange provides vitamin C, but a balanced diet requires a variety of foods.
example2_zh: 橙子能提供维生素C，但均衡饮食需要多种食物。

meanings_zh: n. 顺序；秩序；v. 订购；点餐；命令；n. 订单；命令
example1_en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
example1_zh: 请把这些照片按正确顺序排列。
example2_en: Online shoppers can now order fresh produce directly from local farms, supporting regional economies.
example2_zh: 网购者如今可以直接向当地农场订购新鲜农产品，从而支持地区经济。

meanings_zh: adj. 普通的；平常的
example1_en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
example1_zh: 打开之前，它看起来就是一个普通盒子。
example2_en: Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.
example2_zh: 城市规划应反映普通居民的需求，而不是只顾吸引富有的投资者。

meanings_zh: n. 组织；机构；团体；n. 组织工作；安排
example1_en: She volunteers for an organization that rescues injured birds.
example1_zh: 她在一家救助受伤鸟类的机构做志愿者。
example2_en: International organizations can help governments coordinate their responses to environmental problems that extend beyond national borders.
example2_zh: 国际组织可以帮助各国政府协调应对跨越国界的环境问题。

meanings_zh: det. 其他的；另外的；pron. 另外的人或事物
example1_en: This shoe fits, but where is the other one?
example1_zh: 这只鞋合脚，但另一只在哪里？
example2_en: Schools should teach practical skills alongside other subjects to prepare students for the demands of adult life.
example2_zh: 学校应在教授其他科目的同时传授实用技能，让学生为成年生活的要求做好准备。

meanings_zh: pron. 我们的；我们的东西
example1_en: The small garden is ours.
example1_zh: 这个小花园是我们的。
example2_en: Their classroom is larger than ours.
example2_zh: 他们的教室比我们的更大。

meanings_zh: pron. 我们自己；pron. 我们亲自
example1_en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
example1_zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。
example2_en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
example2_zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。

meanings_zh: n. 概要；大纲；v. 概述；列出要点；n. 轮廓；外形
example1_en: I wrote a quick outline before starting my essay.
example1_zh: 开始写作文之前，我先快速列了一个提纲。
example2_en: The report outlines several practical measures that schools can adopt to support students with learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 这份报告概述了学校可以采取的几项切实措施，以帮助有学习困难的学生。

meanings_zh: adv. 在外面；向外面；prep. 在…外；超出…范围；adj. 外面的；外部的
example1_en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
example1_zh: 父母准备午饭时，孩子们在外面玩耍。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to learn outside the classroom through practical activities and community projects.
example2_zh: 学校应通过实践活动和社区项目，为学生提供课堂之外的学习机会。

meanings_zh: n. 烤箱；烤炉
example1_en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
example1_zh: 面包刚出烤箱，还热乎着。
example2_en: Using an energy-efficient oven can reduce household electricity consumption without changing cooking habits significantly.
example2_zh: 使用节能烤箱可以减少家庭用电量，而不必大幅改变烹饪习惯。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方；越过；prep. 超过；adv. 结束
example1_en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。
example2_en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。

meanings_zh: adj. 自己的；v. 拥有
example1_en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
example1_zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。
example2_en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
example2_zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

meanings_zh: n. 所有者；物主
example1_en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
example1_zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.
example2_zh: 房产业主应维护其建筑，确保租户和附近居民的安全。

meanings_zh: adv. 下午；午后至午夜前
example1_en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
example1_zh: 游泳池今天晚上八点关门。
example2_en: Keeping public libraries open until nine p.m. would allow more working adults to access educational resources.
example2_zh: 让公共图书馆开放至晚上九点，可以使更多在职成年人获取教育资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 疼痛的；引起疼痛的；adj. 令人痛苦的；令人难堪的
example1_en: My ankle is still painful when I climb stairs.
example1_zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是很疼。
example2_en: For many workers, losing a secure job is a painful experience that affects both confidence and financial stability.
example2_zh: 对许多劳动者而言，失去稳定工作是一段痛苦的经历，既影响信心，也影响经济稳定。

meanings_zh: n. 油漆；颜料；v. 刷漆；涂色；v. 用颜料绘画
example1_en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
example1_zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。
example2_en: Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.
example2_zh: 学校应让孩子经常绘画，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和自我表达。

meanings_zh: n. 画家；n. 油漆工
example1_en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
example1_zh: 画家在调色板上混合蓝色和绿色。
example2_en: Local painters can preserve cultural traditions while introducing younger audiences to new artistic styles.
example2_zh: 当地画家既能传承文化传统，也能让年轻观众接触新的艺术风格。

meanings_zh: n. 绘画作品；画；n. 绘画；画画；n. 刷漆；粉刷
example1_en: We hung a colourful painting above the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们在沙发上方挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。
example2_en: Public galleries make important paintings accessible to everyone, regardless of their income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共美术馆让所有人都能欣赏重要画作，不受收入或教育背景的限制。

meanings_zh: n. 一双；一对；一副；n. 两人；一组两人；v. 配对；使成对
example1_en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
example1_zh: 我把最喜欢的那双手套落在公交车上了。
example2_en: Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.
example2_zh: 教师常将各有所长的学生配成一组，以鼓励合作并改善学习成效。

meanings_zh: n. 王宫；高级官邸
example1_en: We walked through the palace gardens before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们在王宫花园里散了步。
example2_en: Opening a historic palace to visitors can generate income for conservation and support local tourism.
example2_zh: 向游客开放历史悠久的宫殿，可以筹集保护资金并支持当地旅游业。

meanings_zh: n. 平底锅；烤盘；v. 严厉批评；v. 摇摄；转动镜头
example1_en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding onions.
example1_zh: 先把锅里的油烧热，再放入洋葱。
example2_en: Television chefs can encourage healthier eating by demonstrating how to prepare nutritious meals using a single pan.
example2_zh: 电视厨师可以通过演示如何用一口锅烹制营养餐，来鼓励更健康的饮食。

meanings_zh: n. 薄煎饼；松饼
example1_en: He flipped the pancake and reached for the honey.
example1_zh: 他把煎饼翻了个面，伸手去拿蜂蜜。
example2_en: Preparing pancakes in cooking classes allows students to practise measuring ingredients and using kitchen equipment safely.
example2_zh: 在烹饪课上制作煎饼，让学生有机会练习称量食材和安全使用厨房设备。

meanings_zh: n. 大熊猫
example1_en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
example1_zh: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。
example2_en: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
example2_zh: 保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。

meanings_zh: n. 恐慌；惊慌；v. 惊慌失措；使恐慌
example1_en: I felt a moment of panic when my keys disappeared.
example1_zh: 发现钥匙不见时，我一时惊慌起来。
example2_en: Clear communication during emergencies can reduce public panic and help people follow safety instructions more effectively.
example2_zh: 紧急情况下清晰的沟通能减少公众恐慌，帮助人们更有效地遵循安全指示。

meanings_zh: n. 纸；纸张；n. 报纸；n. 论文；试卷
example1_en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
example1_zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。
example2_en: The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.
example2_zh: 这所大学鼓励学生以电子形式提交作业，以减少各院系的纸张消耗。

meanings_zh: n. 段落
example1_en: This paragraph is too long for a quick email.
example1_zh: 对于一封简短的邮件来说，这一段太长了。
example2_en: Each paragraph in an academic essay should develop a clear argument supported by relevant evidence.
example2_zh: 学术文章的每一段都应展开一个清晰的论点，并以相关证据加以支持。

meanings_zh: int. 请再说一遍；v. 原谅；赦免；n. 赦免；宽恕
example1_en: Pardon? I couldn't hear you over the washing machine.
example1_zh: 请再说一遍？洗衣机太吵，我没听清。
example2_en: A legal pardon can help someone rebuild their life, although public acceptance may take longer.
example2_zh: 法律上的赦免可以帮助一个人重建生活，但获得公众接纳可能需要更久。

meanings_zh: n. 父亲或母亲；n. 母公司；v. 养育；教养
example1_en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
example1_zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。
example2_en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
example2_zh: 学校应让家长参与教育决策，因为家庭支持在孩子的学习中发挥着重要作用。

meanings_zh: n. 巴黎
example1_en: Paris is the capital of France.
example1_zh: 巴黎是法国的首都。
example2_en: Many visitors see the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
example2_zh: 许多游客在巴黎参观埃菲尔铁塔。

meanings_zh: n. 公园；v. 停车；泊车；n. 专用园区
example1_en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
example1_zh: 我们在公园的树下共进了野餐。
example2_en: Providing a park within walking distance of every neighbourhood can encourage exercise and strengthen community ties.
example2_zh: 让每个社区步行可达公园，有助于鼓励锻炼并加强社区联系。

meanings_zh: n. 鹦鹉；v. 机械地重复；鹦鹉学舌
example1_en: The green parrot cracked a seed with its beak.
example1_zh: 那只绿色鹦鹉用喙啄开了一粒种子。
example2_en: Students who merely parrot their teachers' explanations may struggle to apply knowledge to unfamiliar situations.
example2_zh: 只会机械重复教师讲解的学生，可能难以将知识应用于陌生情境。

meanings_zh: n. 部分；角色
example1_en: This is my favourite part of the story.
example1_zh: 这是故事中我最喜欢的部分。
example2_en: Every student played a part in the project.
example2_zh: 每名学生都参与了这个项目。

meanings_zh: n. 搭档；合作伙伴；合伙人；n. 配偶；伴侣；v. 与…搭档；合作
example1_en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
example1_zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。
example2_en: Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.
example2_zh: 大学可以与当地企业合作，让学生在就业前获得实践经验。

meanings_zh: v. 经过；通过；v. 传递；递给；v. 通过考试；及格
example1_en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
example1_zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。
example2_en: Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.
example2_zh: 学生必须通过实践考核，才能开始在实验室独立工作。

meanings_zh: n. 乘客；旅客
example1_en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
example1_zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。
example2_en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
example2_zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。

meanings_zh: n. 护照；n. 通往成功等的途径
example1_en: I checked my bag twice to find my passport.
example1_zh: 我翻了两遍包才找到护照。
example2_en: A university degree is often viewed as a passport to better employment, although practical experience also matters.
example2_zh: 大学学位常被视为获得更好工作的通行证，不过实践经验也很重要。

meanings_zh: n. 密码；口令
example1_en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
example1_zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。
example2_en: Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.
example2_zh: 为每个账户设置不同的密码，可以降低个人信息被盗的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 糊状物；浆糊；v. 用浆糊粘贴；v. 粘贴电子内容
example1_en: Mix the flour with water to make a paste.
example1_zh: 把面粉和水混合，调成糊状。
example2_en: Students should not simply paste material from websites into assignments without acknowledging the original sources.
example2_zh: 学生不应直接把网站材料粘贴进作业而不注明原始来源。

meanings_zh: n. 病人；患者；adj. 有耐心的；能忍耐的
example1_en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
example1_zh: 护士给病人端来了一杯水。
example2_en: Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.
example2_zh: 让患者讨论治疗方案可以增进信任，并改善健康结果。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；付工资；n. 工资；薪酬；v. 值得；划算
example1_en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
example1_zh: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？
example2_en: Employers should pay workers fairly to improve staff morale and reduce the number of people leaving.
example2_zh: 雇主应公平支付员工薪酬，以提高士气并减少人员流失。

meanings_zh: abbr. 体育（课）
example1_en: We have PE on Tuesday.
example1_zh: 我们星期二有体育课。
example2_en: PE helps us stay active and healthy.
example2_zh: 体育帮助我们保持活力和健康。

meanings_zh: n. 豌豆；豌豆粒
example1_en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
example1_zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。
example2_en: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
example2_zh: 在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。

meanings_zh: n. 和平；和睦；n. 安宁；平静
example1_en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
example1_zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。
example2_en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
example2_zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。

meanings_zh: n. 顶峰；山峰；最高点；v. 达到最高点；adj. 最高的；高峰期的
example1_en: Snow still covered the mountain peak in June.
example1_zh: 六月时，山顶仍覆盖着积雪。
example2_en: Electricity demand usually peaks in the early evening, when households use several appliances at once.
example2_zh: 电力需求通常在傍晚达到高峰，因为那时许多家庭会同时使用多种电器。

meanings_zh: n. 花生；花生米；n. 极少的钱
example1_en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
example1_zh: 她剥开壳，吃掉了里面的花生米。
example2_en: Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.
example2_zh: 学校安排膳食时应考虑花生过敏问题，确保所有儿童都能安全用餐。

meanings_zh: n. 梨
example1_en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 她把一个熟梨切成片，放进早餐碗里。
example2_en: Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.
example2_zh: 在自然成熟的季节购买本地种植的梨，可能减少长途食品运输的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 笔；钢笔；n. 动物围栏；圈；v. 撰写
example1_en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
example1_zh: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？
example2_en: Some students prefer using a pen because writing by hand helps them organise their ideas.
example2_zh: 有些学生更喜欢用笔，因为手写有助于他们整理思路。

meanings_zh: n. 铅笔；v. 用铅笔写或画
example1_en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
example1_zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。
example2_en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
example2_zh: 使用铅笔让学生能随着对科学概念理解的加深，轻松修改图示。

meanings_zh: n. 企鹅
example1_en: The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
example1_zh: 那只企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过岩石，朝大海走去。
example2_en: Changes in ocean temperatures can affect penguin populations by altering the availability of fish and other prey.
example2_zh: 海水温度的变化会改变鱼类及其他猎物的供应量，从而影响企鹅种群。

meanings_zh: n. 人；人们；n. 民族
example1_en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。
example2_en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
example2_zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。

meanings_zh: n. 胡椒粉；胡椒；n. 甜椒；辣椒；v. 使布满；大量加入
example1_en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
example1_zh: 能把胡椒粉递给我，让我加到汤里吗？
example2_en: Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.
example2_zh: 农民可以在温室里种植甜椒，以维持全年的稳定食物供应。

meanings_zh: prep. 每；每一
example1_en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
example1_zh: 这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。
example2_en: Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 减少每户家庭的能源消耗是降低一个国家碳排放的重要一步。

meanings_zh: adj. 完美的；最合适的；v. 使完善；使精通；adj. 完成时的
example1_en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
example1_zh: 这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。
example2_en: Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 尽管没有完美的交通系统，可靠的公共交通服务仍能显著减少城市对汽车的依赖。

meanings_zh: v. 表演；演出；v. 执行；履行；v. 表现；运转
example1_en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。
example2_en: Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
example2_zh: 学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。

meanings_zh: n. 表演者；演出者；n. 表现出某种水平的人或事物
example1_en: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
example1_zh: 一名街头艺人在拥挤的市场旁抛接橙子。
example2_en: Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.
example2_zh: 公共资金可以帮助年轻表演者提升技能，并将现场演出带到文化服务不足的社区。

meanings_zh: adv. 也许；可能；adv. 或许（委婉建议或请求）
example1_en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
example1_zh: 也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.
example2_zh: 政府或许可以让低收入家庭更买得起新鲜农产品，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

meanings_zh: n. 一段时间；时期；n. 课时；一节课；n. 月经；经期
example1_en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
example1_zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。
example2_en: A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
example2_zh: 长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 人；个人；n. 语法人称
example1_en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
example1_zh: 只有一个人在面包店外等候。
example2_en: Every person should have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of income or employment status.
example2_zh: 每个人都应享有负担得起的医疗服务，无论其收入或就业状况如何。

meanings_zh: adj. 个人的；本人的；adj. 私人的；隐私的；adj. 针对个人的；人身攻击的
example1_en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
example1_zh: 上火车时，请将个人物品放在身边。
example2_en: Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
example2_zh: 在线服务应保护个人信息，并清楚说明如何收集和使用客户数据。

meanings_zh: n. 个性；性格；n. 个人魅力；n. 名人
example1_en: Her cheerful personality makes everyone feel welcome at dinner.
example1_zh: 她开朗的性格让每位来吃饭的人都感到受欢迎。
example2_en: Schools should recognise that differences in personality can influence how students participate in group activities.
example2_zh: 学校应认识到，性格差异会影响学生参与集体活动的方式。

meanings_zh: n. 宠物；v. 抚摸
example1_en: Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我们的宠物兔喜欢躲在厨房桌子下面。
example2_en: Caring for a pet can help children develop responsibility and learn to recognise the needs of others.
example2_zh: 照顾宠物能帮助儿童培养责任感，并学会察觉他人的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 电话；手机；v. 给……打电话
example1_en: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我洗碗时，电话响了。
example2_en: Limiting phone use in classrooms may help students concentrate more effectively on lessons and group activities.
example2_zh: 限制课堂上的手机使用，可能有助于学生更专注于课程和小组活动。

meanings_zh: n. 照片
example1_en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。
example2_en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
example2_zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。

meanings_zh: n. 摄影；摄影术
example1_en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
example1_zh: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。
example2_en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
example2_zh: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。

meanings_zh: adj. 身体的；体力的；adj. 物质的；有形的；adj. 物理的
example1_en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
example1_zh: 每个周末做园艺活都让我得到充分的身体锻炼。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.
example2_zh: 规律的体育活动能够改善公众健康，并减轻国家医疗体系的财政压力。

meanings_zh: n. 物理学家
example1_en: A physicist showed our class how magnets work.
example1_zh: 一位物理学家向我们班演示了磁铁的工作原理。
example2_en: Physicists contribute to medical progress by developing imaging technologies that help doctors examine the human body.
example2_zh: 物理学家通过开发帮助医生检查人体的成像技术，推动医学进步。

meanings_zh: n. 物理学
example1_en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
example1_zh: 我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。
example2_en: A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
example2_zh: 扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。

meanings_zh: n. 钢琴家；钢琴演奏者
example1_en: The pianist smiled before playing her favourite song.
example1_zh: 那位钢琴演奏者微微一笑，开始弹奏她最喜爱的歌曲。
example2_en: A professional pianist usually needs years of disciplined practice as well as opportunities to perform publicly.
example2_zh: 职业钢琴家通常既需要多年严格的练习，也需要公开演出的机会。

meanings_zh: n. 钢琴
example1_en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。
example2_en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
example2_zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

meanings_zh: v. 挑选；选择；v. 采摘；n. 镐；鹤嘴锄
example1_en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
example1_zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。
example2_en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

meanings_zh: n. 野餐；v. 去野餐
example1_en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
example1_zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。
example2_en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
example2_zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

meanings_zh: n. 图片；图画；照片；n. 情况；整体印象；v. 想象；设想
example1_en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
example1_zh: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。
example2_en: Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
example2_zh: 调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。

meanings_zh: n. 馅饼；派
example1_en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。
example2_en: Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.
example2_zh: 水果派等传统菜肴有助于让地方饮食文化代代相传。

meanings_zh: n. 块；片；件；n. 文章；艺术作品；v. 拼合；拼凑
example1_en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
example1_zh: 她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。
example2_en: Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
example2_zh: 研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。

meanings_zh: n. 猪
example1_en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
example1_zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。
example2_en: Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
example2_zh: 农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。

meanings_zh: n. 药丸；药片；n. 口服避孕药
example1_en: He swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
example1_zh: 他用一杯水把药片吞了下去。
example2_en: Although a pill may relieve symptoms, lasting improvements in health often require changes to daily habits.
example2_zh: 虽然药物可能缓解症状，但要持久改善健康，往往需要改变日常习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 飞行员；adj. 试点的；试验性的；v. 驾驶飞机；试行
example1_en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
example1_zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。
example2_en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。

meanings_zh: n. 乒乓球运动；v. 来回移动；反复往返
example1_en: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
example1_zh: 等晚饭时，我们一起打了乒乓球。
example2_en: Community centres can offer inexpensive activities such as ping-pong to encourage social interaction among older residents.
example2_zh: 社区中心可以提供乒乓球等花费不高的活动，鼓励老年居民进行社交。

meanings_zh: adj. 粉红色的；n. 粉红色
example1_en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
example1_zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。
example2_en: Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
example2_zh: 设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。

meanings_zh: n. 管子；管道；v. 用管道输送；n. 烟斗
example1_en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
example1_zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。
example2_en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。

meanings_zh: n. 比萨饼
example1_en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
example1_zh: 电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。
example2_en: Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
example2_zh: 虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。

meanings_zh: n. 地方；地点；v. 放置；n. 座位；名额
example1_en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
example1_zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。
example2_en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
example2_zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。

meanings_zh: n. 计划；方案；v. 计划；打算；n. 平面图
example1_en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
example1_zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。
example2_en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
example2_zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。

meanings_zh: n. 行星
example1_en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。
example2_en: Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.
example2_zh: 科学家研究遥远的行星，以了解地球以外是否存在适合生命的条件。

meanings_zh: n. 植物；v. 种植；栽种；n. 工厂；工业设施
example1_en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
example1_zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。
example2_en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

meanings_zh: n. 塑料；adj. 塑料制的；adj. 可塑的
example1_en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
example1_zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。
example2_en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
example2_zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

meanings_zh: n. 盘子；碟子；n. 薄板；金属板；v. 给…镀上金属
example1_en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
example1_zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
example2_zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。

meanings_zh: v. 玩耍；参加游戏或运动；v. 演奏；播放；扮演；n. 戏剧；剧本
example1_en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
example1_zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。
example2_en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
example2_zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。

meanings_zh: n. 运动员；比赛参加者；n. 演奏者；n. 播放器
example1_en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
example1_zh: 足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。
example2_en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
example2_zh: 教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。

meanings_zh: n. 儿童游乐场；操场
example1_en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。
example2_en: Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
example2_zh: 每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；舒适的；adj. 友善的；和蔼的
example1_en: We enjoyed a pleasant walk beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边愉快地散了步。
example2_en: Public gardens provide pleasant spaces where residents can exercise, socialise, and escape the pressures of urban life.
example2_zh: 公共花园提供舒适宜人的空间，让居民锻炼、社交，并暂时摆脱城市生活的压力。

meanings_zh: n. 快乐；满足；n. 乐事；令人愉快的经历
example1_en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
example1_zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。
example2_en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。

meanings_zh: pron. 大量；充足；adv. 很；足够地；n. 富足；丰裕
example1_en: There is plenty of soup left for everyone.
example1_zh: 剩下的汤足够大家喝。
example2_en: Although cities offer plenty of employment opportunities, high housing costs can discourage young workers from moving there.
example2_zh: 尽管城市提供大量就业机会，高昂的住房成本仍可能让年轻劳动者不愿迁入。

meanings_zh: n. 口袋；v. 把…放入口袋；私吞；adj. 袖珍的
example1_en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我在外套口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
example2_zh: 当无法上网或网络不稳定时，袖珍词典对语言学习者仍然很有用。

meanings_zh: n. 播客；播客节目；v. 制作并发布播客
example1_en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。
example2_en: Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.
example2_zh: 教育类播客让学习者能够在出行或做日常家务时探索复杂的主题。

meanings_zh: n. 诗；诗歌作品
example1_en: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
example1_zh: 莱拉晚饭后朗读了一首短诗。
example2_en: Reading a poem from another culture can help students explore unfamiliar perspectives and develop sensitivity to language.
example2_zh: 阅读来自另一种文化的诗歌，可以帮助学生探索陌生的视角，培养语言敏感度。

meanings_zh: n. 诗人
example1_en: The poet read her latest work beside the fireplace.
example1_zh: 这位诗人在壁炉旁朗读了她的最新作品。
example2_en: A poet can challenge social attitudes by expressing familiar experiences in unexpected and emotionally powerful ways.
example2_zh: 诗人可以用出人意料且富有感染力的方式表达日常体验，从而挑战社会观念。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；要点；n. 尖端；尖头；v. 指向；指给……看
example1_en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
example1_zh: 关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。
example2_en: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
example2_zh: 这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 有礼貌的；客气的
example1_en: The polite child held the door open for us.
example1_zh: 那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。
example2_en: Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
example2_zh: 职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。

meanings_zh: n. 游泳池；水塘；n. 共同储备；备用资源；v. 集中共用；合伙出资
example1_en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。
example2_en: Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
example2_zh: 小企业可以集中资源，购买单独承担会过于昂贵的设备。

meanings_zh: adj. 贫穷的；adj. 差的；不足的；adj. 可怜的
example1_en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
example1_zh: 这户贫困家庭几乎买不起新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.
example2_zh: 公共交通不便可能限制远离主要城市中心的居民的就业机会。

meanings_zh: n. 流行音乐；v. 爆开；发出砰声；v. 短暂去；顺手放
example1_en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
example1_zh: 我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。
example2_en: Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.
example2_zh: 流行音乐可以让年轻听众了解其他文化，尤其是在艺人融合不同音乐传统时。

meanings_zh: adj. 受欢迎的；流行的；adj. 大众的；通俗的
example1_en: This small café is popular with local students.
example1_zh: 这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。
example2_en: Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
example2_zh: 通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。

meanings_zh: n. 人口；全体居民；n. 种群
example1_en: The village population grows when families move here.
example1_zh: 有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。
example2_en: An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.
example2_zh: 人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 猪肉
example1_en: We cooked the pork slowly with apples and onions.
example1_zh: 我们把猪肉和苹果、洋葱一起慢炖。
example2_en: Clear food labelling helps consumers identify products containing pork and make choices that suit their dietary requirements.
example2_zh: 清晰的食品标签有助于消费者识别含猪肉的产品，并作出符合自身饮食要求的选择。

meanings_zh: n. 燕麦粥；麦片粥
example1_en: I topped my warm porridge with sliced banana.
example1_zh: 我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。
example2_en: Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.
example2_zh: 学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。

meanings_zh: n. 港口；港口城市；n. 计算机端口；接口；n. 船或飞机的左舷
example1_en: We watched fishing boats returning to the port.
example1_zh: 我们看着渔船返回港口。
example2_en: Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.
example2_zh: 扩建港口可能促进国际贸易，但也可能破坏附近的海洋生境。

meanings_zh: n. 位置；姿势；n. 职位；地位；立场；v. 放置；安置
example1_en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
example1_zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？
example2_en: The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
example2_zh: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。

meanings_zh: adj. 积极乐观的；有益的；adj. 确信的；肯定的；adj. 阳性的；正数的
example1_en: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
example1_zh: 即使下雨毁了我们的野餐，她仍然保持乐观。
example2_en: Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on children's emotional development and overall wellbeing.
example2_zh: 经常接触大自然可以对儿童的情绪发展和整体健康产生积极影响。

meanings_zh: adj. 可能的；可实现的；adj. 或许合适的；潜在的
example1_en: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
example1_zh: 可以预订今晚的餐桌吗？
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy makes it possible for countries to reduce their dependence on imported fuels.
example2_zh: 对可再生能源的投资使各国有可能减少对进口燃料的依赖。

meanings_zh: adv. 可能；也许；adv. 究竟；无论如何
example1_en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
example1_zh: 如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。
example2_en: Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 扩大城市绿地可能降低夏季气温，同时改善居民的身心健康。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；邮政；v. 邮寄；发布；n. 职位；岗位
example1_en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。
example2_en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
example2_zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。

meanings_zh: n. 明信片
example1_en: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
example1_zh: 她从一个海边村庄给我寄来了一张明信片。
example2_en: Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.
example2_zh: 虽然电子信息传递得更快，但寄明信片能让旅行者与家人之间的联系更具人情味。

meanings_zh: n. 海报；招贴画
example1_en: She hung a colourful poster above her desk.
example1_zh: 她在书桌上方挂了一张色彩鲜艳的海报。
example2_en: A well-designed poster can encourage people to recycle by presenting environmental messages clearly and attractively.
example2_zh: 设计精良的海报可以清晰而有吸引力地传达环保信息，鼓励人们回收利用。

meanings_zh: n. 锅；n. 盆；罐；壶；v. 把植物栽入盆中
example1_en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
example1_zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。
example2_en: Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
example2_zh: 用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。

meanings_zh: n. 土豆；马铃薯
example1_en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
example1_zh: 我烤了一个土豆，并在里面填上奶酪。
example2_en: Potato farming provides an important source of food and income for many rural communities worldwide.
example2_zh: 马铃薯种植为世界各地许多农村社区提供了重要的食物和收入来源。

meanings_zh: v. 倒；灌；倾注；v. 下倾盆大雨；v. 涌入；涌出
example1_en: She poured warm milk into a large blue mug.
example1_zh: 她把温牛奶倒进一个蓝色的大杯子里。
example2_en: When factories pour untreated waste into rivers, they threaten aquatic ecosystems and nearby communities' drinking water.
example2_zh: 工厂将未经处理的废弃物排入河流时，会威胁水生生态系统及附近社区的饮用水安全。

meanings_zh: n. 权力；影响力；n. 动力；电力；v. 为…提供动力
example1_en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
example1_zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。
example2_en: Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
example2_zh: 太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。

meanings_zh: adj. 强有力的；动力强的；adj. 有权势的；影响力大的
example1_en: The powerful wind blew our garden chairs onto the grass.
example1_zh: 大风把我们的花园椅子吹到了草地上。
example2_en: Powerful companies should take greater responsibility for reducing the environmental damage caused by their operations.
example2_zh: 有影响力的企业应承担更大责任，减少其经营活动造成的环境破坏。

meanings_zh: adj. 实际操作的；实践的；adj. 实用的；可行的；adj. 务实的；动手能力强的
example1_en: The course gave me practical experience in repairing bikes.
example1_zh: 这门课程让我获得了修理自行车的实践经验。
example2_en: Schools should combine academic learning with practical skills to prepare students for a changing workplace.
example2_zh: 学校应将学术学习与实用技能相结合，帮助学生为不断变化的职场做好准备。

meanings_zh: n. 练习；训练；n. 惯例；做法；n. 实践；实际应用
example1_en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
example1_zh: 每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。
example2_en: Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。

meanings_zh: v. 练习；v. 从事专业工作；v. 践行；实行
example1_en: I practise the violin quietly after dinner each evening.
example1_zh: 我每天晚饭后都会轻声练习小提琴。
example2_en: Language learners should practise speaking regularly rather than rely entirely on memorising vocabulary and grammar rules.
example2_zh: 语言学习者应经常练习口语，而不是完全依赖背诵词汇和语法规则。

meanings_zh: v. 表扬；赞扬；n. 表扬；赞美
example1_en: Our coach praised us for helping the new players.
example1_zh: 教练表扬了我们帮助新队员的举动。
example2_en: Teachers who praise effort rather than natural ability may encourage students to persist when facing academic challenges.
example2_zh: 表扬努力而非天赋的教师，可能更能鼓励学生在学业遇到挑战时坚持下去。

meanings_zh: n. 预测；预言
example1_en: Your prediction was right: it rained all afternoon.
example1_zh: 你预测对了：整个下午都在下雨。
example2_en: Accurate predictions of future energy demand are essential for planning reliable and sustainable electricity supplies.
example2_zh: 准确预测未来能源需求，对于规划可靠且可持续的电力供应至关重要。

meanings_zh: v. 更喜欢；宁愿
example1_en: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，比起蛋糕，我更喜欢吃新鲜水果。
example2_en: Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.
example2_zh: 一些员工更喜欢居家办公，因为这样更灵活，也免去了每天通勤。

meanings_zh: n. 准备；准备工作
example1_en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
example1_zh: 孩子们帮忙时，准备晚饭反而要花更长时间。
example2_en: Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.
example2_zh: 充分准备求职面试能帮助毕业生更自信地介绍自己的技能和经验。

meanings_zh: v. 准备；做好准备；v. 制作；拟订
example1_en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。
example2_en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
example2_zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。

meanings_zh: adj. 在场的；目前的；v. 展示；提出；颁发；n. 礼物；现在
example1_en: All the children were present for the class photo.
example1_zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。
example2_en: Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.
example2_zh: 研究人员应清楚地展示研究结果，以便政策制定者就公共卫生作出有依据的决策。

meanings_zh: v. 按；压；n. 新闻界；报刊；v. 催促；敦促
example1_en: Press this button to open the garage door.
example1_zh: 按这个按钮就能打开车库门。
example2_en: A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.
example2_zh: 自由的新闻界帮助公民了解公共事务，并监督掌权者承担责任。

meanings_zh: n. 心理压力；催迫；n. 压力；压强；v. 迫使；向…施压
example1_en: I feel pressure to answer work messages immediately.
example1_zh: 我觉得自己必须立即回复工作消息，这让我有压力。
example2_en: Employers should avoid putting excessive pressure on staff, as this can damage both health and productivity.
example2_zh: 雇主应避免给员工施加过大压力，因为这既可能损害健康，也可能降低生产力。

meanings_zh: v. 假装；佯装；adj. 假想的；仿真的
example1_en: The children pretended the sofa was a pirate ship.
example1_zh: 孩子们把沙发想象成一艘海盗船。
example2_en: Children who pretend to be different characters can develop empathy by exploring unfamiliar perspectives through play.
example2_zh: 孩子们在游戏中扮演不同角色、体验陌生视角，可以培养同理心。

meanings_zh: adj. 漂亮的；秀丽的；adv. 相当；颇
example1_en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
example1_zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。
example2_en: Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
example2_zh: 虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。

meanings_zh: n. 价格；价钱；n. 代价；v. 给……定价
example1_en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
example1_zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。
example2_en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
example2_zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。

meanings_zh: n. 自豪；得意；n. 自尊；自负；v. 以……为傲
example1_en: Her face shone with pride as she displayed her painting.
example1_zh: 她展示画作时，脸上洋溢着自豪。
example2_en: Schools can foster community pride by encouraging students to participate in projects that improve their local environment.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生参与改善当地环境的项目，从而培养社区自豪感。

meanings_zh: adj. 首要的；主要的；adj. 小学的；初等教育的；adj. 最初的；直接的
example1_en: Our primary concern is keeping the children safe.
example1_zh: 我们最关心的是确保孩子们安全。
example2_en: Investment in primary education can reduce inequality by giving children a stronger foundation for future learning.
example2_zh: 投资初等教育可以为儿童今后的学习打下更牢固的基础，从而减少不平等。

meanings_zh: n. 王子；亲王；n. 公国君主
example1_en: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
example1_zh: 王子在宫殿阳台上向来访者挥手。
example2_en: In some constitutional monarchies, a prince may support charitable organisations without holding any direct political power.
example2_zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，王子可能支持慈善组织，但不掌握任何直接的政治权力。

meanings_zh: v. 印刷；打印；n. 印刷文字；字体；n. 印痕；印迹
example1_en: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
example1_zh: 你能把这份食谱打印两份吗？
example2_en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。

meanings_zh: n. 打印机；n. 印刷工；印刷商
example1_en: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
example1_zh: 我的作业打印到一半时，打印机没纸了。
example2_en: Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.
example2_zh: 学校可以将所有打印机设为自动双面打印，从而减少纸张浪费。

meanings_zh: adj. 私人的；非公开的；adj. 私营的；私有的；adj. 私密的；保密的
example1_en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
example1_zh: 每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。
example2_en: Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.
example2_zh: 私营公司可以改善公共交通，但政府必须确保票价仍在民众承受范围内。

meanings_zh: n. 奖品；奖金；奖项；v. 珍视；高度重视
example1_en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
example1_zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。
example2_en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
example2_zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。

meanings_zh: adv. 很可能；大概
example1_en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
example1_zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
example2_en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市，交通拥堵很可能会逐渐减轻。

meanings_zh: n. 问题；困难；n. 习题；待解答的问题
example1_en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
example1_zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。
example2_en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
example2_zh: 交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。

meanings_zh: n. 过程；程序；v. 处理；加工
example1_en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
example1_zh: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。
example2_en: The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.
example2_zh: 申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。

meanings_zh: v. 生产；创作；v. 产生；引起；n. 农产品
example1_en: Our garden produces enough tomatoes for the whole family.
example1_zh: 我们菜园里种出的番茄够全家吃。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can produce long-term benefits for both local communities and the environment.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以为当地社区和环境带来长期益处。

meanings_zh: n. 产品；制品；n. 产物；结果；n. 乘积
example1_en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
example1_zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。

meanings_zh: n. 生产；制造；n. 制作；演出作品
example1_en: The factory has increased production to meet summer demand.
example1_zh: 工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。
example2_en: Cleaner energy production can reduce air pollution while supporting the development of a modern economy.
example2_zh: 更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。

meanings_zh: n. 职业；专业性职业；n. 某职业的全体从业者；n. 公开表白；声明
example1_en: Nursing is a demanding profession, but my sister loves it.
example1_zh: 护理是个要求很高的职业，但我姐姐很喜欢。
example2_en: The teaching profession needs greater public support to attract talented graduates and retain experienced staff.
example2_zh: 教师行业需要更多公众支持，以吸引优秀毕业生并留住经验丰富的教师。

meanings_zh: n. 教授
example1_en: Our professor brought ancient coins to class today.
example1_zh: 我们的教授今天带了古钱币来上课。
example2_en: The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.
example2_zh: 这位教授鼓励学生在对气候政策下结论之前评估不同的信息来源。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机程序；v. 编写程序；设定运行；n. 计划；课程；节目
example1_en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
example1_zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。
example2_en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
example2_zh: 学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。

meanings_zh: n. 进步；进展；v. 进步；逐步发展
example1_en: You have made real progress with your swimming.
example1_zh: 你的游泳水平确实有了进步。
example2_en: Regular feedback helps students monitor their progress and identify areas that require further practice.
example2_zh: 定期反馈有助于学生了解自己的进步，并找出需要进一步练习的方面。

meanings_zh: n. 项目；工程；课题；v. 预计；预测；v. 投射；放映
example1_en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
example1_zh: 我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。
example2_en: Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
example2_zh: 研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。

meanings_zh: v. 承诺；答应；n. 承诺；诺言；n. 潜力；前景
example1_en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
example1_zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。
example2_en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
example2_zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。

meanings_zh: n. 发音；读音
example1_en: I practise my pronunciation by recording short voice messages.
example1_zh: 我通过录制简短的语音消息练习发音。
example2_en: Clear pronunciation helps language learners communicate effectively, even when their grammar is not always accurate.
example2_zh: 即使语法并非总是准确，清晰的发音也能帮助语言学习者有效沟通。

meanings_zh: adj. 适当的；正确的；adj. 像样的；真正的；adj. 严格意义上的；本身的
example1_en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
example1_zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合适的鞋。
example2_en: Workers should receive proper training before operating machinery that could pose a risk to their safety.
example2_zh: 工人在操作可能危及自身安全的机器前，应接受适当培训。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；防护
example1_en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
example1_zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。
example2_en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
example2_zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。

meanings_zh: v. 证明；证实；v. 结果是；证明是
example1_en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
example1_zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。
example2_en: Long-term studies may prove that regular exercise improves concentration as well as physical health.
example2_zh: 长期研究可能证实，经常锻炼既能改善注意力，也能增强身体健康。

meanings_zh: v. 提供；供应；v. 供养；赡养
example1_en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
example1_zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。
example2_en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
example2_zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。

meanings_zh: n. 省；行政区；n. 职责范围；专属领域
example1_en: My aunt lives in a quiet village in this province.
example1_zh: 我姑姑住在这个省的一个安静村庄里。
example2_en: Each province should adapt its transport policies to local geography, population density, and economic needs.
example2_zh: 各省应根据当地地理条件、人口密度和经济需求调整交通政策。

meanings_zh: adj. 公众的；公用的；公开的；adj. 政府的；公立的；n. 公众；民众
example1_en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
example1_zh: 这座公共花园每天开放到日落。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地上班，同时减少对私家车的依赖。

meanings_zh: v. 出版；刊登；v. 公布；发布
example1_en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
example1_zh: 当地杂志刊登了我拍摄的河流照片。
example2_en: Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.
example2_zh: 研究人员应公开发表研究结果，让政策制定者能够依据可靠证据作出决策。

meanings_zh: v. 拉；拖；拔；n. 拉；拉力；v. 拉伤肌肉
example1_en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
example1_zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。
example2_en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
example2_zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

meanings_zh: n. 南瓜
example1_en: We roasted a pumpkin and served it with rice.
example1_zh: 我们烤了一个南瓜，配米饭一起吃。
example2_en: Growing crops such as pumpkin in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 在社区菜园种植南瓜等作物，可以让城市社区居民更容易获得新鲜食物。

meanings_zh: v. 惩罚；处罚
example1_en: The referee punished the player for breaking the rules.
example1_zh: 裁判因那名球员违反规则而对其作出处罚。
example2_en: Schools should explain why behaviour is unacceptable rather than simply punish students without offering guidance.
example2_zh: 学校应解释为何某种行为不可接受，而不是只惩罚学生却不给予引导。

meanings_zh: adj. 紫色的；n. 紫色
example1_en: He wore a purple scarf with his grey coat.
example1_zh: 他穿着灰色外套，围了一条紫色围巾。
example2_en: Garden designers often combine purple flowers with yellow varieties to create a striking visual contrast.
example2_zh: 花园设计师常将紫色花卉与黄色品种搭配，形成鲜明的视觉反差。

meanings_zh: n. 目的；用途；n. 目标感；使命感
example1_en: What is the purpose of this tiny kitchen tool?
example1_zh: 这个小小的厨房工具是做什么用的？
example2_en: The main purpose of public libraries is to provide equal access to information and learning opportunities.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆的主要目的是让人们平等地获取信息和学习机会。

meanings_zh: v. 推；按；v. 敦促；迫使；n. 推动；大力争取
example1_en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
example1_zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？
example2_en: Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生在学业上进步，而不是迫使他们不断与同学竞争。

meanings_zh: n. 俯卧撑
example1_en: I managed one push-up before my arms started shaking.
example1_zh: 我做了一个俯卧撑，胳膊就开始发抖了。
example2_en: Simple exercises such as push-ups allow people to build strength without paying for expensive gym memberships.
example2_zh: 俯卧撑等简单运动让人们无需支付昂贵的健身房会员费就能增强力量。

meanings_zh: v. 放；安置；v. 表达；措辞；v. 使处于某种状态
example1_en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
example1_zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。
example2_en: Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.
example2_zh: 不断上涨的住房成本给刚开始职业生涯的年轻人带来很大压力。

meanings_zh: n. 质量；品质；n. 特质；品德；adj. 优质的
example1_en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
example1_zh: 以这个价格来说，这双鞋的质量让我感到惊喜。
example2_en: Governments should improve the quality of public transport before encouraging people to give up driving.
example2_zh: 政府应先提高公共交通的质量，再鼓励人们放弃开车。

meanings_zh: n. 四分之一；n. 季度；n. 城区；街区
example1_en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
example1_zh: 她把三明治切成四等份给孩子们吃。
example2_en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
example2_zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。

meanings_zh: n. 问题；疑问；n. 议题；待解决的问题；v. 询问；质疑
example1_en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
example1_zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。
example2_en: Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.
example2_zh: 研究人员越来越质疑，在现代办公环境中，延长工作时间是否真的能提高生产效率。

meanings_zh: n. 等候的队伍；v. 排队等候
example1_en: We joined the queue outside the bakery this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们加入了面包店外的队伍。
example2_en: Improved ticketing systems can reduce the time passengers spend waiting in a queue at busy stations.
example2_zh: 改进售票系统可以减少乘客在繁忙车站排队等候的时间。

meanings_zh: adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；adj. 短暂的；用时少的
example1_en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
example1_zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。
example2_en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
example2_zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。

meanings_zh: adv. 迅速地；很快地
example1_en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
example1_zh: 出租车一到，我们就迅速收拾好了行李。
example2_en: Cities must respond quickly to extreme weather events to protect vulnerable residents and maintain essential services.
example2_zh: 城市必须迅速应对极端天气事件，以保护弱势居民并维持基本服务。

meanings_zh: adj. 安静的；轻声的；adj. 平静的；不繁忙的；n. 安静；宁静
example1_en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
example1_zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。
example2_en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。

meanings_zh: adv. 轻声地；安静地；adv. 悄悄地；不张扬地
example1_en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
example1_zh: 请轻轻关门，宝宝正在睡觉。
example2_en: Students who work quietly in shared study areas help create an environment that supports concentration.
example2_zh: 在公共学习区域安静学习的学生有助于营造利于专注的环境。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；颇；adv. 完全；十分
example1_en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
example1_zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。
example2_en: Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.
example2_zh: 虽然骑行在学生中颇受欢迎，但基础设施不足使许多通勤者无法选择这种可持续的出行方式。

meanings_zh: n. 兔；家兔
example1_en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
example1_zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。
example2_en: Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 将兔子引入新环境可能破坏原生植被，扰乱当地生态系统的平衡。

meanings_zh: n. 速度比赛；赛跑；n. 种族；v. 竞速；飞奔
example1_en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
example1_zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。
example2_en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
example2_zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。

meanings_zh: n. 球拍；n. 喧闹声
example1_en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
example1_zh: 我把网球拍落在球场边了。
example2_en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
example2_zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。

meanings_zh: n. 收音机；n. 无线电广播；无线电通信；v. 用无线电联系或发送
example1_en: Dad keeps a small radio on the kitchen shelf.
example1_zh: 爸爸在厨房架子上放着一台小收音机。
example2_en: Radio remains an important source of information in remote communities where reliable internet access is limited.
example2_zh: 在难以稳定上网的偏远社区，广播仍是重要的信息来源。

meanings_zh: n. 铁路；铁路系统
example1_en: Our house overlooks the railway near the old bridge.
example1_zh: 从我们家能望见旧桥附近的铁路。
example2_en: Investment in railway networks can reduce road congestion while improving access to employment in neighbouring cities.
example2_zh: 投资铁路网络可以缓解道路拥堵，同时方便人们前往邻近城市就业。

meanings_zh: n. 雨；雨水；v. 下雨
example1_en: Heavy rain kept us inside for the whole afternoon.
example1_zh: 大雨让我们整个下午都待在屋里。
example2_en: Farmers increasingly depend on stored water because seasonal rain has become less predictable in many regions.
example2_zh: 由于许多地区的季节性降雨越来越难以预测，农民日益依赖储存的水。

meanings_zh: n. 彩虹；n. 缤纷的色彩
example1_en: A bright rainbow appeared above the hills after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，群山上空出现了一道鲜艳的彩虹。
example2_en: Tourists often photograph the rainbow that forms in the spray near the base of the waterfall.
example2_zh: 游客经常拍摄瀑布底部附近水雾中形成的彩虹。

meanings_zh: n. 雨衣
example1_en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
example1_zh: 走进雨中之前，我一把拿起了雨衣。
example2_en: Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 前往天气多变地区的旅行者应携带轻便雨衣，以便在户外活动时保持舒适。

meanings_zh: adj. 下雨的；多雨的
example1_en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that rainy afternoon.
example1_zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们待在室内烤面包。
example2_en: In regions with a long rainy season, reliable drainage systems are essential for protecting homes and roads.
example2_zh: 在雨季漫长的地区，可靠的排水系统对保护房屋和道路至关重要。

meanings_zh: v. 提高；举起；v. 筹集；v. 养育；饲养
example1_en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
example1_zh: 如果你还需要一支铅笔，请举手。
example2_en: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
example2_zh: 社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。

meanings_zh: n. 说唱音乐；说唱歌曲；v. 表演说唱；v. 快速敲击
example1_en: My brother listens to rap while he cooks dinner.
example1_zh: 我哥哥做晚饭时会听说唱音乐。
example2_en: Rap can give young people a creative way to express their experiences and discuss social issues.
example2_zh: 说唱能为年轻人提供一种富有创意的方式，表达经历并讨论社会问题。

meanings_zh: adj. 迅速的；快速的；n. 急流；险滩
