example1_en: Her rapid recovery surprised everyone in the family.
example1_zh: 她恢复得如此迅速，让全家人都感到惊讶。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth often places considerable pressure on public transport, housing, and essential services.
example2_zh: 城市的快速发展往往给公共交通、住房和基本服务带来相当大的压力。

meanings_zh: adv. 迅速地；快速地
example1_en: Dark clouds spread rapidly across the sky before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，乌云迅速布满天空。
example2_en: As urban populations grow rapidly, public transport systems must expand to meet increasing demand.
example2_zh: 随着城市人口迅速增长，公共交通系统必须扩展，以满足不断增加的需求。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；颇；adv. 宁愿；更愿意；adv. 更确切地说
example1_en: This soup is rather salty, but the bread is delicious.
example1_zh: 这汤有点咸，不过面包很好吃。
example2_en: Many commuters would rather cycle to work if safer routes were available throughout the city.
example2_zh: 如果全市都有更安全的骑行路线，许多通勤者会更愿意骑车上班。

meanings_zh: n. 评级；等级；n. 收视率；收听率；n. 额定值
example1_en: The hotel received a high rating for its friendly service.
example1_zh: 这家酒店因服务热情而获得了很高的评价。
example2_en: A clear energy rating helps consumers compare household appliances and choose models with lower running costs.
example2_zh: 清晰的能效评级帮助消费者比较家用电器，选择使用成本更低的型号。

meanings_zh: v. 到达；达到；v. 伸手；够到；n. 可及范围；影响范围
example1_en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
example1_zh: 我们刚到车站，雨就下起来了。
example2_en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
example2_zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。

meanings_zh: v. 作出反应；回应；v. 发生化学反应
example1_en: How did your sister react to the surprise party?
example1_zh: 你姐姐对这场惊喜派对有什么反应？
example2_en: Governments must react quickly to public health emergencies while providing clear information to citizens.
example2_zh: 政府必须迅速应对公共卫生紧急事件，同时向公众提供清晰的信息。

meanings_zh: v. 阅读；读懂；v. 朗读；v. 看懂；解读
example1_en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
example1_zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。
example2_en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
example2_zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。

meanings_zh: n. 读者；阅读者；n. 阅读器；读卡器；n. 分级读物；阅读课本
example1_en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
example1_zh: 莉娜热爱阅读，总是随身带着一本书。
example2_en: Digital libraries allow readers in remote communities to access educational resources without travelling to larger towns.
example2_zh: 数字图书馆让偏远社区的读者无需前往较大的城镇，就能获取教育资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 准备好的；可用的；adj. 愿意的；adj. 即将做某事的
example1_en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
example1_zh: 晚饭好了，请把你的盘子拿来。
example2_en: Schools must ensure that students are ready to meet the demands of a rapidly changing workplace.
example2_zh: 学校必须确保学生做好准备，以应对快速变化的职场需求。

meanings_zh: adj. 真实的；实际存在的；adj. 真的；非仿制的；adj. 实际的；扣除通胀的
example1_en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
example1_zh: 我以为那只鸟是塑料的，没想到是真的。
example2_en: Although average salaries have increased, rising prices mean that many workers have experienced a fall in real income.
example2_zh: 虽然平均工资上涨了，但物价上涨意味着许多劳动者的实际收入有所下降。

meanings_zh: n. 现实；实际情况；n. 事实；现实存在的事物
example1_en: The holiday looked perfect, but reality was quite different.
example1_zh: 这次假期看起来很完美，但实际情况却大不相同。
example2_en: Although remote work offers flexibility, the reality is that many employees struggle to separate work from personal life.
example2_zh: 虽然远程工作带来了灵活性，但现实是许多员工难以将工作与个人生活分开。

meanings_zh: adv. 很；非常；adv. 真正地；实际上；adv. 真的吗
example1_en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
example1_zh: 这汤非常烫，先让它凉一凉吧。
example2_en: Before expanding online education, policymakers should consider whether digital courses really meet the needs of disadvantaged learners.
example2_zh: 在扩大在线教育之前，政策制定者应考虑数字课程是否真正满足弱势学习者的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 原因；理由；n. 理性；推理能力；v. 推理；推断
example1_en: The heavy rain was the reason we stayed home.
example1_zh: 大雨是我们待在家里的原因。
example2_en: One reason for rising urban rents is that housing supply has failed to keep pace with population growth.
example2_zh: 城市租金上涨的一个原因是住房供应未能跟上人口增长。

meanings_zh: adj. 合理的；通情达理的；adj. 价格公道的；adj. 尚可的；过得去的
example1_en: Your suggestion sounds reasonable, so let's try it tomorrow.
example1_zh: 你的建议听起来很合理，我们明天试试吧。
example2_en: Employers should set reasonable targets that encourage productivity without placing excessive pressure on their staff.
example2_zh: 雇主应设定合理目标，在提高生产效率的同时避免给员工施加过大压力。

meanings_zh: v. 回想起；记得；v. 召回；收回；n. 记忆力；产品召回
example1_en: I still recall the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
example1_zh: 我仍然记得祖母厨房里的气味。
example2_en: Manufacturers should recall faulty products promptly to protect consumers and maintain public trust in safety standards.
example2_zh: 制造商应及时召回有缺陷的产品，以保护消费者并维持公众对安全标准的信任。

meanings_zh: v. 收到；得到；v. 接待；迎接
example1_en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
example1_zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？
example2_en: All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.
example2_zh: 在新线路开通之前，所有居民都应获得有关公共交通调整的明确信息。

meanings_zh: adj. 最近的；不久前的
example1_en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
example1_zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？
example2_en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
example2_zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。

meanings_zh: adv. 最近；不久前
example1_en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
example1_zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。
example2_en: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
example2_zh: 研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 食谱；烹饪方法；n. 促成某结果的方法或因素
example1_en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
example1_zh: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。
example2_en: Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.
example2_zh: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。

meanings_zh: v. 认出；识别；v. 承认；意识到；v. 正式认可；表彰
example1_en: I recognized my old teacher by her familiar laugh.
example1_zh: 我听到熟悉的笑声，认出了以前的老师。
example2_en: Employers should recognize the value of practical experience when assessing candidates who lack formal qualifications.
example2_zh: 评估缺乏正式学历或资质的求职者时，雇主应认可实践经验的价值。

meanings_zh: v. 推荐；介绍；v. 建议；劝告
example1_en: Can you recommend a quiet café near the station?
example1_zh: 你能推荐一家车站附近安静的咖啡馆吗？
example2_en: Health experts recommend regular exercise to reduce stress and improve overall physical and mental wellbeing.
example2_zh: 健康专家建议经常运动，以减轻压力并改善整体身心健康。

meanings_zh: n. 建议；n. 推荐；推荐信
example1_en: On your recommendation, I started taking short evening walks.
example1_zh: 听了你的建议，我开始在傍晚散一小会儿步。
example2_en: The committee's main recommendation was to improve public transport before introducing higher parking charges in the city centre.
example2_zh: 委员会的主要建议是先改善公共交通，再提高市中心的停车费。

meanings_zh: n. 记录；档案；v. 记录；录音；录像；n. 最高纪录
example1_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
example1_zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。
example2_en: Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.
example2_zh: 准确的医疗记录让医护人员能够作出有依据的决定，避免不必要的治疗。

meanings_zh: adj. 红色的；n. 红色
example1_en: She wore a red coat to the winter market.
example1_zh: 她穿着一件红色外套去了冬季集市。
example2_en: Designers often use red to draw attention to important warnings on machinery and in public spaces.
example2_zh: 设计师常用红色来突出机器上及公共场所中的重要警示。

meanings_zh: v. 减少；降低；缩小
example1_en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
example1_zh: 我们可以利用剩饭剩菜来减少浪费。
example2_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and improve long-term energy security.
example2_zh: 政府应投资可再生能源，以减少碳排放并改善长期能源安全。

meanings_zh: n. 礁；暗礁
example1_en: We watched colourful fish swimming around the coral reef.
example1_zh: 我们看着色彩斑斓的鱼在珊瑚礁周围游动。
example2_en: Protecting coral reefs is essential because they support marine biodiversity and help shield coastlines from powerful waves.
example2_zh: 保护珊瑚礁至关重要，因为它们维持海洋生物多样性，并帮助海岸抵御强浪。

meanings_zh: v. 改革；改进；n. 改革；改良措施；v. 改过自新；使改正
example1_en: Parents want the school to reform its admissions process.
example1_zh: 家长们希望学校改革招生程序。
example2_en: Healthcare reform should focus on reducing waiting times while ensuring equal access to essential services.
example2_zh: 医疗改革应着重缩短等候时间，同时确保人人都能平等获得基本服务。

meanings_zh: n. 冰箱；冷藏柜
example1_en: Put the milk in the refrigerator before it spoils.
example1_zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱，免得变质。
example2_en: Replacing an old refrigerator with an efficient model can reduce household electricity consumption significantly.
example2_zh: 用节能型号替换旧冰箱，可以显著减少家庭用电量。

meanings_zh: v. 拒绝；谢绝；n. 垃圾；废弃物
example1_en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
example1_zh: 不带上她最喜欢的蓝色雨伞，她就不肯走。
example2_en: Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.
example2_zh: 地方政府可能拒绝批准威胁野生动物栖息地或增加洪灾风险的开发项目。

meanings_zh: adj. 定期的；经常的；adj. 规则的；均匀的；n. 常客
example1_en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
example1_zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。
example2_en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
example2_zh: 规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。

meanings_zh: n. 排练；预演
example1_en: Our final rehearsal finished just before the audience arrived.
example1_zh: 我们的最后一次排练在观众到来前刚刚结束。
example2_en: Regular rehearsal helps students develop confidence and teamwork skills before they perform in front of an audience.
example2_zh: 定期排练有助于学生在登台表演前培养信心和团队合作能力。

meanings_zh: n. 人际关系；恋爱关系；n. 关联；联系
example1_en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
example1_zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。
example2_en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

meanings_zh: n. 亲戚；亲属；adj. 相对的；比较而言的
example1_en: A relative brought us homemade bread during the holidays.
example1_zh: 假期里，一位亲戚给我们带来了自制面包。
example2_en: The relative cost of public transport influences whether residents choose buses over private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通的相对费用会影响居民是否选择公交车而非私家车。

meanings_zh: v. 放松；休息；v. 放松肌肉；松弛；v. 放宽；放松限制
example1_en: I like to relax with music after dinner.
example1_zh: 我喜欢晚饭后听音乐放松。
example2_en: Regular access to green spaces helps urban residents relax and may improve their overall mental health.
example2_zh: 经常接触绿地有助于城市居民放松，也可能改善他们的整体心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 接力赛；v. 转达；转播；n. 继电器
example1_en: Our team dropped the baton during the school relay.
example1_zh: 我们队在学校接力赛中掉了接力棒。
example2_en: Emergency services relay weather warnings to remote communities through local radio stations and mobile networks.
example2_zh: 应急部门通过地方广播电台和移动网络向偏远社区传达天气警报。

meanings_zh: v. 仍然是；保持；v. 留下；停留；v. 剩下；余留
example1_en: Please remain seated until the bus has stopped completely.
example1_zh: 请留在座位上，直到公交车完全停稳。
example2_en: Despite improvements in public transport, private cars remain the main means of travel in many rural areas.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，私家车仍是许多农村地区的主要出行工具。

meanings_zh: v. 记得；想起；v. 记住去做；v. 纪念；缅怀
example1_en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
example1_zh: 我至今还记得祖母厨房里的气味。
example2_en: Students often remember new vocabulary more effectively when they use it in meaningful conversations.
example2_zh: 学生在有意义的对话中使用新词汇，往往能更有效地记住它们。

meanings_zh: v. 提醒；v. 使想起
example1_en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
example1_zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。
example2_en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
example2_zh: 学校应定期提醒学生，在使用在线学习平台时保护个人信息。

meanings_zh: v. 移走；取下；脱去；v. 清除；消除；v. 免职；撤职
example1_en: Please remove your shoes before stepping onto the new carpet.
example1_zh: 踩上新地毯前，请先脱鞋。
example2_en: Governments should remove unnecessary barriers that prevent qualified workers from entering the labour market.
example2_zh: 政府应消除阻碍合格劳动者进入劳动力市场的不必要障碍。

meanings_zh: v. 重复；重说；重做；n. 重复；重演；重播
example1_en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
example1_zh: 你能把地址再慢一点说一遍吗？
example2_en: Students who repeat new vocabulary aloud regularly may develop greater confidence when speaking a foreign language.
example2_zh: 经常大声重复新词汇的学生，在说外语时可能会更有信心。

meanings_zh: v. 替换；取代；更换；v. 把……放回原处
example1_en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。
example2_en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
example2_zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。

meanings_zh: v. 回答；答复；n. 回答；答复
example1_en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
example1_zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。
example2_en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
example2_zh: 地方官员应及时答复对公共交通服务提出担忧的居民。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；报道；v. 报告；报道；v. 报到
example1_en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
example1_zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。
example2_en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。

meanings_zh: n. 记者
example1_en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
example1_zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。
example2_en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
example2_zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。

meanings_zh: v. 需要；v. 要求；规定
example1_en: These plants require plenty of sunlight and regular watering.
example1_zh: 这些植物需要充足的阳光和定期浇水。
example2_en: Governments should require manufacturers to provide clear instructions for repairing products rather than replacing them.
example2_zh: 政府应要求制造商提供清晰的产品维修说明，以鼓励维修而非更换。

meanings_zh: v. 营救；解救；n. 营救；救援行动
example1_en: Firefighters rescued a kitten from the roof this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，消防员从屋顶救下了一只小猫。
example2_en: Coastal communities need well-equipped teams to rescue residents when severe flooding blocks roads and damages homes.
example2_zh: 沿海社区需要装备精良的队伍，在严重洪灾阻断道路、损坏房屋时营救居民。

meanings_zh: n. 研究；调查；v. 研究；调查
example1_en: I did some research before choosing my new bicycle.
example1_zh: 挑选新自行车之前，我做了一番调查。
example2_en: Research into renewable energy can help governments develop cleaner and more reliable sources of electricity.
example2_zh: 对可再生能源的研究可以帮助政府开发更清洁、更可靠的电力来源。

meanings_zh: n. 研究人员；研究者
example1_en: The researcher carefully examined the leaf under a microscope.
example1_zh: 研究人员用显微镜仔细观察了这片叶子。
example2_en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 资源；财力；人力；n. 资料；学习资源；v. 为…提供资源
example1_en: Our village shares its water resources during dry summers.
example1_zh: 在干旱的夏季，我们村会共享水资源。
example2_en: Governments should manage natural resources carefully to balance economic development with long-term environmental protection.
example2_zh: 政府应谨慎管理自然资源，以平衡经济发展与长期环境保护。

meanings_zh: n. 尊重；敬佩；v. 尊重；遵守；n. 方面
example1_en: She showed respect by listening without interrupting her colleague.
example1_zh: 她认真倾听，没有打断同事，以此表达尊重。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to respect different opinions while evaluating the evidence behind each argument.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生尊重不同观点，同时评估每种论点背后的证据。

meanings_zh: adj. 负责的；有责任的；adj. 造成某事的；应担责的；adj. 可靠的；有责任心的
example1_en: I'm responsible for feeding our cat every morning.
example1_zh: 我负责每天早晨喂我们家的猫。
example2_en: Governments are responsible for ensuring that all children have access to safe and affordable education.
example2_zh: 政府有责任确保所有儿童都能接受安全且负担得起的教育。

meanings_zh: n. 休息；v. 休息；让…休息；n. 其余部分；其他人
example1_en: Let's have a rest under that shady tree.
example1_zh: 我们在那棵树荫下休息一下吧。
example2_en: Regular periods of rest can help employees maintain concentration and reduce the risk of workplace accidents.
example2_zh: 定期休息有助于员工保持专注，并降低工作场所发生事故的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 餐馆；餐厅
example1_en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。
example2_en: Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.
example2_zh: 当地餐馆可以用附近农场的食材制作传统菜肴，以此吸引游客。

meanings_zh: n. 结果；后果；n. 成绩；比赛结果；v. 导致；由……造成
example1_en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
example1_zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。

meanings_zh: v. 复述；重新讲述
example1_en: My grandmother retells her favourite story every winter.
example1_zh: 奶奶每年冬天都会再讲一遍她最喜欢的故事。
example2_en: Asking students to retell a story in their own words can improve comprehension and speaking skills.
example2_zh: 让学生用自己的话复述故事，可以提高理解能力和口语技能。

meanings_zh: v. 返回；归还；n. 返回；归来；n. 收益；回报
example1_en: Please return these library books before you go away.
example1_zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。
example2_en: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。

meanings_zh: n. 重聚；团聚；聚会
example1_en: Our family reunion filled the garden with laughter.
example1_zh: 我们的家庭聚会让花园里充满了欢笑。
example2_en: School reunions can strengthen social connections and encourage former students to support their local communities.
example2_zh: 校友聚会能够加强社会联系，并鼓励往届学生支持当地社区。

meanings_zh: v. 再次使用；重复利用
example1_en: We reuse paper bags when we can.
example1_zh: 我们尽可能重复使用纸袋。
example2_en: Reusing old materials can reduce waste.
example2_zh: 重复利用旧材料可以减少浪费。

meanings_zh: n. 评论；评价；n. 审查；回顾；v. 审查；复习；评论
example1_en: Her review convinced me to read the whole novel.
example1_zh: 她的书评让我决定读完整部小说。
example2_en: Governments should regularly review housing policies to ensure that affordable accommodation remains available to low-income families.
example2_zh: 政府应定期审查住房政策，确保低收入家庭仍能获得负担得起的住所。

meanings_zh: n. 大米；米饭；稻
example1_en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
example1_zh: 我们晚餐吃了米饭和清蒸鱼。
example2_en: Improved irrigation methods can help farmers grow rice while using less water in regions affected by drought.
example2_zh: 改进灌溉方式可帮助受干旱影响地区的农民在减少用水的同时种植水稻。

meanings_zh: adj. 富有的；富裕的；adj. 富含的；丰富的；adj. 油腻的；浓厚的
example1_en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
example1_zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。
example2_en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
example2_zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

meanings_zh: n. 谜语；n. 谜；难解之事
example1_en: My cousin asked a riddle that nobody could solve.
example1_zh: 我的表亲出了一个谁也解不开的谜语。
example2_en: The sudden disappearance of this ancient settlement remains a riddle despite decades of archaeological research.
example2_zh: 尽管经过数十年的考古研究，这座古代聚落的突然消失仍是一个谜。

meanings_zh: v. 骑；乘坐；n. 乘车行程；骑行
example1_en: We ride our bikes to the lake every weekend.
example1_zh: 我们每个周末都骑自行车去湖边。
example2_en: Safer cycling routes could encourage more residents to ride bicycles rather than drive for short urban journeys.
example2_zh: 更安全的自行车道可以鼓励更多居民在城市短途出行时骑车，而不是开车。

meanings_zh: adj. 正确的；合适的；n. 权利；adj. 右边的；右侧的
example1_en: You picked the right key to open the door.
example1_zh: 你选对了开门的钥匙。
example2_en: Every child has the right to receive an education, regardless of their family's financial circumstances.
example2_zh: 每个孩子都有受教育的权利，无论其家庭经济状况如何。

meanings_zh: n. 戒指；环状物；v. 响铃；使响铃；v. 打电话给
example1_en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
example1_zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。
example2_en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
example2_zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。

meanings_zh: v. 上升；增加；上涨；v. 起身；站起来；n. 上升；增长；上涨
example1_en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
example1_zh: 我书桌旁的暖气上方，热空气向上升腾。
example2_en: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
example2_zh: 住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。

meanings_zh: n. 风险；危险；v. 冒…的风险
example1_en: Wear sturdy shoes to reduce the risk of slipping.
example1_zh: 穿结实的鞋子可以降低滑倒的风险。
example2_en: Governments should assess the risk of flooding before approving new housing developments near rivers.
example2_zh: 政府在批准河流附近的新住宅开发项目之前，应评估洪水风险。

meanings_zh: adj. 有风险的；危险的
example1_en: It is risky to cycle home without lights.
example1_zh: 骑车回家时不开车灯很危险。
example2_en: Investing all public funds in a single industry is risky because economic conditions can change unexpectedly.
example2_zh: 将所有公共资金投入单一产业风险很大，因为经济形势可能发生意外变化。

meanings_zh: n. 河；江
example1_en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。
example2_en: Protecting river ecosystems requires cooperation between farming communities, local industries, and environmental agencies.
example2_zh: 保护河流生态系统需要农业社区、当地企业和环境机构之间的合作。

meanings_zh: n. 道路；公路；n. 途径；进程
example1_en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
example1_zh: 过马路前要向两边看。
example2_en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
example2_zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

meanings_zh: n. 机器人；自动机械
example1_en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。
example2_en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
example2_zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。

meanings_zh: n. 岩石；石块；n. 摇滚乐；v. 摇动；摇晃
example1_en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。
example2_en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
example2_zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

meanings_zh: n. 火箭；v. 飞涨；迅速上升
example1_en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
example1_zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。
example2_en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
example2_zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。

meanings_zh: n. 作用；职责；n. 角色
example1_en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
example1_zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。
example2_en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

meanings_zh: v. 滚动；使滚动；v. 卷起；卷成；n. 一卷；小面包
example1_en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
example1_zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。
example2_en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
example2_zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。

meanings_zh: adj. 浪漫的；爱情的；adj. 理想化的；不切实际的；n. 浪漫的人；理想主义者
example1_en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
example1_zh: 他们在宁静的湖边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。
example2_en: Advertisements often present a romantic image of rural life while ignoring limited services and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 广告常把乡村生活描绘得很美好，却忽视了服务和就业机会不足的问题。

meanings_zh: n. 屋顶；顶部；v. 给……盖屋顶
example1_en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
example1_zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。
example2_en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
example2_zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 房间；室；n. 空间；余地
example1_en: My room has a desk beside the window.
example1_zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。
example2_en: Although public transport has improved significantly, there is still room for further investment in rural services.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通已显著改善，农村交通服务仍有进一步投资的空间。

meanings_zh: n. 植物的根；n. 根源；起因；v. 生根；使生根
example1_en: Thick roots from the oak have cracked our garden path.
example1_zh: 橡树粗壮的根把我们花园的小路撑裂了。
example2_en: Effective policies should address the root of poverty rather than simply provide temporary financial assistance.
example2_zh: 有效的政策应解决贫困的根源，而不只是提供临时的经济援助。

meanings_zh: n. 绳；绳索；v. 用绳捆绑
example1_en: We tied the boat to a post with rope.
example1_zh: 我们用绳子把船系在一根柱子上。
example2_en: Climbers should inspect their ropes regularly because damaged equipment can put the entire group at risk.
example2_zh: 登山者应定期检查绳索，因为损坏的装备可能危及整个团队。

meanings_zh: n. 玫瑰；蔷薇；v. 上升；增加（rise过去式）
example1_en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
example1_zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。
example2_en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
example2_zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗糙的；不平的；adj. 粗略的；大致的；adj. 艰难的；动荡的；猛烈的
example1_en: The rough wooden bench scratched my bare legs.
example1_zh: 粗糙的木长凳刮到了我裸露的小腿。
example2_en: A rough estimate of construction costs can help local authorities decide whether a housing project is affordable.
example2_zh: 粗略估算建筑成本有助于地方政府判断是否负担得起某个住房项目。

meanings_zh: adj. 圆形的；球形的；n. 一轮；一回合；prep. 围绕；绕过
example1_en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。
example2_en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。

meanings_zh: n. 惯例；日常安排；adj. 例行的；常规的；n. 一套表演动作
example1_en: A short walk is part of my morning routine.
example1_zh: 短距离散步是我每天早晨的固定安排之一。
example2_en: Maintaining a regular sleep routine can improve concentration and help students cope with academic pressure.
example2_zh: 保持规律的睡眠作息能提高注意力，帮助学生应对学业压力。

meanings_zh: n. 探测车；漫游者
example1_en: The rover sent pictures from Mars.
example1_zh: 探测车从火星发回了照片。
example2_en: A space rover can travel across rough ground.
example2_zh: 太空探测车可以穿越崎岖地面。

meanings_zh: abbr. 请回复（请确认是否参加）
example1_en: Please RSVP before Friday.
example1_zh: 请在星期五之前回复是否参加。
example2_en: The invitation asks guests to RSVP by email.
example2_zh: 邀请函请客人通过电子邮件确认是否参加。

meanings_zh: v. 擦；揉；摩擦；n. 擦；揉
example1_en: She rubbed her cold hands together beside the heater.
example1_zh: 她在暖气旁搓着冰冷的双手。
example2_en: Protective gloves prevent workers from rubbing their skin against rough surfaces when handling heavy materials.
example2_zh: 搬运重物时，防护手套可以避免工人的皮肤与粗糙表面摩擦。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾；废物；n. 废话；胡说
example1_en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
example1_zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。
example2_en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
example2_zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗鲁的；无礼的
example1_en: It was rude to interrupt her during dinner.
example1_zh: 吃晚饭时打断她说话很不礼貌。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how to disagree respectfully without making rude comments about others.
example2_zh: 学校应该教孩子如何礼貌地表达不同意见，而不是对他人出言不逊。

meanings_zh: n. 规则；规定；n. 统治；管辖；v. 统治；裁定
example1_en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
example1_zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。
example2_en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
example2_zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 尺子；直尺；n. 统治者
example1_en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line here.
example1_zh: 用尺子在这里画一条直线。
example2_en: The decisions of ancient rulers often influenced trade, architecture, and the daily lives of ordinary people.
example2_zh: 古代统治者的决策往往影响贸易、建筑以及普通人的日常生活。

meanings_zh: v. 跑；奔跑；v. 经营；管理；v. 运转；运行
example1_en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
example1_zh: 今天早饭前，我们跑步穿过了公园。
example2_en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
example2_zh: 地方议会经常开办培训项目，帮助失业居民培养雇主所需的技能。

meanings_zh: n. 跑步者；赛跑选手
example1_en: A runner in bright shoes passed us by the lake.
example1_zh: 一位穿着亮色鞋子的跑步者在湖边从我们身旁跑过。
example2_en: Urban parks provide runners with safer exercise spaces away from heavy traffic and polluted main roads.
example2_zh: 城市公园为跑步者提供更安全的锻炼空间，远离繁忙交通和污染严重的主干道。

meanings_zh: v. 赶紧；匆忙做；n. 匆忙；繁忙时段；n. 一阵强烈感受
example1_en: I rushed downstairs when I heard the doorbell.
example1_zh: 听到门铃声，我赶紧跑下了楼。
example2_en: Governments should not rush major transport projects without first assessing their environmental and financial impacts.
example2_zh: 政府不应在评估环境和财务影响之前仓促推进重大交通项目。

meanings_zh: adj. 俄罗斯的；俄语的；n. 俄罗斯人；n. 俄语
example1_en: We cooked Russian dumplings for dinner last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我们做了俄式饺子当晚餐。
example2_en: Studying Russian literature can help students explore how historical events influence cultural identity and artistic expression.
example2_zh: 学习俄罗斯文学可以帮助学生探究历史事件如何影响文化认同和艺术表达。

meanings_zh: adj. 难过的；悲伤的
example1_en: I felt sad when my friend moved away.
example1_zh: 朋友搬走时我感到难过。
example2_en: The sad ending made everyone quiet.
example2_zh: 悲伤的结局让大家安静下来。

meanings_zh: adv. 悲伤地；难过地；adv. 遗憾的是；不幸地
example1_en: He waved sadly as his best friend's train departed.
example1_zh: 最好的朋友乘坐的火车离站时，他难过地挥手告别。
example2_en: Sadly, many historic buildings have been demolished to make room for roads and commercial developments.
example2_zh: 遗憾的是，许多历史建筑已被拆除，为道路和商业开发腾出空间。

meanings_zh: adj. 安全的；无危险的；adj. 稳妥的；风险小的；n. 保险箱
example1_en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
example1_zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；保障；n. 保护措施；保障
example1_en: These padded covers safeguard the furniture during the move.
example1_zh: 这些加厚护套在搬家时保护家具。
example2_en: Governments should introduce stronger regulations to safeguard personal information collected by online services and mobile applications.
example2_zh: 政府应出台更严格的法规，保护在线服务和移动应用收集的个人信息。

meanings_zh: n. 安全；平安
example1_en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
example1_zh: 为了你自身的安全，请戴上头盔。
example2_en: Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.
example2_zh: 改善道路安全既需要更好的街道设计，也需要更严格地执行交通法规。

meanings_zh: n. 沙拉；凉拌菜
example1_en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
example1_zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。
example2_en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
example2_zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

meanings_zh: n. 出售；销售；n. 降价促销；n. 销售额；销量
example1_en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
example1_zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。
example2_en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
example2_zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

meanings_zh: n. 盐；食盐；v. 给……加盐；用盐腌
example1_en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
example1_zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。
example2_en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
example2_zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。

meanings_zh: adj. 相同的；同一个的；pron. 同样的事物
example1_en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。
example2_en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
example2_zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

meanings_zh: n. 沙；沙子；v. 用砂纸打磨
example1_en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
example1_zh: 孩子们用湿沙堆了一座城堡。
example2_en: Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.
example2_zh: 为建筑工程开采河床中的沙子可能破坏栖息地，并增加侵蚀风险。

meanings_zh: n. 三明治；v. 把……夹在中间
example1_en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
example1_zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。
example2_en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。

meanings_zh: adj. 多沙的；铺满沙的；adj. 沙色的；浅黄褐色的
example1_en: We left our shoes beside the sandy path.
example1_zh: 我们把鞋放在了沙地小路旁。
example2_en: Sandy soils often require careful irrigation because they retain less water than soils with more clay.
example2_zh: 沙质土壤通常需要精心灌溉，因为其保水能力弱于黏土含量较高的土壤。

meanings_zh: n. 人造卫星；n. 天然卫星
example1_en: The satellite sent back clear pictures of the storm.
example1_zh: 这颗卫星传回了风暴的清晰图像。
example2_en: Satellite observations allow scientists to monitor changes in forest cover across remote regions over time.
example2_zh: 卫星观测使科学家能够长期监测偏远地区森林覆盖的变化。

meanings_zh: n. 星期六
example1_en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。

meanings_zh: v. 挽救；救助；v. 节省；储蓄；v. 保存；保留
example1_en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
example1_zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

meanings_zh: n. 锯；锯子；v. 锯；锯开；v. 看见（see的过去式）
example1_en: He used a saw to cut the wooden shelf.
example1_zh: 他用锯子切割那块木制搁板。
example2_en: The last decade saw significant improvements in public transport, particularly in rapidly growing urban areas.
example2_zh: 过去十年，公共交通取得了显著改善，尤其是在快速发展的城市地区。

meanings_zh: v. 说；表达；v. 写着；表明；n. 发言权；决定权
example1_en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
example1_zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。
example2_en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
example2_zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。

meanings_zh: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的
example1_en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
example1_zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。
example2_en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
example2_zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。

meanings_zh: n. 围巾；头巾
example1_en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
example1_zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。
example2_en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
example2_zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。

meanings_zh: adj. 吓人的；令人害怕的
example1_en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
example1_zh: 那个吓人的声音只不过是树枝在碰窗户。
example2_en: Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.
example2_zh: 开始上学可能让年幼的孩子害怕，因此教师应营造友善的环境。

meanings_zh: n. 风景；景色；n. 舞台布景
example1_en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边停下来欣赏风景。
example2_en: Protecting natural scenery can attract responsible tourism while preserving valuable habitats for local wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护自然风景可以吸引负责任的旅游活动，同时为当地野生动物保留宝贵的栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 学校；上学；n. 学派；流派；n. 鱼群
example1_en: We walk to school together along the river.
example1_zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。
example2_en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
example2_zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。

meanings_zh: n. 书包
example1_en: My books are in my schoolbag.
example1_zh: 我的书在书包里。
example2_en: She packed her schoolbag before going to bed.
example2_zh: 她睡觉前整理好了书包。

meanings_zh: n. 科学；自然科学；n. 科学学科
example1_en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
example1_zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。
example2_en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
example2_zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。

meanings_zh: adj. 科学的；符合科学方法的
example1_en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
example1_zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。
example2_en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
example2_zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。

meanings_zh: n. 科学家
example1_en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
example1_zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。
example2_en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
example2_zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

meanings_zh: n. 剪刀
example1_en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
example1_zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。
example2_en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
example2_zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。

meanings_zh: n. 得分；分数；v. 得分；获得分数；n. 配乐；乐谱
example1_en: My score improved after a week of practice.
example1_zh: 练习一周后，我的分数提高了。
example2_en: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
example2_zh: 考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。

meanings_zh: n. 苏格兰
example1_en: We explored old castles during our holiday in Scotland.
example1_zh: 我们在苏格兰度假时游览了古老的城堡。
example2_en: Scotland attracts visitors with its dramatic landscapes, while rural communities benefit from spending on accommodation and local services.
example2_zh: 苏格兰以壮丽的风景吸引游客，而乡村社区则受益于游客在住宿和当地服务上的消费。

meanings_zh: v. 尖叫；尖声喊叫；n. 尖叫声
example1_en: The children screamed with excitement as the ride began.
example1_zh: 游乐设施一启动，孩子们就兴奋地尖叫起来。
example2_en: Residents complain that visitors scream late at night, disturbing sleep and reducing the neighbourhood's quality of life.
example2_zh: 居民抱怨游客深夜尖叫，扰人睡眠，降低了社区的生活质量。

meanings_zh: n. 屏幕；银幕；v. 筛查；审查；v. 放映；播出
example1_en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
example1_zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。
example2_en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
example2_zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。

meanings_zh: n. 海；海洋；n. 大量；一大片
example1_en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
example1_zh: 孩子们看着小船在海上航行。
example2_en: Plastic waste entering the sea threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human food supplies.
example2_zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生生物，并可能最终影响人类的食物供应。

meanings_zh: n. 季节；n. 旺季；赛季；活动期；v. 给……调味
example1_en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
example1_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。
example2_en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
example2_zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

meanings_zh: n. 座位；v. 使就座；容纳……就座；n. 议席；席位
example1_en: She saved me a seat near the front.
example1_zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。
example2_en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
example2_zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

meanings_zh: num. 第二；n. 秒；片刻；v. 附议；支持提议
example1_en: This is my second cup of tea today.
example1_zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。
example2_en: Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.
example2_zh: 学习第二语言可以拓宽职业机会，并帮助学生理解其他文化的观点。

meanings_zh: adv. 其次；第二
example1_en: Firstly, the flat is affordable; secondly, it has a balcony.
example1_zh: 首先，这套公寓租金实惠；其次，它还有阳台。
example2_en: Secondly, expanding public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 其次，扩大公共交通覆盖范围可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地获得就业机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 秘密的；保密的；n. 秘密；n. 秘诀；诀窍
example1_en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
example1_zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。
example2_en: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
example2_zh: 政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。

meanings_zh: n. 部分；章节；区域；n. 截面；切片；v. 划分；切成片
example1_en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
example1_zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。
example2_en: The final section of the report examines how urban design can encourage healthier lifestyles.
example2_zh: 报告的最后一部分探讨了城市设计如何促进更健康的生活方式。

meanings_zh: n. 安全；安全保障；n. 安保人员；保安工作；n. 稳定；保障
example1_en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
example1_zh: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。
example2_en: Organisations must strengthen data security to protect personal information as more services move online.
example2_zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。

meanings_zh: v. 看见；v. 理解；明白；v. 会见；探望
example1_en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
example1_zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。
example2_en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
example2_zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。

meanings_zh: n. 种子；v. 播种
example1_en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
example1_zh: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。
example2_en: Protecting seed diversity helps farmers adapt to changing climates and reduces the risk of widespread crop failure.
example2_zh: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。

meanings_zh: v. 似乎；看来
example1_en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
example1_zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。
example2_en: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
example2_zh: 尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。

meanings_zh: adv. 很少；不常
example1_en: We seldom eat out because we enjoy cooking together.
example1_zh: 我们很少外出吃饭，因为我们喜欢一起做饭。
example2_en: Rural communities seldom receive the same level of public transport investment as major urban centres.
example2_zh: 农村社区很少获得与主要城市中心同等水平的公共交通投资。

meanings_zh: adj. 自私的；只顾自己的
example1_en: It was selfish to take the whole cake.
example1_zh: 把整个蛋糕拿走太自私了。
example2_en: Selfish behaviour in shared housing can create tension and undermine trust among residents over time.
example2_zh: 合租住房中的自私行为会造成矛盾，并逐渐损害住户之间的信任。

meanings_zh: v. 卖；出售；v. 有销路；卖得；v. 使人接受；推销
example1_en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
example1_zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
example2_zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。

meanings_zh: v. 发送；寄送；v. 派遣；打发
example1_en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
example1_zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。
example2_en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
example2_zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。

meanings_zh: n. 感官；感觉能力；n. 感觉；意识；v. 察觉；感觉到
example1_en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
example1_zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。
example2_en: Community gardens can strengthen residents' sense of belonging by creating opportunities for regular social interaction.
example2_zh: 社区花园可以创造日常社交机会，从而增强居民的归属感。

meanings_zh: n. 句子；n. 刑罚；判决；v. 判刑；宣判
example1_en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
example1_zh: 老师让我们写一个关于秋天的句子。
example2_en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
example2_zh: 学会变化句子长度，可以帮助学生在学术文章中更清晰地表达复杂观点。

meanings_zh: n. 九月
example1_en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
example1_zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。
example2_en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
example2_zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。

meanings_zh: adj. 严重的；重大的；adj. 认真的；严肃的
example1_en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
example1_zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。
example2_en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。

meanings_zh: v. 端上；供应；接待；v. 为……服务；履行职责；v. 用作；起……作用
example1_en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
example1_zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。
example2_en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。

meanings_zh: n. 服务；公共服务；v. 检修；保养；n. 宗教仪式
example1_en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。
example2_en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
example2_zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。

meanings_zh: n. 一人份；一份食物；adj. 现任的；现役的
example1_en: Would you like another serving of soup before dessert?
example1_zh: 吃甜点前，你还想再来一份汤吗？
example2_en: Clear information about calories per serving can help consumers compare products and make more informed dietary choices.
example2_zh: 清楚标明每份食品的热量，有助于消费者比较产品，作出更明智的饮食选择。

meanings_zh: v. 放置；设置；确定；n. 一套；一组；adj. 固定的；事先确定的
example1_en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。
example2_en: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
example2_zh: 政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。

meanings_zh: num. 七
example1_en: There are seven days in a week.
example1_zh: 一周有七天。
example2_en: I get up at seven every morning.
example2_zh: 我每天早上七点起床。

meanings_zh: num. 十七
example1_en: My sister is seventeen and loves playing volleyball.
example1_zh: 我妹妹十七岁，喜欢打排球。
example2_en: The survey found that seventeen students preferred practical training to traditional classroom instruction.
example2_zh: 调查发现，十七名学生更喜欢实践培训，而非传统课堂教学。

meanings_zh: det. 几个；数个；pron. 几个；数个
example1_en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
example1_zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。
example2_en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
example2_zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 影子；阴影；v. 跟随观察；跟岗学习
example1_en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。
example2_en: Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.
example2_zh: 让学生跟随经验丰富的护士学习，有助于他们了解医疗职业的实际要求。

meanings_zh: v. 摇动；抖动；颤抖；v. 使震惊；动摇；n. 摇动；抖动
example1_en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
example1_zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。
example2_en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
example2_zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

meanings_zh: v. 要不要；好吗；v. 将会；必将；v. 必须；应当
example1_en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
example1_zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？
example2_en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
example2_zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。

meanings_zh: n. 形状；外形；v. 塑造；影响；v. 使成形
example1_en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
example1_zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。
example2_en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
example2_zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

meanings_zh: v. 分享；共用；分担；n. 一份；份额；n. 股份
example1_en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
example1_zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。
example2_en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
example2_zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

meanings_zh: pron. 她
example1_en: She reads in the library every day.
example1_zh: 她每天在图书馆读书。
example2_en: She is good at drawing animals.
example2_zh: 她擅长画动物。

meanings_zh: n. 绵羊
example1_en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
example1_zh: 几只绵羊正在农场附近的一棵树下休息。
example2_en: Keeping too many sheep on fragile grasslands can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 在脆弱的草地上饲养过多绵羊会破坏植被，增加水土流失的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 搁板；架子；n. 陆架；岩石凸台
example1_en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
example1_zh: 把干净杯子放在水槽上方的架子上。
example2_en: Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.
example2_zh: 把健康零食摆在与视线齐平的货架上，可能促使购物者选择更有营养的食品。

meanings_zh: n. 庇护；遮蔽；n. 避难所；遮蔽物；v. 躲避；庇护
example1_en: We found shelter under a bridge during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨中，我们躲到一座桥下避雨。
example2_en: Local authorities should provide temporary shelter for residents whose homes have been damaged by floods.
example2_zh: 地方政府应为房屋遭洪水损坏的居民提供临时住所。

meanings_zh: v. 发光；照耀；v. 擦亮；n. 光泽；光亮
example1_en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。
example2_en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。

meanings_zh: n. 衬衫
example1_en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
example1_zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。
example2_en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
example2_zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

meanings_zh: n. 震惊；意外打击；v. 使震惊；n. 休克；电击
example1_en: The sudden rise in rent came as a shock.
example1_zh: 租金突然上涨，让人十分震惊。
example2_en: Moving abroad can cause culture shock, particularly when everyday customs differ greatly from those at home.
example2_zh: 移居国外可能带来文化冲击，尤其是当日常习俗与本国差异很大时。

meanings_zh: adj. 震惊的；惊愕的；adj. 愤慨的；十分反感的
example1_en: I was shocked to find water flooding the kitchen.
example1_zh: 发现厨房里到处是水，我惊呆了。
example2_en: Residents were shocked by the sudden closure of the only hospital serving their rural community.
example2_zh: 当地居民对唯一服务于他们乡村社区的医院突然关闭感到震惊。

meanings_zh: n. 鞋
example1_en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
example1_zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。
example2_en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
example2_zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。

meanings_zh: v. 射击；射中；v. 拍摄；n. 嫩芽；新枝
example1_en: She learned to shoot arrows at a local club.
example1_zh: 她在当地一家俱乐部学会了射箭。
example2_en: Film crews often shoot documentaries in remote locations to highlight the effects of climate change.
example2_zh: 摄制组常在偏远地区拍摄纪录片，以突出气候变化的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 商店；店铺；v. 购物
example1_en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
example2_zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。

meanings_zh: adj. 短的；短暂的；矮的；adj. 不足的；短缺的；adv. 未达到；突然停止
example1_en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。
example2_en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
example2_zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。

meanings_zh: adj. 短期的
example1_en: This short-term job will cover my summer expenses.
example1_zh: 这份短期工作能支付我暑假期间的开销。
example2_en: Short-term solutions may reduce immediate pressure but fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
example2_zh: 短期措施或许能缓解眼前的压力，却无法解决失业的根本原因。

meanings_zh: n. 短缺；不足
example1_en: A water shortage forced us to take shorter showers.
example1_zh: 缺水迫使我们缩短淋浴时间。
example2_en: A shortage of affordable housing can force essential workers to live far from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 可负担住房短缺可能迫使关键岗位的工作人员住在远离工作地点的地方。

meanings_zh: n. 短裤
example1_en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
example1_zh: 我为这次海滨度假打包了短裤和凉鞋。
example2_en: In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.
example2_zh: 天气炎热时，轻薄的短裤能帮助人们在户外锻炼时保持舒适。

meanings_zh: v. 应该；应当；v. 按理会；应该会；v. 本应该
example1_en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
example1_zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。
example2_en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

meanings_zh: n. 肩；肩膀；v. 承担；肩负
example1_en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
example1_zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。
example2_en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
example2_zh: 政府和企业必须承担更大的责任，减少工业生产对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: v. 喊叫；大声说；n. 喊声；呼喊
example1_en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
example1_zh: 我们朝河对岸大喊，却没有人听见。
example2_en: In noisy classrooms, teachers may need to shout, which can strain their voices over time.
example2_zh: 在嘈杂的教室里，教师可能需要大声说话，长期如此会损伤嗓音。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；给……看；v. 表明；证明；n. 演出；节目；展览
example1_en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
example1_zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。
example2_en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
example2_zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 淋浴；淋浴器；n. 阵雨；v. 淋浴
example1_en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
example1_zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。
example2_en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
example2_zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。

meanings_zh: v. 关闭；关上；停业；adj. 关闭的；不营业的
example1_en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
example1_zh: 请在雨飘进来之前把窗户关上。
example2_en: When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.
example2_zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民便失去了宝贵的免费学习资源和共享社区空间。

meanings_zh: adj. 害羞的；腼腆的；v. 因受惊而退缩
example1_en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
example1_zh: 莉娜刚加入这个新社团时有些害羞。
example2_en: Small group discussions can help shy students gain confidence before speaking in front of the whole class.
example2_zh: 小组讨论可以帮助害羞的学生建立信心，为在全班面前发言做准备。

meanings_zh: adj. 生病的；不舒服的；adj. 恶心的；想吐的；adj. 厌烦的；受够了的
example1_en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
example1_zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。
example2_en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
example2_zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。

meanings_zh: n. 侧面；边；旁边；n. 方面；一方；v. 支持；站在某方
example1_en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
example1_zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。
example2_en: Public debates should consider both sides of an issue before any major policy decision is made.
example2_zh: 在作出任何重大政策决定之前，公共讨论都应考虑问题的正反两面。

meanings_zh: n. 视力；视觉；n. 看见；视野；n. 景象；名胜
example1_en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
example1_zh: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。
example2_en: Regular eye examinations can help preserve sight by detecting problems before they cause permanent damage.
example2_zh: 定期眼部检查能在问题造成永久损伤前将其发现，从而帮助保护视力。

meanings_zh: n. 迹象；征兆；n. 标牌；符号；手势；v. 签名；签署
example1_en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
example1_zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。
example2_en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
example2_zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。

meanings_zh: n. 蚕丝；丝绸
example1_en: She wrapped a soft silk scarf around her neck.
example1_zh: 她把一条柔软的丝巾围在脖子上。
example2_en: Traditional silk production provides employment in rural communities while preserving skills passed down through generations.
example2_zh: 传统丝绸生产为农村社区提供就业机会，同时保留了代代相传的技艺。

meanings_zh: adj. 愚蠢的；不明智的；adj. 滑稽的；逗趣的
example1_en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
example1_zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。
example2_en: Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
example2_zh: 教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。

meanings_zh: n. 银；adj. 银色的；银制的；n. 银牌
example1_en: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
example1_zh: 这把小勺子是纯银做的。
example2_en: Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.
example2_zh: 银的导电性能极佳，因此被广泛用于电子设备。

meanings_zh: adj. 相似的；类似的
example1_en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
example1_zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。
example2_en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
example2_zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。

meanings_zh: n. 相似；相似点
example1_en: The similarity between these two jackets surprised me.
example1_zh: 这两件夹克如此相似，让我很惊讶。
example2_en: Despite their geographical distance, the two regions show striking similarities in traditional farming methods.
example2_zh: 尽管地理位置相距遥远，这两个地区的传统耕作方式却有着惊人的相似之处。

meanings_zh: adj. 简单的；容易的；adj. 朴素的；不加修饰的
example1_en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
example1_zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。
example2_en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
example2_zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

meanings_zh: adv. 仅仅；只不过；adv. 简单地；朴素地；adv. 简直；实在
example1_en: I simply want a quiet evening at home.
example1_zh: 我只想在家安安静静地过个晚上。
example2_en: Improving public health requires more than simply encouraging individuals to exercise; affordable facilities are also essential.
example2_zh: 改善公共健康不仅仅需要鼓励个人锻炼；价格亲民的设施也必不可少。

meanings_zh: prep. 自……以来；conj. 自……以来；因为；adv. 此后；从那时起
example1_en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
example1_zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。
example2_en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
example2_zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。

meanings_zh: adj. 真诚的；诚挚的
example1_en: Her sincere apology helped us become friends again.
example1_zh: 她真诚的道歉让我们重新成为了朋友。
example2_en: Sincere efforts to consult local residents can strengthen public trust in major urban development projects.
example2_zh: 真诚征求当地居民意见的努力，可以增强公众对重大城市开发项目的信任。

meanings_zh: adv. 真诚地；由衷地
example1_en: I sincerely hope you feel better very soon.
example1_zh: 我由衷地希望你很快好起来。
example2_en: Organisations should listen sincerely to residents' concerns before introducing changes that affect the local community.
example2_zh: 机构在推行影响当地社区的变革之前，应真诚倾听居民的关切。

meanings_zh: v. 唱；唱歌；v. 鸟鸣；鸣啭
example1_en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。
example2_en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
example2_zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。

meanings_zh: n. 歌手；歌唱家
example1_en: The singer smiled as the audience began to clap.
example1_zh: 观众开始鼓掌时，歌手露出了笑容。
example2_en: Local festivals provide young singers with valuable opportunities to perform publicly and develop confidence in their abilities.
example2_zh: 当地节庆为年轻歌手提供了宝贵的公开演出机会，帮助他们建立对自身能力的信心。

meanings_zh: adj. 单个的；仅一个的；adj. 单身的；未婚的；adj. 单程的
example1_en: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
example1_zh: 停电时，房间里只有一支蜡烛照明。
example2_en: No single policy can solve urban congestion without improvements to public transport and local planning.
example2_zh: 如果不改善公共交通和地方规划，任何单一政策都无法解决城市拥堵。

meanings_zh: n. 先生；老师（尊称）；n. 爵士（姓名前的头衔）
example1_en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
example1_zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。
example2_en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
example2_zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。

meanings_zh: n. 姐姐；妹妹；n. 修女
example1_en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
example1_zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。
example2_en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
example2_zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

meanings_zh: n. 情况；形势；处境
example1_en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
example1_zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。
example2_en: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
example2_zh: 对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。

meanings_zh: num. 六
example1_en: Six students are in the reading group.
example1_zh: 阅读小组里有六名学生。
example2_en: The shop closes at six o'clock.
example2_zh: 商店六点关门。

meanings_zh: num. 十六
example1_en: We baked sixteen small cakes for the family picnic.
example1_zh: 我们为家庭野餐烤了十六个小蛋糕。
example2_en: In some countries, students can choose vocational training instead of continuing general education at the age of sixteen.
example2_zh: 在一些国家，学生十六岁时可以选择职业培训，而不继续接受普通教育。

meanings_zh: n. 大小；规模；n. 尺码；号；v. 按大小分类；确定尺寸
example1_en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。
example2_en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。

meanings_zh: v. 滑冰；滑旱冰；n. 冰鞋；旱冰鞋
example1_en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
example1_zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。
example2_en: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
example2_zh: 供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板；v. 玩滑板；滑行
example1_en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
example1_zh: 开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。
example2_en: Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
example2_zh: 为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板运动
example1_en: We went skateboarding at the park after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们去公园玩滑板了。
example2_en: Dedicated skateboarding facilities give young people safe spaces to exercise and develop their balance and coordination.
example2_zh: 专用滑板设施为年轻人提供了安全的锻炼空间，帮助他们提高平衡感和协调能力。

meanings_zh: v. 滑雪；n. 滑雪板
example1_en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
example1_zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。
example2_en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
example2_zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

meanings_zh: n. 技能；技巧；本领
example1_en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
example1_zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。
example2_en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
example2_zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

meanings_zh: n. 裙子；v. 沿边缘走；绕过；v. 回避
example1_en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
example1_zh: 她上楼时，蓝色裙子轻轻摆动。
example2_en: Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.
example2_zh: 公共讨论往往回避谁应承担环保费用这一问题。

meanings_zh: n. 天空
example1_en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
example1_zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。
example2_en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
example2_zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。

meanings_zh: v. 睡觉；n. 睡眠
example1_en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
example1_zh: 我们的猫喜欢睡在温暖的暖气片旁边。
example2_en: Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.
example2_zh: 规律的睡眠有助于记忆和注意力，因此对备考学生尤其重要。

meanings_zh: adj. 困倦的；想睡的；adj. 安静冷清的
example1_en: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
example1_zh: 午饭后我觉得困，就小睡了一会儿。
example2_en: Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
example2_zh: 上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。

meanings_zh: n. 薄片；一片；v. 切成薄片；n. 一部分；份额
example1_en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
example1_zh: 她在我的茶里放了一片柠檬。
example2_en: Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.
example2_zh: 住房开支占据家庭收入的很大一部分，使许多家庭几乎没有钱用于休闲。

meanings_zh: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；adj. 微小的；渺茫的；v. 减肥；使缩减
example1_en: This slim lamp fits neatly on my small desk.
example1_zh: 这盏细长的灯放在我的小书桌上正合适。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, there is only a slim chance that commuters will stop driving.
example2_zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，通勤者放弃开车的可能性就很小。

meanings_zh: adj. 缓慢的；耗时的；v. 减速；使放慢；adj. 钟表走得慢的
example1_en: We took a slow walk along the river.
example1_zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。
example2_en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。

meanings_zh: adv. 缓慢地；慢慢地
example1_en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
example1_zh: 她慢慢地把热汤倒进碗里。
example2_en: Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.
example2_zh: 尽管公众观念改变得较慢，但越来越多的消费者正在选择塑料包装更少的产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 小的；少的；adj. 年幼的；adj. 不重要的；轻微的
example1_en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
example1_zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。
example2_en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
example2_zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

meanings_zh: adj. 聪明的；明智的；adj. 整洁时髦的；adj. 智能的
example1_en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
example1_zh: 用那个办法修好架子真聪明。
example2_en: Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.
example2_zh: 智能灌溉系统可根据土壤状况调节供水，从而减少水资源浪费。

meanings_zh: n. 气味；嗅觉；v. 闻到；嗅；v. 有……气味
example1_en: The smell of fresh bread filled our kitchen.
example1_zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在我们的厨房里。
example2_en: A reduced sense of smell can affect appetite and make it harder to detect spoiled food.
example2_zh: 嗅觉减退会影响食欲，也会让人更难察觉变质的食物。

meanings_zh: v. 微笑；n. 微笑；笑容
example1_en: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
example1_zh: 我在房间另一头挥手时，宝宝笑了。
example2_en: A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.
example2_zh: 友善的微笑能让患者在与医护人员讨论自己的顾虑时感到更自在。

meanings_zh: n. 烟；烟雾；v. 吸烟；v. 冒烟
example1_en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。
example2_en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
example2_zh: 森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。

meanings_zh: adj. 光滑的；平整的；adj. 顺利的；平稳的；v. 使平整；抚平
example1_en: This stone feels smooth and cool in my hand.
example1_zh: 这块石头握在手里又光滑又凉。
example2_en: Clear communication between departments is essential for a smooth transition to a new working system.
example2_zh: 部门之间清晰的沟通对于顺利过渡到新的工作制度至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 零食；小吃；v. 吃零食；吃点心
example1_en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
example1_zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 蛇；v. 蜿蜒延伸；曲折前行
example1_en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
example1_zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。
example2_en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
example2_zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

meanings_zh: n. 雪；积雪；v. 下雪
example1_en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
example1_zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。
example2_en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
example2_zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。

meanings_zh: n. 雪人
example1_en: We made a snowman after the snow.
example1_zh: 下雪后我们堆了一个雪人。
example2_en: The snowman has a carrot nose.
example2_zh: 这个雪人有一个胡萝卜鼻子。

meanings_zh: adj. 下雪的；多雪的；adj. 被雪覆盖的
example1_en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that snowy afternoon.
example1_zh: 那个下雪的下午，我们待在屋里烤面包。
example2_en: In snowy regions, reliable public transport requires regular road maintenance and vehicles designed for winter conditions.
example2_zh: 在多雪地区，可靠的公共交通需要定期道路养护和适合冬季路况的车辆。

meanings_zh: adv. 这么；如此；非常；conj. 所以；因此；adv. 这样；如此
example1_en: The soup was so hot that I had to wait.
example1_zh: 汤太烫了，我只好等一会儿。
example2_en: Public transport is limited in rural areas, so many residents rely on private cars for essential journeys.
example2_zh: 农村地区的公共交通有限，因此许多居民依靠私家车进行必要的出行。

meanings_zh: adj. 社会的；adj. 社交的；交际的；adj. 群居的
example1_en: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
example1_zh: 我的新工作让我几乎没时间参加社交活动。
example2_en: Affordable housing policies can reduce social inequality by helping families access safe homes near essential services.
example2_zh: 可负担住房政策帮助家庭在基本服务设施附近获得安全住所，从而减少社会不平等。

meanings_zh: n. 社会主义
example1_en: Our history teacher explained socialism during today's lively class discussion.
example1_zh: 在今天热烈的课堂讨论中，我们的历史老师讲解了社会主义。
example2_en: Debates about socialism often focus on public ownership, economic equality, and the appropriate role of government.
example2_zh: 关于社会主义的讨论往往聚焦于公有制、经济平等以及政府应发挥的作用。

meanings_zh: adj. 社会主义的；n. 社会主义者
example1_en: Our reading group discussed socialist ideas over tea.
example1_zh: 我们读书小组边喝茶边讨论社会主义思想。
example2_en: Socialist policies often seek to reduce economic inequality through public ownership and the redistribution of wealth.
example2_zh: 社会主义政策通常力图通过公有制和财富再分配来减少经济不平等。

meanings_zh: n. 社会；n. 协会；社团
example1_en: Everyone has a part to play in society.
example1_zh: 每个人都能在社会中发挥作用。
example2_en: An ageing society requires accessible healthcare and policies that support older people's independence.
example2_zh: 老龄化社会需要便捷可及的医疗服务，以及支持老年人独立生活的政策。

meanings_zh: n. 短袜；袜子
example1_en: One blue sock was hiding under the bed.
example1_zh: 一只蓝袜子藏在床底下。
example2_en: Choosing durable socks made from recycled materials can help consumers reduce clothing waste over time.
example2_zh: 选择用再生材料制作的耐穿袜子，有助于消费者逐渐减少衣物浪费。

meanings_zh: adj. 柔软的；软的；adj. 轻柔的；柔和的；adj. 不严厉的；心软的
example1_en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example1_zh: 这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。
example2_en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
example2_zh: 柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。

meanings_zh: n. 土壤；v. 弄脏
example1_en: She filled the pot with soil and planted seeds.
example1_zh: 她往花盆里填了土，然后种下种子。
example2_en: Intensive farming can damage soil quality, reducing the land's ability to support crops over time.
example2_zh: 集约化农业可能损害土壤质量，逐渐降低土地种植作物的能力。

meanings_zh: adj. 太阳的；adj. 利用太阳能的
example1_en: We wore special protective glasses to watch the solar eclipse.
example1_zh: 我们戴着专用防护眼镜观看日食。
example2_en: Investment in solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and create jobs in rural communities.
example2_zh: 投资太阳能可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并为农村社区创造就业机会。

meanings_zh: n. 士兵；军人
example1_en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
example1_zh: 那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。
example2_en: Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.
example2_zh: 重大自然灾害发生后，军人可以通过运送食物和救助居民来支援应急部门。

meanings_zh: v. 解决；解答
example1_en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。
example2_en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。

meanings_zh: det. 一些；若干；pron. 一些人；一些事物；adv. 大约
example1_en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
example1_zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。
example2_en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
example2_zh: 一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。

meanings_zh: pron. 某人；有人
example1_en: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
example1_zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。
example2_en: Students are more likely to seek help when they know somebody will listen without judging them.
example2_zh: 如果学生知道有人会倾听而不评判他们，就更有可能寻求帮助。

meanings_zh: pron. 某事；某物
example1_en: There is something soft inside this little box.
example1_zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。
example2_en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
example2_zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。

meanings_zh: adv. 有时；偶尔
example1_en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
example1_zh: 我有时会绕远路穿过公园回家。
example2_en: Working from home sometimes improves productivity, although its benefits depend on suitable equipment and a quiet environment.
example2_zh: 居家办公有时能提高效率，不过其益处取决于合适的设备和安静的环境。

meanings_zh: adv. 在某处；到某处；adv. 大约
example1_en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
example1_zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。
example2_en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。

meanings_zh: n. 儿子
example1_en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
example1_zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。
example2_en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
example2_zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。

meanings_zh: n. 歌曲
example1_en: We sang a happy song together.
example1_zh: 我们一起唱了一首欢快的歌。
example2_en: This song helps me remember the new words.
example2_zh: 这首歌帮助我记住新单词。

meanings_zh: adv. 不久；很快
example1_en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
example1_zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。
example2_en: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
example2_zh: 除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。

meanings_zh: adj. 疼痛的；酸痛的；n. 疮；溃疡；adj. 恼怒的；不快的
example1_en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
example1_zh: 昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。
example2_en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
example2_zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。

meanings_zh: adj. 抱歉的；后悔的；adj. 难过的；同情的
example1_en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
example1_zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁洒在了你的干净衬衫上。
example2_en: Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
example2_zh: 尽管企业可能对环境破坏表示歉意，但恢复公众信任需要切实行动。

meanings_zh: n. 种类；类型；v. 分类；整理；排序；v. 处理妥当；解决
example1_en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
example1_zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？
example2_en: Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
example2_zh: 家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。

meanings_zh: n. 灵魂；心灵；n. 人；n. 灵魂乐
example1_en: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
example1_zh: 在海边散步似乎总能抚慰我的心灵。
example2_en: Many cultural traditions view the soul as something that continues to exist after the body dies.
example2_zh: 许多文化传统认为，灵魂在肉体死亡后仍然存在。

meanings_zh: n. 声音；声响；v. 听起来；发出声音；adj. 合理的；可靠的；完好的
example1_en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
example1_zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。
example2_en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
example2_zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。

meanings_zh: n. 汤；羹
example1_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
example1_zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
example2_en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
example2_zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。

meanings_zh: adj. 酸的；酸味的；adj. 酸腐的；变质的；v. 变坏；使恶化
example1_en: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
example1_zh: 这些葡萄对我来说太酸了。
example2_en: Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
example2_zh: 共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。

meanings_zh: n. 南；南方；adj. 南部的；朝南的；adv. 向南；在南方
example1_en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。
example2_en: Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
example2_zh: 许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。

meanings_zh: adj. 南部的；南方的
example1_en: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
example1_zh: 我们花了一周探索这座岛的南部海岸。
example2_en: Southern regions of the country may face longer droughts as rising temperatures increase pressure on water supplies.
example2_zh: 随着气温升高加大供水压力，该国南部地区可能面临更持久的干旱。

meanings_zh: n. 空间；空地；间隔；n. 太空；v. 使隔开；留间隔
example1_en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
example1_zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。
example2_en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
example2_zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

meanings_zh: n. 航天器；宇宙飞船
example1_en: We watched the spacecraft launch from our garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里观看了航天器发射。
example2_en: Unmanned spacecraft allow scientists to explore distant planets without putting human lives at risk.
example2_zh: 无人航天器让科学家能够探索遥远的行星，而不危及人的生命。

meanings_zh: n. 宇宙飞船
example1_en: The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
example1_zh: 孩子们用纸板箱做了一艘宇宙飞船。
example2_en: Designing a spaceship for long journeys requires careful planning to protect astronauts from radiation and isolation.
example2_zh: 设计用于长途航行的宇宙飞船需要周密规划，以保护宇航员免受辐射和孤独的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 意大利细长面条
example1_en: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork before taking a bite.
example1_zh: 她先用叉子卷起意大利细面，再吃了一口。
example2_en: Simple meals such as spaghetti with vegetables can help students eat affordably while maintaining a balanced diet.
example2_zh: 蔬菜意大利面等简单餐食，可以帮助学生在节省开支的同时保持均衡饮食。

meanings_zh: n. 西班牙
example1_en: We travelled around Spain by train last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了西班牙。
example2_en: Spain attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed tourism infrastructure.
example2_zh: 西班牙凭借文化遗产、多样的景观和完善的旅游基础设施吸引国际游客。

meanings_zh: n. 西班牙语；adj. 西班牙的；西班牙语的
example1_en: I practise Spanish with my neighbour after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后我和邻居一起练习西班牙语。
example2_en: Learning Spanish can broaden students' access to literature and improve their opportunities for international employment.
example2_zh: 学习西班牙语能拓宽学生接触文学作品的渠道，并增加他们在国际就业市场上的机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 备用的；空闲的；v. 抽出；分出；v. 使免遭；饶恕
example1_en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
example1_zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。
example2_en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
example2_zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。

meanings_zh: v. 说话；交谈；v. 会说；使用某种语言；v. 发言；演讲
example1_en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
example1_zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？
example2_en: Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
example2_zh: 会说多种语言的学生可能更容易进行跨文化交流。

meanings_zh: n. 演讲者；发言者；n. 说某种语言的人；n. 扬声器；音箱
example1_en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
example1_zh: 演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。
example2_en: Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
example2_zh: 邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。

meanings_zh: adj. 特别的；特殊的；adj. 专门的；专用的；n. 特价品；特色菜
example1_en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
example1_zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。
example2_en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
example2_zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。

meanings_zh: n. 演讲；发言；n. 说话能力；言语
example1_en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
example1_zh: 莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。
example2_en: In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.
example2_zh: 研究人员在演讲中解释了接触绿地如何改善儿童的心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 速度；速率；v. 快速移动；疾驰；v. 超速驾驶
example1_en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
example1_zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。
example2_en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
example2_zh: 降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。

meanings_zh: v. 拼写；n. 一段时间；n. 咒语；魔法
example1_en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
example1_zh: 请你把姓氏慢慢拼给我听，好吗？
example2_en: A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
example2_zh: 持续的干旱天气会降低农作物产量，并加大当地供水压力。

meanings_zh: v. 花费钱；v. 度过；花费时间
example1_en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
example1_zh: 我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。
example2_en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
example2_zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。

meanings_zh: n. 精神；意志；气概；n. 灵魂；幽灵；n. 烈酒
example1_en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
example1_zh: 即使输了比赛，我们队仍展现出昂扬的斗志。
example2_en: Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 社区项目能够增强合作精神，并鼓励居民为自己的社区感到自豪。

meanings_zh: n. 匙；勺子；v. 用勺舀
example1_en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
example1_zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。
example2_en: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
example2_zh: 教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。

meanings_zh: n. 体育运动；v. 显眼地穿戴；展示
example1_en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
example1_zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。
example2_en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
example2_zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。

meanings_zh: v. 传播；蔓延；v. 展开；摊开；涂抹；n. 传播；扩散
example1_en: She spread a blanket under the tree for our picnic.
example1_zh: 她在树下铺了一条毯子，供我们野餐用。
example2_en: The rapid spread of false information online highlights the importance of teaching critical reading skills in schools.
example2_zh: 虚假信息在网上迅速传播，凸显了学校教授批判性阅读技能的重要性。

meanings_zh: n. 春天；春季；n. 弹簧；发条；n. 泉；泉水
example1_en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
example1_zh: 我们每年春天都在花园里种花。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.
example2_zh: 春季气温升高会使植物提前开花，影响依赖这些植物的昆虫。

meanings_zh: n. 正方形；n. 广场；adj. 正方形的；平方的
example1_en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
example1_zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。
example2_en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。

meanings_zh: n. 松鼠；v. 储藏；积攒
example1_en: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
example1_zh: 一只松鼠在我们花园门旁埋了一颗坚果。
example2_en: Urban parks provide squirrels with food and shelter, although feeding them can alter their natural behaviour.
example2_zh: 城市公园为松鼠提供食物和栖身之所，但投喂可能改变它们的自然行为。
