meanings_zh: adj. 稳定的；稳固的；n. 马厩
example1_en: The table feels stable now that we tightened its legs.
example1_zh: 我们把桌腿拧紧后，桌子现在感觉稳固了。
example2_en: A stable income allows families to plan for future expenses and reduces their dependence on emergency financial assistance.
example2_zh: 稳定的收入让家庭能够规划未来开支，并减少对紧急经济援助的依赖。

meanings_zh: n. 体育场
example1_en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
example1_zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。
example2_en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
example2_zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。

meanings_zh: n. 阶段；时期；n. 舞台；v. 上演；举办；组织
example1_en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
example1_zh: 制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。
example2_en: Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
example2_zh: 在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。

meanings_zh: n. 邮票；n. 印章；印记；v. 盖章；跺脚
example1_en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
example1_zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。
example2_en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。

meanings_zh: n. 标准；水准；adj. 标准的；通常的
example1_en: The food here is always of a high standard.
example1_zh: 这里的食物品质一向很高。
example2_en: Governments should enforce strict safety standards to ensure that new housing protects residents from avoidable risks.
example2_zh: 政府应严格执行安全标准，确保新建住房保护居民免受可避免的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 星；恒星；n. 明星；杰出人物；v. 主演；由…主演
example1_en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。
example2_en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
example2_zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

meanings_zh: v. 开始；着手；v. 启动；发动；n. 开始；起点
example1_en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
example1_zh: 我们一到家就开始做晚饭。
example2_en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
example2_zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。

meanings_zh: n. 状态；状况；n. 国家；州；政府；v. 陈述；明确说明
example1_en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，厨房一片狼藉。
example2_en: The report states that reliable public transport is essential for reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 报告指出，可靠的公共交通对于减少对私家车的依赖至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 车站；n. 工作站；台；所；v. 派驻；安置
example1_en: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
example1_zh: 我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。
example2_en: Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 地方政府应在繁忙的交通枢纽安排受过培训的工作人员，帮助行动不便的乘客。

meanings_zh: v. 停留；暂住；v. 保持某种状态；n. 停留；暂住期间
example1_en: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆里。
example2_en: Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
example2_zh: 比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。

meanings_zh: v. 偷窃；盗用；v. 偷偷移动；n. 极便宜的东西
example1_en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
example1_zh: 我买面包的时候，有人偷走了我的自行车。
example2_en: Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
example2_zh: 企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。

meanings_zh: n. 茎；梗；v. 源于；由…造成；v. 遏制；阻止
example1_en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
example1_zh: 她先修剪了玫瑰的花茎，再给花瓶加水。
example2_en: Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.
example2_zh: 许多城市交通问题源于规划不善，而不只是道路空间不足。

meanings_zh: n. 一步；台阶；n. 步骤；措施；v. 迈步；踏；踩
example1_en: Take one step forward and close the door.
example1_zh: 向前迈一步，把门关上。
example2_en: Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。

meanings_zh: n. 棍；枝条；手杖；v. 粘贴；粘住；v. 插入；刺入
example1_en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
example1_zh: 那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。
example2_en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。

meanings_zh: adj. 黏的；有黏性的；adj. 湿热的；闷热的；adj. 棘手的；难处理的
example1_en: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
example1_zh: 吃完蜂蜜蛋糕后，我的手指黏糊糊的。
example2_en: Food packaging often contains sticky residues that must be removed before the materials can be recycled effectively.
example2_zh: 食品包装上常有黏性残留物，必须先清除才能有效回收材料。

meanings_zh: adv. 仍然；还；adj. 静止的；不动的；adv. 尽管如此；不过
example1_en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
example1_zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。
example2_en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

meanings_zh: n. 胃；腹部；v. 忍受；容忍
example1_en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。
example2_en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
example2_zh: 规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 石头；石料；n. 结石；n. 果核
example1_en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
example1_zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。
example2_en: Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
example2_zh: 使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。

meanings_zh: n. 商店；v. 储存；贮藏；n. 储备；储存物
example1_en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
example2_zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。

meanings_zh: n. 暴风雨；风暴；v. 怒气冲冲地走；n. 风波；强烈反响
example1_en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
example1_zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
example2_en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
example2_zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。

meanings_zh: adj. 有暴风雨的；adj. 充满争吵的；激烈的
example1_en: We stayed indoors because the weather was so stormy.
example1_zh: 因为外面风雨交加，我们待在了室内。
example2_en: Increasingly stormy conditions may disrupt shipping routes and threaten the livelihoods of people in coastal communities.
example2_zh: 日益频繁的暴风雨天气可能扰乱航运路线，并威胁沿海社区居民的生计。

meanings_zh: n. 故事；经历的叙述；n. 新闻报道；n. 楼层（美式）
example1_en: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
example1_zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个她童年的趣事。
example2_en: Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.
example2_zh: 分享个人经历可以帮助学生从更有人情味的角度理解历史事件。

meanings_zh: adj. 直的；笔直的；adv. 径直；直接；adj. 坦诚的；直率的
example1_en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
example1_zh: 用尺子画一条直线。
example2_en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
example2_zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

meanings_zh: adj. 简单易懂的；易做的；adj. 坦率的；直截了当的
example1_en: The recipe is straightforward, even for a beginner.
example1_zh: 这道食谱很简单，即使初学者也能照着做。
example2_en: Governments should make recycling procedures straightforward so that more households can participate without unnecessary confusion.
example2_zh: 政府应简化回收流程，让更多家庭能够参与，避免不必要的困惑。

meanings_zh: adj. 奇怪的；反常的；adj. 陌生的；不熟悉的
example1_en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
example1_zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。
example2_en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
example2_zh: 在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。

meanings_zh: n. 陌生人；n. 初到某地的人；外来者
example1_en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
example1_zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。
example2_en: Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。

meanings_zh: n. 策略；战略
example1_en: Our strategy was to save a little every week.
example1_zh: 我们的策略是每周存一点钱。
example2_en: An effective transport strategy should improve public services while reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 有效的交通策略应在改善公共服务的同时减少对私家车的依赖。

meanings_zh: n. 草莓
example1_en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
example1_zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。
example2_en: Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
example2_zh: 在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。

meanings_zh: n. 力气；力量；n. 长处；优势；n. 强度；坚固程度
example1_en: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
example1_zh: 我使出全身力气才提起那个手提箱。
example2_en: Schools should help students identify their strengths rather than judge everyone solely through written examinations.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生发现自己的长处，而不是仅凭笔试评判所有人。

meanings_zh: n. 精神压力；紧张；v. 强调；n. 重音
example1_en: A short walk helps me deal with work stress.
example1_zh: 散一小会儿步有助于我缓解工作压力。
example2_en: Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.
example2_zh: 学校应教给学生实用的方法，帮助他们应对考试及其他紧张时期的压力。

meanings_zh: adj. 严格的；严厉的；adj. 严谨的；严格限定的
example1_en: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
example1_zh: 我们的教练对准时到场要求很严格。
example2_en: Strict environmental regulations can encourage manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies and reduce harmful industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 严格的环境法规可以促使制造商采用更清洁的技术，减少有害工业排放。

meanings_zh: n. 中风；n. 划动；击打；一笔；v. 轻抚
example1_en: The cat purred while I stroked its soft fur.
example1_zh: 我轻抚猫咪柔软的毛，它发出了呼噜声。
example2_en: Recognising the early symptoms of a stroke can help patients receive treatment before serious brain damage occurs.
example2_zh: 识别中风的早期症状，有助于患者在出现严重脑损伤前接受治疗。

meanings_zh: adj. 强壮的；有力的；adj. 牢固的；结实的；adj. 强烈的；充分的
example1_en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
example1_zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。
example2_en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
example2_zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

meanings_zh: n. 学生
example1_en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
example1_zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。
example2_en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
example2_zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；研究；n. 学习；研究；n. 书房
example1_en: I study English on the bus every morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。
example2_en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
example2_zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。

meanings_zh: n. 风格；方式；n. 款式；时尚；v. 设计造型
example1_en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
example1_zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。
example2_en: Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
example2_zh: 现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。

meanings_zh: n. 话题；主题；学科；adj. 受……影响的；取决于；v. 使遭受；使经历
example1_en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
example1_zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。
example2_en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
example2_zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。

meanings_zh: n. 地铁（美式）；n. 地下人行通道（英式）
example1_en: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午我们乘地铁去了博物馆。
example2_en: Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.
example2_zh: 扩建地铁网络可以缓解交通拥堵，前提是当地居民能够负担票价并方便地使用服务。

meanings_zh: v. 成功；达成目标；v. 接替；继任
example1_en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
example1_zh: 尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。
example2_en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
example2_zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。

meanings_zh: adj. 成功的；有成效的；adj. 事业有成的
example1_en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
example1_zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。
example2_en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
example2_zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。

meanings_zh: det. 这样的；这类的；det. 如此的；这么的
example1_en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
example1_zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。
example2_en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
example2_zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。

meanings_zh: adj. 突然的；意外的
example1_en: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
example1_zh: 一阵突如其来的风把我的帽子吹进了池塘。
example2_en: A sudden rise in food prices can place considerable pressure on families with low incomes.
example2_zh: 食品价格突然上涨会给低收入家庭带来相当大的压力。

meanings_zh: adv. 突然；忽然
example1_en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
example1_zh: 我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。
example2_en: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
example2_zh: 当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。

meanings_zh: v. 受苦；患病；v. 遭受；受损
example1_en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
example1_zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。
example2_en: Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
example2_zh: 大型道路施工导致顾客无法到店时，小企业往往会遭受经济损失。

meanings_zh: n. 糖；食糖
example1_en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
example1_zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。
example2_en: Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
example2_zh: 减少糖的摄入有助于预防与不健康饮食有关的健康问题。

meanings_zh: v. 建议；提议；v. 表明；暗示
example1_en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
example1_zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
example2_zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 建议；提议；n. 暗示；细微迹象
example1_en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
example1_zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。
example2_en: The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.
example2_zh: 扩建自行车道的建议得到了关注道路安全的居民的大力支持。

meanings_zh: v. 适合；合心意；v. 使显得好看；相配；n. 一套西装；套装
example1_en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
example1_zh: 明天把预约时间提前一点会更适合你吗？
example2_en: Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间适合需要兼顾工作职责与家庭责任的员工。

meanings_zh: adj. 合适的；适宜的
example1_en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
example1_zh: 这双步行鞋适合走泥泞的林间小路。
example2_en: Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.
example2_zh: 城市应为老年居民提供合适的住房，方便他们就医和乘坐公共交通。

meanings_zh: v. 概括；总结
example1_en: Could you summarize the story before we discuss it?
example1_zh: 我们讨论之前，你能概括一下这个故事吗？
example2_en: Students should learn to summarize research findings accurately rather than reproduce every detail from their sources.
example2_zh: 学生应学会准确概括研究结果，而不是复述资料中的每个细节。

meanings_zh: n. 夏天；夏季
example1_en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
example1_zh: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。
example2_en: Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
example2_zh: 夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。

meanings_zh: n. 太阳；n. 阳光；v. 晒太阳
example1_en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
example1_zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。
example2_en: Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
example2_zh: 在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。

meanings_zh: n. 星期日；周日
example1_en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
example1_zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。
example2_en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

meanings_zh: n. 太阳镜；墨镜
example1_en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。
example2_en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 阳光；日光
example1_en: Warm sunlight streamed through the window onto my desk.
example1_zh: 温暖的阳光透过窗户洒在我的书桌上。
example2_en: Designing classrooms to receive more natural sunlight may improve students' comfort and reduce electricity use.
example2_zh: 让教室获得更多自然光的设计可能提高学生的舒适度，并减少用电。

meanings_zh: adj. 阳光充足的；晴朗的；adj. 开朗的；乐观的
example1_en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。
example2_en: Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
example2_zh: 阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。

meanings_zh: n. 日出；日出时分
example1_en: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
example1_zh: 我们早早醒来，观看湖上的日出。
example2_en: Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.
example2_zh: 安排在日出前后的户外活动让游客能在较凉爽的气温下观赏当地野生动物。

meanings_zh: n. 日落；日落时分；n. 落日景象；晚霞
example1_en: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在日落前刚好赶到了海滩。
example2_en: Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.
example2_zh: 沿海目的地常以壮丽的落日景色吸引游客，为当地企业创造宝贵商机。

meanings_zh: n. 阳光；n. 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
example1_en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。
example2_en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；棒极了的；adv. 非常；特别
example1_en: We had a super afternoon playing games in the garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里玩游戏，度过了一个特别愉快的下午。
example2_en: Although users may describe an app as super helpful, researchers need objective evidence to assess its educational value.
example2_zh: 尽管用户可能形容某款应用特别有帮助，研究人员仍需客观证据来评估其教育价值。

meanings_zh: n. 超级市场；超市
example1_en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
example1_zh: 我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。
example2_en: Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
example2_zh: 大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。

meanings_zh: v. 供应；提供；n. 供应；供应量；n. 必需品；物资
example1_en: A nearby farm supplies fresh eggs to our shop.
example1_zh: 附近一家农场给我们的商店供应新鲜鸡蛋。
example2_en: Cities must secure a reliable water supply as population growth and climate change place increasing pressure on resources.
example2_zh: 随着人口增长和气候变化给资源带来越来越大的压力，城市必须确保可靠的供水。

meanings_zh: v. 支持；帮助；供养；v. 支撑；承托；n. 支持；援助；支撑
example1_en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
example1_zh: 每当我尝试新事物时，姐姐都会支持我。
example2_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；推测；v. 假设；设想
example1_en: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
example1_zh: 我想，如果天气一直这么暖和，我们可以在外面吃饭。
example2_en: Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
example2_zh: 假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。

meanings_zh: adj. 确信的；有把握的；adj. 一定会的；必然的；adv. 当然；确实
example1_en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
example1_zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？
example2_en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
example2_zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。

meanings_zh: adv. 想必；总该；adv. 必定；确实
example1_en: Surely you can spare five minutes to help?
example1_zh: 你总能抽出五分钟来帮忙吧？
example2_en: Surely governments should prioritise clean drinking water before investing public money in expensive sports facilities.
example2_zh: 政府在投入公共资金建设昂贵的体育设施之前，总该优先保障清洁饮用水吧。

meanings_zh: n. 表面；表层；v. 浮出水面；v. 显露；被发现
example1_en: Wipe the kitchen surface before you start preparing lunch.
example1_zh: 开始准备午饭前，先擦一下厨房台面。
example2_en: Dark road surfaces absorb heat during the day, contributing to higher temperatures in urban areas.
example2_zh: 深色路面白天吸收热量，导致城市地区气温升高。

meanings_zh: n. 惊讶；意外之事；v. 使惊讶
example1_en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
example1_zh: 在厨房里发现一个生日蛋糕，真是个美好的惊喜。
example2_en: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
example2_zh: 调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。

meanings_zh: adj. 惊讶的；感到意外的
example1_en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
example1_zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。
example2_en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
example2_zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

meanings_zh: n. 调查；民意调查；v. 调查；v. 勘测；测量
example1_en: I completed a short survey about our local library.
example1_zh: 我填写了一份关于本地图书馆的简短问卷。
example2_en: A recent survey suggests that many commuters would cycle more often if safer routes were available.
example2_zh: 最近一项调查表明，如果有更安全的路线，许多通勤者会更经常骑自行车。

meanings_zh: v. 幸存；存活；v. 继续存在；挺过；v. 比…活得长
example1_en: Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
example1_zh: 我们的小仙人掌三个星期没浇水也活下来了。
example2_en: Small businesses are more likely to survive economic downturns when they maintain strong relationships with local customers.
example2_zh: 小企业若与本地顾客保持牢固联系，就更有可能挺过经济低迷期。

meanings_zh: n. 寿司
example1_en: We tried sushi at a Japanese restaurant.
example1_zh: 我们在一家日本餐馆品尝了寿司。
example2_en: This sushi is made with rice and vegetables.
example2_zh: 这种寿司是用米饭和蔬菜做的。

meanings_zh: n. 天鹅
example1_en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
example1_zh: 一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。
example2_en: Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
example2_zh: 保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。

meanings_zh: n. 毛衣；针织套衫
example1_en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
example1_zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。
example2_en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
example2_zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。

meanings_zh: v. 扫；清扫；v. 迅速席卷；掠过
example1_en: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
example1_zh: 请在客人到来前把厨房地板扫干净。
example2_en: Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.
example2_zh: 猛烈的风暴可能席卷沿海地区，损坏房屋并扰乱重要的交通服务。

meanings_zh: adj. 甜的；adj. 亲切的；贴心的；n. 糖果
example1_en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
example1_zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。
example2_en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
example2_zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。

meanings_zh: v. 游泳；游过；n. 一次游泳
example1_en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。
example2_en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

meanings_zh: n. 悉尼
example1_en: Sydney is a large city in Australia.
example1_zh: 悉尼是澳大利亚的一座大城市。
example2_en: We saw the Opera House in Sydney.
example2_zh: 我们在悉尼看到了歌剧院。

meanings_zh: n. 象征；标志；n. 符号
example1_en: For my grandparents, this old house is a symbol of hope.
example1_zh: 对我的祖父母来说，这座老房子是希望的象征。
example2_en: Public parks can become a symbol of a city's commitment to environmental protection and residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 公共公园可以成为城市致力于环境保护和提升居民生活质量的象征。

meanings_zh: n. 系统；n. 制度；体制；n. 方法；成套程序
example1_en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
example1_zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。
example2_en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
example2_zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。

meanings_zh: n. T恤衫
example1_en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
example1_zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。
example2_en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
example2_zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。

meanings_zh: n. 中国航天员
example1_en: The taikonaut worked inside China's space station.
example1_zh: 这名中国航天员在中国空间站内工作。
example2_en: Many children dream of becoming a taikonaut.
example2_zh: 许多孩子梦想成为中国航天员。

meanings_zh: n. 尾巴；尾部；v. 尾随；跟踪
example1_en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
example1_zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。
example2_en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
example2_zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

meanings_zh: v. 拿；取；带走；v. 花费；需要；v. 乘坐；搭乘
example1_en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
example1_zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。
example2_en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
example2_zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。

meanings_zh: n. 天赋；才能；n. 人才；有才能的人
example1_en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
example1_zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。
example2_en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
example2_zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

meanings_zh: adj. 有天赋的；有才能的
example1_en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
example1_zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
example2_zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。

meanings_zh: v. 说话；交谈；谈论；n. 谈话；会谈；n. 演讲；讲座
example1_en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。

meanings_zh: adj. 高的；高大的
example1_en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
example1_zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。
example2_en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
example2_zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

meanings_zh: n. 水龙头；v. 轻敲；轻拍；v. 开发利用
example1_en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
example1_zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。
example2_en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
example2_zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

meanings_zh: n. 胶带；n. 磁带；录音带；v. 用胶带粘贴或固定
example1_en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
example1_zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。
example2_en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
example2_zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。

meanings_zh: n. 任务；工作；v. 给……分派任务
example1_en: My first task today is to water the plants.
example1_zh: 我今天的第一项任务是给植物浇水。
example2_en: Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.
example2_zh: 把复杂任务分成较小的阶段，可以帮助学生更有效地管理时间。

meanings_zh: n. 味道；味觉；v. 品尝；尝起来；n. 品味；喜好
example1_en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
example1_zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。
example2_en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
example2_zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。

meanings_zh: n. 茶；茶水；n. 茶叶；n. 茶点；晚餐
example1_en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
example1_zh: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。
example2_en: In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
example2_zh: 在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。

meanings_zh: v. 教；教授；教导
example1_en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
example1_zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。

meanings_zh: n. 教师；老师
example1_en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
example1_zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。
example2_en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
example2_zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

meanings_zh: n. 队；团队；v. 合作；组成团队
example1_en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
example1_zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。
example2_en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
example2_zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

meanings_zh: n. 团队合作
example1_en: Good teamwork helped us finish painting before lunch.
example1_zh: 良好的团队合作让我们在午饭前刷完了漆。
example2_en: Group projects can develop teamwork skills that students will need in their future careers.
example2_zh: 小组项目可以培养学生未来工作所需的团队合作能力。

meanings_zh: v. 撕破；扯开；n. 眼泪；n. 裂口；破洞
example1_en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
example1_zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。
example2_en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
example2_zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；技巧；手法；n. 技艺；技术水平
example1_en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
example1_zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。
example2_en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
example2_zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

meanings_zh: n. 技术；科技
example1_en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
example1_zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。
example2_en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
example2_zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。

meanings_zh: n. 十三至十九岁青少年
example1_en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
example1_zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。
example2_en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
example2_zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。

meanings_zh: n. 望远镜；v. 压缩；缩短；v. 套叠伸缩
example1_en: We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.
example1_zh: 我们在阳台上用望远镜观察月亮。
example2_en: Space telescopes allow scientists to study distant galaxies without interference from the Earth's atmosphere.
example2_zh: 太空望远镜让科学家能够不受地球大气干扰地研究遥远的星系。

meanings_zh: v. 告诉；讲述；v. 吩咐；命令；v. 辨别；看出
example1_en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
example1_zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。
example2_en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
example2_zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。

meanings_zh: n. 脾气；易怒的性情；v. 缓和；节制；v. 使金属回火
example1_en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
example1_zh: 抽屉又卡住了，他大发脾气。
example2_en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
example2_zh: 政府应认真考虑新技术可能带来的社会后果，避免一味热衷于推广。

meanings_zh: n. 温度；气温；体温；n. 发烧
example1_en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
example1_zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。
example2_en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
example2_zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

meanings_zh: num. 十
example1_en: We need ten pencils for the activity.
example1_zh: 这项活动需要十支铅笔。
example2_en: It takes ten minutes to walk there.
example2_zh: 步行到那里需要十分钟。

meanings_zh: n. 网球运动
example1_en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
example1_zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。
example2_en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
example2_zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。

meanings_zh: n. 帐篷
example1_en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
example1_zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。
example2_en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 术语；用语；n. 学期；n. 期限；任期
example1_en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
example1_zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。
example2_en: The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
example2_zh: 可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人不快的；adj. 可怕的；严重的
example1_en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
example1_zh: 汤很难喝，于是我做了个三明治。
example2_en: Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 垃圾管理不善可能给公共健康带来严重后果，在人口密集的城市尤其如此。

meanings_zh: adv. 非常；极其；adv. 糟糕地；很差地
example1_en: I'm terribly sorry I spilled juice on your jacket.
example1_zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，实在抱歉。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, elderly residents may feel terribly isolated in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，偏远农村社区的老年居民可能会感到非常孤立。

meanings_zh: n. 测验；测试；检查；v. 测验；检测；检验
example1_en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。
example2_en: Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。

meanings_zh: n. 文字；文本；n. 短信；v. 发短信
example1_en: The text on this menu is too small.
example1_zh: 这份菜单上的字太小了。
example2_en: Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
example2_zh: 教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。

meanings_zh: n. 教科书；课本；adj. 典型的；标准的
example1_en: I left my science textbook on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我把科学课本落在厨房桌上了。
example2_en: Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.
example2_zh: 电子教材可以降低学校开支，不过一些学生觉得纸质材料更便于学习。

meanings_zh: adj. 泰国的；泰语的；n. 泰语；n. 泰国人
example1_en: We shared a delicious Thai curry for dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭我们一起吃了一道美味的泰式咖喱。
example2_en: Thai cuisine attracts international visitors and provides valuable opportunities for local restaurants and cooking schools.
example2_zh: 泰国菜吸引着国际游客，也为当地餐馆和烹饪学校提供了宝贵的机会。

meanings_zh: prep. 比；conj. 比
example1_en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
example1_zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。
example2_en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。

meanings_zh: n. 感恩；感恩祈祷；n. 感恩节
example1_en: They held a small thanksgiving ceremony after the harvest.
example1_zh: 收获后，他们举行了一场小型感恩仪式。
example2_en: In some countries, Thanksgiving brings families together and encourages reflection on the importance of community support.
example2_zh: 在一些国家，感恩节让家人团聚，也促使人们思考社区互助的重要性。

meanings_zh: n. 剧院；n. 戏剧；戏剧艺术；n. 手术室
example1_en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
example1_zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。
example2_en: Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
example2_zh: 对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。

meanings_zh: det. 他们的；她们的；它们的
example1_en: Their classroom is on the second floor.
example1_zh: 他们的教室在二楼。
example2_en: The children put away their books.
example2_zh: 孩子们收好了他们的书。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的
example1_en: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
example1_zh: 我们的花园很小，但他们的花园里有好几棵树。
example2_en: Some families own their homes, while others rent theirs because property prices remain beyond their reach.
example2_zh: 有些家庭拥有自己的住房，另一些则因房价仍超出承受能力而租房居住。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们；她们；它们（宾格）
example1_en: I can see them in the playground.
example1_zh: 我能在操场上看到他们。
example2_en: Please put the books back after you use them.
example2_zh: 用完这些书后请把它们放回去。

meanings_zh: adv. 然后；那时
example1_en: Wash your hands, then eat lunch.
example1_zh: 先洗手，然后吃午饭。
example2_en: I lived in a small town back then.
example2_zh: 那时候我住在一个小镇上。

meanings_zh: adv. 在那里；往那里；pron. 用于表示存在的句式
example1_en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
example1_zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。
example2_en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
example2_zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。

meanings_zh: adv. 因此；所以
example1_en: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
example1_zh: 商店关门了，因此我们空手回了家。
example2_en: Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
example2_zh: 公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。

meanings_zh: det. 这些；pron. 这些人；这些事物
example1_en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
example1_zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。
example2_en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
example2_zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。

meanings_zh: adj. 厚的；粗的；adj. 浓密的；浓重的；adj. 黏稠的
example1_en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
example1_zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。
example2_en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
example2_zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

meanings_zh: adj. 薄的；细的；adj. 瘦的；v. 使稀疏；变稀薄
example1_en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
example1_zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。
example2_en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
example2_zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。

meanings_zh: n. 东西；物品；n. 事情；情况；n. 个人物品
example1_en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
example1_zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？
example2_en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
example2_zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；觉得；v. 思考；考虑
example1_en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
example1_zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。
example2_en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
example2_zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。

meanings_zh: n. 思想家；善于思考的人
example1_en: My grandfather is a quiet thinker who enjoys difficult questions.
example1_zh: 我爷爷是个沉静、爱思考的人，喜欢琢磨难题。
example2_en: Education should encourage students to become independent thinkers rather than simply accept established ideas without question.
example2_zh: 教育应鼓励学生成为独立思考者，而不是不加质疑地接受既有观点。

meanings_zh: num. 第三；n. 三分之一
example1_en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。
example2_en: Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
example2_zh: 该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。

meanings_zh: adj. 口渴的；adj. 渴望的
example1_en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
example1_zh: 我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。
example2_en: Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.
example2_zh: 渴求知识的孩子能从鼓励提问和自主探索的课程中受益。

meanings_zh: num. 十三
example1_en: There are thirteen books on the shelf.
example1_zh: 书架上有十三本书。
example2_en: He is thirteen years old this year.
example2_zh: 他今年十三岁。

meanings_zh: num. 第三十
example1_en: Her birthday is on the thirtieth of June.
example1_zh: 她的生日是六月三十日。
example2_en: He was the thirtieth runner to finish.
example2_zh: 他是第三十个完成比赛的选手。

meanings_zh: det.; pron. 那些
example1_en: Those flowers are very beautiful.
example1_zh: 那些花非常漂亮。
example2_en: Please put those on the top shelf.
example2_zh: 请把那些东西放在最上面的架子上。

meanings_zh: conj. 虽然；尽管；adv. 不过；然而
example1_en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
example1_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。
example2_en: Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
example2_zh: 虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。

meanings_zh: n. 想法；念头；n. 思考；考虑；v. 想；认为（过去式）
example1_en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。
example2_en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
example2_zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。

meanings_zh: num. 一千；n. 数千；大量
example1_en: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
example1_zh: 维修费总共将近一千美元。
example2_en: Several thousand residents have benefited from the new cycle routes connecting suburban neighbourhoods with the city centre.
example2_zh: 连接郊区社区与市中心的新自行车道已让数千名居民受益。

meanings_zh: num. 三
example1_en: I have three good friends.
example1_zh: 我有三个好朋友。
example2_en: Please read the story three times.
example2_zh: 请把这个故事读三遍。

meanings_zh: n. 喉咙；咽喉
example1_en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
example1_zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。
example2_en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
example2_zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；贯穿；prep. 通过；凭借；adv. 从头到尾；通过
example1_en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
example1_zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。
example2_en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
example2_zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

meanings_zh: v. 扔；投；掷；v. 举办聚会；n. 投掷；投掷距离
example1_en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
example1_zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。
example2_en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

meanings_zh: n. 雷；雷声；v. 打雷；轰隆作响
example1_en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
example1_zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。
example2_en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
example2_zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。

meanings_zh: n. 星期四
example1_en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
example1_zh: 我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。
example2_en: The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
example2_zh: 这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。

meanings_zh: v. 打钩；作滴答声；n. 钩号；滴答声；n. 蜱；壁虱
example1_en: The old clock ticks softly beside my bed.
example1_zh: 那只旧钟在我的床边轻轻地滴答作响。
example2_en: Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.
example2_zh: 参与者应在相应方框内打钩，说明自己使用公共交通的频率。

meanings_zh: n. 票；入场券；n. 交通违章罚单；v. 向……开交通罚单
example1_en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
example1_zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。
example2_en: Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.
example2_zh: 降低票价可以鼓励更多通勤者选择乘火车而非开车上班。

meanings_zh: adj. 整洁的；整齐的；v. 整理；收拾
example1_en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
example1_zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。
example2_en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
example2_zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。

meanings_zh: v. 系；绑；打结；n. 领带；n. 联系；关系
example1_en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
example1_zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。
example2_en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
example2_zh: 学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。

meanings_zh: n. 老虎
example1_en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
example1_zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。
example2_en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
example2_zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧的；紧身的；adj. 紧张的；余地很小的；adv. 紧紧地；牢牢地
example1_en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
example1_zh: 这双鞋的鞋头太紧，挤着我的脚趾。
example2_en: Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.
example2_zh: 预算紧张的学校可能难以为学生提供现代化设备和充分的支持。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到……为止；conj. 直到……才；直到；n. 收银机；现金抽屉
example1_en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。
example2_en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
example2_zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 时间；时刻；n. 次；回；v. 计时；安排时机
example1_en: We still have time for a walk before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前我们还有时间散步。
example2_en: Schools should give students enough time to explore creative activities alongside their preparation for formal examinations.
example2_zh: 学校应在学生准备正式考试的同时，给予他们足够的时间探索创意活动。

meanings_zh: adj. 极小的；微小的
example1_en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
example1_zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。
example2_en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
example2_zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

meanings_zh: n. 实用建议；窍门；n. 尖端；末端；n. 小费
example1_en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
example1_zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。
example2_en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。

meanings_zh: adj. 疲倦的；累的；adj. 厌倦的；厌烦的
example1_en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
example1_zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。
example2_en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
example2_zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。

meanings_zh: adj. 累人的；令人疲倦的
example1_en: Carrying these heavy bags upstairs is tiring work.
example1_zh: 把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼是件累人的活。
example2_en: Long and tiring commutes can reduce workers' productivity and leave them with less time for family activities.
example2_zh: 漫长而累人的通勤会降低员工的工作效率，也会减少他们参与家庭活动的时间。

meanings_zh: n. 标题；书名；名称；n. 头衔；职称；n. 冠军称号
example1_en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
example1_zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。
example2_en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
example2_zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。

meanings_zh: adv. 今天；现今；n. 今天；当今
example1_en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
example1_zh: 今天天气暖和，我们到外面吃饭吧。
example2_en: Today, many universities offer flexible courses that allow students to combine employment with further education.
example2_zh: 如今，许多大学开设灵活的课程，让学生能够兼顾工作和继续教育。

meanings_zh: adv. 一起；共同；adv. 合在一起；相互连接
example1_en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
example1_zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。
example2_en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
example2_zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 马桶；便器；n. 厕所；洗手间
example1_en: The toilet upstairs keeps making a strange dripping sound.
example1_zh: 楼上的马桶一直发出奇怪的滴水声。
example2_en: Access to clean public toilets is essential for protecting health and making urban spaces welcoming to everyone.
example2_zh: 提供干净的公共厕所，对保障健康和打造人人友好的城市空间至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 番茄；西红柿
example1_en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
example1_zh: 她切了一个熟番茄，放进奶酪三明治里。
example2_en: Growing tomatoes in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 在社区花园种植番茄，可以让城市居民更容易获得新鲜食物。

meanings_zh: adv. 在明天；n. 明天；未来
example1_en: We are meeting at the swimming pool tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 我们明天早上在游泳池见面。
example2_en: The environmental decisions made today will shape the world that the children of tomorrow inherit.
example2_zh: 今天作出的环境决策将塑造未来孩子们继承的世界。

meanings_zh: n. 舌头；n. 语言
example1_en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
example1_zh: 我喝热汤时烫到了舌头。
example2_en: Children who receive early education in their mother tongue may develop stronger foundations for learning other languages.
example2_zh: 用母语接受早期教育的儿童，可能为学习其他语言打下更牢固的基础。

meanings_zh: adv. 在今晚；n. 今晚；今夜
example1_en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。
example2_en: Residents will meet tonight to discuss how public transport could better serve the local community.
example2_zh: 居民们今晚将开会讨论公共交通如何更好地服务当地社区。

meanings_zh: n. 工具；用具；n. 手段；辅助工具
example1_en: This small tool helps me tighten the loose screws.
example1_zh: 这个小工具帮我拧紧松动的螺丝。
example2_en: Digital maps are a valuable tool for urban planners seeking to design more accessible public transport networks.
example2_zh: 数字地图是城市规划者设计更便捷的公共交通网络的重要辅助工具。

meanings_zh: n. 牙齿；n. 齿状部分
example1_en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
example1_zh: 牙医用一面小镜子检查了每颗牙齿。
example2_en: Regular dental checkups can help prevent tooth decay and reduce the need for expensive treatment.
example2_zh: 定期牙科检查有助于预防蛀牙，减少接受昂贵治疗的需要。

meanings_zh: n. 牙痛
example1_en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
example1_zh: 牙痛让我大半夜都没睡着。
example2_en: Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的牙科服务让牙痛患者能在问题恶化前就医。

meanings_zh: n. 牙膏
example1_en: I squeezed some toothpaste onto my brush before breakfast.
example1_zh: 早餐前，我往牙刷上挤了些牙膏。
example2_en: Regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste helps prevent tooth decay and can reduce the need for costly dental treatment.
example2_zh: 经常使用含氟牙膏刷牙有助于预防蛀牙，并可减少昂贵牙科治疗的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 顶部；顶端；adj. 最高的；最好的；v. 位居……之首；超过
example1_en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
example1_zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。
example2_en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
example2_zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。

meanings_zh: n. 话题；主题
example1_en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
example1_zh: 食物在我们家一直是个热门话题。
example2_en: Climate change has become a central topic in school discussions about the future of our planet.
example2_zh: 气候变化已成为学校讨论地球未来时的核心话题。

meanings_zh: n. 龙卷风
example1_en: We watched the tornado from a safe underground shelter.
example1_zh: 我们在安全的地下避难处观察那场龙卷风。
example2_en: Effective warning systems can reduce injuries when a tornado approaches a densely populated area.
example2_zh: 当龙卷风接近人口密集地区时，有效的预警系统能够减少人员受伤。

meanings_zh: adj. 总的；完全的；n. 总数；总额；v. 总计达；合计
example1_en: The total cost includes breakfast and a bus ticket.
example1_zh: 总费用包含早餐和一张公交车票。
example2_en: Improving home insulation can reduce total energy consumption while making housing more comfortable throughout the year.
example2_zh: 改善住宅隔热性能可以减少能源总消耗，同时让住房全年都更加舒适。

meanings_zh: v. 触摸；碰；n. 触觉；触碰；v. 感动
example1_en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
example1_zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。
example2_en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
example2_zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

meanings_zh: n. 游览；参观；巡游；n. 巡回演出；巡回比赛；v. 游览；巡回演出
example1_en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
example1_zh: 我们在导游带领下参观了那座古堡。
example2_en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
example2_zh: 有组织的游览既能让游客了解当地传统，也能为社区导游提供稳定收入。

meanings_zh: n. 旅游业；观光旅游
example1_en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
example1_zh: 每年夏天，旅游业都会为我们村带来许多游客。
example2_en: Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.
example2_zh: 可持续旅游能为当地社区创造收入，同时保护吸引游客的自然景观。

meanings_zh: n. 游客；观光者
example1_en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
example1_zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。
example2_en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
example2_zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。

meanings_zh: prep. 朝；向；prep. 对；对于；prep. 用于；有助于
example1_en: The puppy ran towards me with its tail wagging.
example1_zh: 小狗摇着尾巴朝我跑来。
example2_en: Investment in public transport is an important step towards reducing air pollution in cities.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通是减少城市空气污染的重要一步。

meanings_zh: n. 塔；塔楼；v. 高耸；远高于
example1_en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
example1_zh: 我们爬上塔，看着船只驶过海湾。
example2_en: The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.
example2_zh: 这座历史悠久的塔全年吸引着游客，为附近的商店和餐馆带来可观收入。

meanings_zh: n. 城镇；市镇；n. 市中心；商业区
example1_en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们镇的老桥旁有一家面包店。
example2_en: Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.
example2_zh: 改善小城镇的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会和基本服务。

meanings_zh: n. 小路；跑道；轨道；v. 追踪；监测；n. 足迹；车辙
example1_en: We followed a narrow track through the pine forest.
example1_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过松林。
example2_en: Researchers use satellite technology to track animal movements and identify habitats that require greater protection.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用卫星技术追踪动物活动，并确定需要加强保护的栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 传统；惯例
example1_en: Making dumplings together is a tradition in our family.
example1_zh: 一起包饺子是我们家的传统。
example2_en: Schools can help preserve local traditions by inviting older residents to share their knowledge and practical skills.
example2_zh: 学校可以邀请年长居民分享知识和实用技能，从而帮助保留当地传统。

meanings_zh: adj. 传统的；沿袭已久的
example1_en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
example1_zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。
example2_en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
example2_zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。

meanings_zh: n. 交通；路上车辆；n. 通信量；网络流量
example1_en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
example1_zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

meanings_zh: n. 培训；训练；n. 体能训练；体育训练
example1_en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
example1_zh: 培训第一天，我就参与了为顾客提供帮助的工作。
example2_en: Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.
example2_zh: 定期职业培训有助于员工适应技术变化，并改善他们的长期职业前景。

meanings_zh: n. 财宝；珍宝；n. 珍品；珍贵之物；v. 珍爱；珍视
example1_en: The children imagined finding treasure inside the old chest.
example1_zh: 孩子们想象着在旧箱子里发现财宝。
example2_en: Museums preserve cultural treasures so that future generations can understand the achievements and traditions of earlier societies.
example2_zh: 博物馆保存文化珍宝，让后代能够了解早期社会的成就和传统。

meanings_zh: v. 对待；看待；v. 治疗；医治；n. 乐事；特别款待
example1_en: Our neighbours treat their rescue dog with great kindness.
example1_zh: 邻居们对他们收养的狗十分友善。
example2_en: Employers should treat all applicants fairly and assess their suitability using relevant skills rather than personal background.
example2_zh: 雇主应公平对待所有求职者，依据相关技能而非个人背景评估他们是否适合岗位。

meanings_zh: n. 树；树木
example1_en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。
example2_en: Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 在城市地区植树能提供树荫、改善空气质量，并为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 诡计；恶作剧；n. 窍门；戏法；v. 欺骗；哄骗
example1_en: Someone played a trick on me with a plastic spider.
example1_zh: 有人用一只塑料蜘蛛捉弄了我。
example2_en: Some online advertisements trick consumers into paying for services they initially believed were free.
example2_zh: 一些网络广告诱骗消费者为他们起初以为免费的服务付费。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行；出行；v. 绊倒；使绊倒
example1_en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
example1_zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。
example2_en: School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.
example2_zh: 学校组织的博物馆参观能让学生直接接触历史实物，从而丰富课堂学习。

meanings_zh: n. 麻烦；困难；故障；v. 使烦恼；麻烦
example1_en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
example1_zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。
example2_en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
example2_zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

meanings_zh: n. 裤子；长裤
example1_en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
example1_zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。
example2_en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
example2_zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。

meanings_zh: n. 卡车；载货汽车；v. 用卡车运输
example1_en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，一辆卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。
example2_en: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
example2_zh: 用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。

meanings_zh: adj. 真实的；正确的；adj. 真正的；名副其实的；adj. 忠实的；忠诚的
example1_en: Is it TRUE that your cat can open doors?
example1_zh: 你的猫会开门，这是真的吗？
example2_en: Students must assess whether online claims are TRUE before using them as evidence in academic essays.
example2_zh: 学生在将网上的说法用作学术论文的论据之前，必须评估其是否属实。

meanings_zh: adv. 真正地；确实；adv. 真诚地；由衷地
example1_en: This is the first place I've felt truly comfortable.
example1_zh: 这是第一个让我感到真正自在的地方。
example2_en: A truly inclusive education system must address the needs of students from different social backgrounds.
example2_zh: 真正包容的教育体系必须满足不同社会背景学生的需求。

meanings_zh: n. 小号；v. 大肆宣扬；鼓吹；v. 发出喇叭般的声音
example1_en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
example1_zh: 那位乐手举起小号，吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。
example2_en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
example2_zh: 在学校管弦乐队学习小号可以提升学生的专注力及与他人合作的能力。

meanings_zh: n. 树干；n. 象鼻；n. 汽车后备箱（美式）
example1_en: We rested against the trunk of an old oak.
example1_zh: 我们靠着一棵老橡树的树干休息。
example2_en: Damage to a tree's trunk can reduce its ability to transport water and nutrients.
example2_zh: 树干受损会削弱树木输送水分和养分的能力。

meanings_zh: n. 信任；信赖；v. 信任；相信；n. 信托；信托机构
example1_en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
example1_zh: 我信得过邻居，放心让他喂我们的猫。
example2_en: Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.
example2_zh: 公众对科学建议的信任，部分取决于研究人员能否清晰地说明不确定性和证据。

meanings_zh: n. 事实；真相；n. 真理
example1_en: Please tell me the truth about the broken cup.
example1_zh: 请告诉我杯子打碎的真相。
example2_en: Journalists should seek the truth rather than publish stories that simply attract public attention.
example2_zh: 记者应当寻求真相，而不是发表仅仅吸引公众注意的报道。

meanings_zh: n. 星期二
example1_en: We usually have dinner together on Tuesday evenings.
example1_zh: 我们通常在星期二晚上一起吃饭。
example2_en: The community centre offers free language classes every Tuesday to help newcomers settle into the area.
example2_zh: 社区中心每周二提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者适应当地生活。

meanings_zh: n. 隧道；地下通道；v. 挖隧道
example1_en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
example1_zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。
example2_en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
example2_zh: 在河底修建隧道可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善相邻区域之间的交通联系。

meanings_zh: v. 转动；转向；v. 变得；变成；n. 轮到的机会；轮次
example1_en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
example1_zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。
example2_en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
example2_zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。

meanings_zh: n. 吐鲁番
example1_en: Turpan is famous for its sweet grapes.
example1_zh: 吐鲁番以香甜的葡萄闻名。
example2_en: The weather in Turpan is hot and dry in summer.
example2_zh: 吐鲁番夏季炎热干燥。

meanings_zh: n. 海龟；龟（美）
example1_en: We watched a turtle swimming slowly over the reef.
example1_zh: 我们看着一只海龟在珊瑚礁上方缓缓游动。
example2_en: Reducing plastic pollution in coastal waters is essential for protecting turtle populations and other marine wildlife.
example2_zh: 减少沿海水域的塑料污染，对保护海龟种群及其他海洋野生动物至关重要。

meanings_zh: abbr. 电视；电视机
example1_en: We watched a nature programme on TV.
example1_zh: 我们在电视上看了一个自然节目。
example2_en: Please turn off the TV before dinner.
example2_zh: 晚饭前请关掉电视。

meanings_zh: num. 第十二；n. 十二分之一
example1_en: We celebrated her twelfth birthday with a homemade cake.
example1_zh: 我们用自制蛋糕庆祝了她的十二岁生日。
example2_en: By the twelfth month of the programme, most participants had developed more effective study habits.
example2_zh: 到该项目的第十二个月时，大多数参与者已经养成了更有效的学习习惯。

meanings_zh: num. 十二
example1_en: There are twelve fresh eggs in this carton.
example1_zh: 这个蛋盒里有十二枚新鲜鸡蛋。
example2_en: The training programme lasts twelve weeks and combines practical experience with classroom instruction for young adults.
example2_zh: 这项培训为期十二周，为年轻成年人提供实践经验与课堂教学相结合的学习。

meanings_zh: num. 第二十
example1_en: Today is the twentieth of April.
example1_zh: 今天是四月二十日。
example2_en: She came twentieth in the long race.
example2_zh: 她在长跑中获得第二十名。

meanings_zh: num. 二十
example1_en: Twenty students are waiting outside.
example1_zh: 二十名学生正在外面等候。
example2_en: The book costs twenty yuan.
example2_zh: 这本书二十元。

meanings_zh: num. 第二十一
example1_en: The school festival is on the twenty-first of May.
example1_zh: 校园节在五月二十一日。
example2_en: Our team finished twenty-first in the event.
example2_zh: 我们队在这项活动中排名第二十一。

meanings_zh: num. 第二十三
example1_en: Her birthday is on the twenty-third of March.
example1_zh: 她的生日是三月二十三日。
example2_en: This is the twenty-third page of the book.
example2_zh: 这是这本书的第二十三页。

meanings_zh: adv. 两次；adv. 两倍
example1_en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
example1_zh: 我检查了两次包，却没找到钥匙。
example2_en: Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 每周至少锻炼两次的居民，身心健康可能得到改善。

meanings_zh: n. 双胞胎之一；adj. 成对的；双胞胎的
example1_en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
example1_zh: 我的双胞胎手足和我都喜欢游泳。
example2_en: Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.
example2_zh: 涉及同卵双胞胎的研究有助于研究人员了解基因和环境如何影响人的发育。

meanings_zh: num. 二；两个
example1_en: There are two apples on the table.
example1_zh: 桌子上有两个苹果。
example2_en: The two teams played very well.
example2_zh: 两支队伍都表现得很好。

meanings_zh: n. 类型；种类；v. 打字
example1_en: What type of bread would you like today?
example1_zh: 你今天想要哪种面包？
example2_en: Different types of public transport are needed to serve both urban and rural communities.
example2_zh: 城市和农村社区都需要不同类型的公共交通服务。

meanings_zh: n. 台风
example1_en: We stayed indoors as the typhoon shook the windows.
example1_zh: 台风把窗户震得直响，我们一直待在室内。
example2_en: Coastal communities need stronger buildings and reliable warning systems to reduce damage caused by typhoons.
example2_zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的建筑和可靠的预警系统，以减少台风造成的破坏。

meanings_zh: adj. 丑陋的；难看的；adj. 令人不快的；险恶的
example1_en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
example1_zh: 我们用木制屏风遮住了那些难看的管道。
example2_en: Poorly planned developments can create ugly urban landscapes that reduce residents' satisfaction with their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 规划不善的开发项目可能形成难看的城市景观，降低居民对社区的满意度。

meanings_zh: abbr. 英国
example1_en: My pen friend lives in the UK.
example1_zh: 我的笔友住在英国。
example2_en: The UK includes England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
example2_zh: 英国包括英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰。

meanings_zh: n. 雨伞；阳伞；adj. 统括的；综合性的
example1_en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
example1_zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。
example2_en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
example2_zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。

meanings_zh: n. 叔伯；舅舅；姑姨父
example1_en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
example1_zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。
example2_en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
example2_zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

meanings_zh: prep. 在…下面；prep. 少于；低于；prep. 在…状态或控制下
example1_en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 猫蜷缩在厨房的桌子下面。
example2_en: Under the new policy, local authorities must provide safer cycling routes near schools and residential areas.
example2_zh: 根据新政策，地方政府必须在学校和住宅区附近提供更安全的骑行路线。

meanings_zh: v. 理解；懂得；v. 体谅；理解感受；v. 获悉；认为
example1_en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
example1_zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。
example2_en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生理解自己的日常选择如何影响自然环境。

meanings_zh: adv. 不幸的是；遗憾的是
example1_en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
example1_zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。
example2_en: Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.
example2_zh: 遗憾的是，许多乡村学校缺乏为学生提供可靠网络连接所需的资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 不快乐的；难过的；adj. 不满意的
example1_en: He looked unhappy when the picnic was cancelled.
example1_zh: 野餐取消后，他显得很不开心。
example2_en: Residents are unhappy with the proposed road expansion because it would remove valuable green space.
example2_zh: 居民对拟议中的道路扩建不满意，因为它会占用宝贵的绿地。

meanings_zh: n. 制服；校服；adj. 一致的；均匀的
example1_en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
example1_zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。
example2_en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
example2_zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。

meanings_zh: n. 单位；单元；n. 装置；组件；n. 部门；小组；部队
example1_en: We finished the first unit before our lunch break.
example1_zh: 我们在午休前学完了第一个单元。
example2_en: Each unit of the course introduces practical skills that students can apply in the workplace.
example2_zh: 这门课程的每个单元都介绍学生可以在工作中运用的实用技能。

meanings_zh: n. 宇宙；n. 独特的世界；体系
example1_en: We watched a film about stars and the universe.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于恒星和宇宙的电影。
example2_en: Research into the origins of the universe has driven advances in telescope technology and data analysis.
example2_zh: 对宇宙起源的研究推动了望远镜技术和数据分析的进步。

meanings_zh: n. 大学
example1_en: My sister studies engineering at a university near home.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在离家不远的一所大学读工程学。
example2_en: Governments should improve access to university so that talented students are not excluded by financial barriers.
example2_zh: 政府应扩大接受大学教育的机会，避免有才华的学生因经济障碍被拒之门外。

meanings_zh: conj. 除非；如果不
example1_en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
example1_zh: 除非开始下雨，否则我们就在外面吃饭。
example2_en: Public transport will remain unpopular unless local authorities improve its reliability and make fares more affordable.
example2_zh: 除非地方政府提高公共交通的可靠性并降低票价，否则它仍不会受欢迎。

meanings_zh: adj. 倒霉的；不幸的；adj. 被认为不吉利的
example1_en: We were unlucky to miss the bus by seconds.
example1_zh: 我们真倒霉，只差几秒就错过了公交车。
example2_en: Students who are unlucky enough to fall ill during examinations should be offered alternative assessment arrangements.
example2_zh: 不幸在考试期间生病的学生应获得其他考核安排。

meanings_zh: v. 拔掉插头；断开电源
example1_en: Please unplug the charger when it is not in use.
example1_zh: 充电器不用时请拔掉插头。
example2_en: We unplug devices to save electricity.
example2_zh: 我们拔掉设备插头来节约用电。

meanings_zh: adj. 凌乱的；不整洁的；adj. 不爱收拾的
example1_en: Her untidy desk was covered with cups and notebooks.
example1_zh: 她凌乱的书桌上堆满了杯子和笔记本。
example2_en: Shared workspaces can quickly become untidy unless employees take responsibility for keeping communal areas clean and organised.
example2_zh: 如果员工不主动保持公共区域干净有序，共享办公空间很快就会变得凌乱。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到……为止；conj. 直到……时
example1_en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
example1_zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。
example2_en: Governments should continue supporting renewable energy until cleaner technologies become affordable for the majority of households.
example2_zh: 政府应持续支持可再生能源，直到大多数家庭都能负担得起更清洁的技术。

meanings_zh: adj. 不寻常的；与众不同的
example1_en: This carrot has an unusual shape, like a tiny hand.
example1_zh: 这根胡萝卜的形状很特别，像一只小手。
example2_en: Scientists are investigating unusual weather patterns that may be linked to rising global temperatures.
example2_zh: 科学家正在研究可能与全球气温上升有关的异常天气模式。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上；prep. 一……就；在……时
example1_en: The cat rested upon a cushion beside the window.
example1_zh: 猫趴在窗边的垫子上休息。
example2_en: Upon completing their training, new teachers should receive ongoing support from experienced colleagues at school.
example2_zh: 新教师完成培训后，应持续获得校内资深同事的支持。

meanings_zh: adj. 难过的；心烦的；v. 使难过；使心烦；v. 打乱；扰乱
example1_en: Lena felt upset when she lost her favourite scarf.
example1_zh: 莉娜丢了最喜欢的围巾，心里很难过。
example2_en: Sudden changes to school routines can upset younger children, who often rely on predictable daily activities.
example2_zh: 学校作息突然改变可能让年幼的孩子不安，因为他们往往依赖可预期的日常活动。

meanings_zh: pron. 我们（宾格）
example1_en: Our teacher showed us a new game.
example1_zh: 老师给我们展示了一个新游戏。
example2_en: Please come and play with us.
example2_zh: 请来和我们一起玩。

meanings_zh: abbr. 美国
example1_en: Washington, D.C. is the capital of the USA.
example1_zh: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区是美国首都。
example2_en: She travelled to the USA with her family.
example2_zh: 她和家人去了美国旅行。

meanings_zh: v. 使用；运用；n. 使用；利用；n. 用途；用处
example1_en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
example1_zh: 我可以用你的剪刀打开这个包裹吗？
example2_en: Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.
example2_zh: 政府应提高公共交通服务的可靠性和可负担性，鼓励人们使用公共交通。

meanings_zh: adj. 有用的；有帮助的
example1_en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
example1_zh: 停电时，这个小手电筒很有用。
example2_en: Reliable online resources can be useful for learners who lack access to well-equipped libraries.
example2_zh: 对于无法使用设备完善的图书馆的学习者来说，可靠的网络资源可能很有帮助。

meanings_zh: adj. 通常的；惯常的
example1_en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
example1_zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。
example2_en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
example2_zh: 对科技行业的一些员工来说，居家办公已成为常规安排。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；一般地
example1_en: I usually walk to work unless it rains.
example1_zh: 除非下雨，我通常步行上班。
example2_en: People usually find it easier to maintain healthy habits when their friends and family offer support.
example2_zh: 有朋友和家人的支持，人们通常更容易保持健康的习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 假期；度假；v. 度假
example1_en: We spent our summer vacation camping beside a lake.
example1_zh: 我们暑假在湖边露营。
example2_en: Taking a regular vacation may improve employees' mental health and help them return to work with greater motivation.
example2_zh: 定期休假可能改善员工的心理健康，并让他们回到工作岗位时更有动力。

meanings_zh: n. 山谷；河谷
example1_en: A narrow river winds through the green valley.
example1_zh: 一条狭窄的河流蜿蜒穿过翠绿的山谷。
example2_en: Farming communities in the valley depend on seasonal rainfall to maintain their crops and support local livelihoods.
example2_zh: 河谷中的农业社区依靠季节性降雨维持作物生长，保障当地居民的生计。

meanings_zh: adj. 有用的；有价值的；adj. 贵重的；值钱的
example1_en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
example1_zh: 邻居给了我一些种番茄的宝贵建议。
example2_en: Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.
example2_zh: 实习提供宝贵经验，帮助学生在正式就业前培养实践技能。

meanings_zh: n. 价值；价格；重要性；v. 重视；珍惜；估价；n. 价值观；行为准则
example1_en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
example1_zh: 这个结实的背包非常物有所值。
example2_en: Governments should recognise the value of public parks in improving physical health and strengthening community relationships.
example2_zh: 政府应认识到公共公园在改善身体健康和加强社区联系方面的价值。

meanings_zh: n. 蔬菜
example1_en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
example1_zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
example2_zh: 学校可以在午餐时供应更多种类的蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。

meanings_zh: adv. 很；非常；adj. 正是的；恰好的
example1_en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
example1_zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
example2_zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。

meanings_zh: n. 船；舰艇；n. 血管；脉管；n. 容器；器皿
example1_en: A large fishing vessel sailed slowly into the harbour.
example1_zh: 一艘大型渔船缓缓驶入港口。
example2_en: Commercial vessels can disturb marine ecosystems through underwater noise, fuel leaks, and the introduction of non-native species.
example2_zh: 商船可能通过水下噪声、燃油泄漏和引入外来物种干扰海洋生态系统。

meanings_zh: n. 视频；录像；v. 录制视频；录像
example1_en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
example1_zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。
example2_en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
example2_zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；看法；n. 景色；视野；v. 看待；观看
example1_en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
example1_zh: 我的看法是我们应该早点出发。
example2_en: Many residents view investment in public transport as an effective way to reduce urban pollution.
example2_zh: 许多居民认为，投资公共交通是减少城市污染的有效方式。

meanings_zh: n. 村庄；n. 全村居民
example1_en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。
example2_en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

meanings_zh: n. 小提琴
example1_en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。
example2_en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
example2_zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

meanings_zh: n. 病毒；n. 计算机病毒
example1_en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
example1_zh: 医生说我的咳嗽是由病毒引起的。
example2_en: Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传可以通过鼓励接种疫苗和经常洗手来限制病毒传播。

meanings_zh: adj. 看得见的；adj. 明显的；显而易见的
example1_en: The mountains were barely visible through the morning mist.
example1_zh: 晨雾中，群山依稀可见。
example2_en: Investment in public transport has brought visible improvements to air quality in several major cities.
example2_zh: 公共交通投资已使几个大城市的空气质量得到明显改善。

meanings_zh: v. 拜访；参观；游览；n. 拜访；参观；逗留
example1_en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
example1_zh: 我们去拜访邻居，和他们分享了一些自制的汤。
example2_en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
example2_zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。

meanings_zh: n. 访客；参观者；游客
example1_en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
example1_zh: 一位访客把她的伞落在了我们前门旁。
example2_en: The museum attracts international visitors by offering exhibitions that explore local history and culture.
example2_zh: 这家博物馆通过举办探究当地历史与文化的展览吸引国际游客。

meanings_zh: n. 嗓音；说话声；n. 发言权；影响力；v. 表达；吐露
example1_en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
example1_zh: 她温柔的声音让受惊的小狗安静了下来。
example2_en: Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.
example2_zh: 公众咨询让当地居民有机会参与直接影响其社区的决策。

meanings_zh: n. 排球运动；排球
example1_en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
example1_zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。
example2_en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
example2_zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。

meanings_zh: adj. 自愿的；非强制的；adj. 志愿的；无偿的
example1_en: Joining the weekend walking group is completely voluntary.
example1_zh: 参加周末步行小组完全出于自愿。
example2_en: Voluntary work can help young people develop practical skills while contributing to their local communities.
example2_zh: 志愿工作既能帮助年轻人培养实用技能，也能让他们为当地社区作贡献。

meanings_zh: n. 志愿者；义工；v. 自愿做；主动提供
example1_en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
example1_zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。
example2_en: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
example2_zh: 大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。

meanings_zh: n. 餐厅服务员；男侍者
example1_en: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
example1_zh: 服务员端来了我们的汤和两个热乎乎的小面包。
example2_en: A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.
example2_zh: 训练有素的服务员可以耐心回应不同顾客的需求，提升用餐体验。

meanings_zh: n. 女服务员
example1_en: The waitress brought us warm bread and fresh soup.
example1_zh: 女服务员给我们端来了温热的面包和新鲜的汤。
example2_en: Working as a waitress can help students develop communication skills while earning money to support their studies.
example2_zh: 当餐厅服务员能帮助学生培养沟通能力，同时赚钱支付学习费用。

meanings_zh: v. 醒来；唤醒；n. 航迹；尾流；n. 守灵聚会
example1_en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
example1_zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。
example2_en: People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
example2_zh: 在固定时间醒来的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠规律。

meanings_zh: v. 走；步行；n. 散步；步行路程
example1_en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每个星期天早上都步行去面包店。
example2_en: Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
example2_zh: 安全的人行道和宜人的公共空间能鼓励居民短途出行时步行而不开车。

meanings_zh: n. 墙；围墙；v. 用墙围住；用墙隔开
example1_en: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房墙上挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。
example2_en: Green walls covered with plants can improve air quality and reduce heat in crowded urban areas.
example2_zh: 覆盖植物的绿墙可以改善空气质量，并减少拥挤城区的热量。

meanings_zh: n. 钱包；皮夹
example1_en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
example1_zh: 我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。
example2_en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
example2_zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。

meanings_zh: v. 想要；希望；n. 缺乏；贫困
example1_en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
example1_zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。
example2_en: Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
example2_zh: 许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。

meanings_zh: n. 战争；n. 斗争；对抗
example1_en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。
example2_en: War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
example2_zh: 战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。

meanings_zh: n. 制品；器皿；n. 待售商品
example1_en: The potter displayed her glazed ware on wooden shelves.
example1_zh: 那位陶艺师把自己的上釉陶器摆在木架上。
example2_en: Local markets allow craftspeople to sell their wares directly, supporting traditional skills and small businesses.
example2_zh: 当地市场让手艺人能够直接出售商品，从而支持传统技艺和小企业的发展。

meanings_zh: adj. 温暖的；暖和的；adj. 热情的；友好的；v. 使暖和；变暖
example1_en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example1_zh: 这条厚毯子让我在凉飕飕的夜晚保持暖和。
example2_en: A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
example2_zh: 学校的热情欢迎能帮助新生获得归属感，并建立自信。

meanings_zh: adv. 热情地；亲切地；adv. 暖和地
example1_en: The neighbours smiled and greeted us warmly this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，邻居们微笑着热情地向我们打招呼。
example2_en: When schools welcome new students warmly, they can reduce anxiety and encourage participation in classroom activities.
example2_zh: 学校热情欢迎新生，有助于减轻他们的焦虑，并鼓励他们参与课堂活动。

meanings_zh: v. 警告；提醒
example1_en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
example1_zh: 如果锅太烫，请提醒我。
example2_en: Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.
example2_zh: 科学家警告说，栖息地持续减少可能使更多物种面临灭绝风险。

meanings_zh: v. 洗；清洗；v. 冲走；冲刷；n. 洗涤；清洗
example1_en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
example1_zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。
example2_en: Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。

meanings_zh: v. 浪费；n. 废物；垃圾；n. 浪费
example1_en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
example1_zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。
example2_en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
example2_zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

meanings_zh: v. 观看；注视；n. 手表；v. 照看；留意
example1_en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
example1_zh: 我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。
example2_en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
example2_zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。

meanings_zh: n. 水；v. 给……浇水
example1_en: Please water the plants before we leave today.
example1_zh: 今天出门前请给植物浇水。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
example2_zh: 获得清洁的饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共健康至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 瀑布
example1_en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
example1_zh: 还没看见瀑布，我们就远远听到了水声。
example2_en: Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
example2_zh: 瀑布附近的旅游业可以带动当地商业，但游客设施应保护周围的自然栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 西瓜
example1_en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
example1_zh: 在外面玩耍后，我们一起吃了一个冰凉的西瓜。
example2_en: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
example2_zh: 在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。

meanings_zh: n. 海浪；波浪；波；v. 挥手；挥舞；n. 浪潮；一阵
example1_en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
example1_zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。
example2_en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
example2_zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。
