meanings_zh: n. 方法；方式；n. 路线；方向；adv. 远远地；大大地
example1_en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
example1_zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。
example2_en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚弱的；无力的；adj. 薄弱的；缺乏说服力的；adj. 淡的；微弱的
example1_en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
example1_zh: 我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。
example2_en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
example2_zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。

meanings_zh: v. 穿；戴；v. 磨损；用旧；n. 磨损；损耗
example1_en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
example1_zh: 地板凉的时候，我总会穿上厚袜子。
example2_en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
example2_zh: 鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。

meanings_zh: n. 天气；v. 经受住；渡过难关；v. 风化；受风雨侵蚀
example1_en: The weather turned sunny just before our picnic.
example1_zh: 就在我们野餐前，天气转晴了。
example2_en: Extreme weather can disrupt food production and increase the cost of basic goods for vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 极端天气会扰乱粮食生产，并推高弱势社区基本商品的价格。

meanings_zh: n. 网站
example1_en: I found the museum's opening hours on its website.
example1_zh: 我在博物馆的网站上查到了开放时间。
example2_en: A well-designed government website can make public services more accessible to people in remote areas.
example2_zh: 设计良好的政府网站能让偏远地区的居民更便捷地获取公共服务。

meanings_zh: n. 星期三
example1_en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
example1_zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。
example2_en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
example2_zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。

meanings_zh: n. 周；星期；n. 工作周
example1_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
example1_zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
example2_en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
example2_zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。

meanings_zh: n. 工作日；周一至周五
example1_en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
example1_zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。
example2_en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
example2_zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。

meanings_zh: n. 周末
example1_en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
example1_zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。
example2_en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
example2_zh: 价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。

meanings_zh: v. 称……的重量；v. 重量为；v. 权衡；仔细考虑
example1_en: Please weigh these apples before putting them in the bag.
example1_zh: 请先称一下这些苹果，再装进袋子。
example2_en: Governments must weigh the economic benefits of tourism against its potential damage to local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 政府必须权衡旅游业的经济收益与其可能对当地生态系统造成的损害。

meanings_zh: n. 重量；体重；n. 重物；砝码；n. 重要性；影响力
example1_en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱太重，很难提起来。
example2_en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
example2_zh: 政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。

meanings_zh: n. 西；西方；西部；adj. 西部的；朝西的；adv. 向西；在西方
example1_en: Our kitchen window faces west, catching the evening sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝西，能照到傍晚的阳光。
example2_en: Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 对该国西部的投资可以缩小地区差距，并创造就业机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 西部的；西方的；adj. 西方国家及文化的；n. 西部电影；西部小说
example1_en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
example1_zh: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。
example2_en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
example2_zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。

meanings_zh: adj. 湿的；潮湿的；adj. 多雨的；下雨的；v. 弄湿
example1_en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
example1_zh: 我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。
example2_en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
example2_zh: 持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。

meanings_zh: n. 鲸
example1_en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
example1_zh: 一头鲸在我们船旁浮出水面，喷出了水雾。
example2_en: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
example2_zh: 保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。

meanings_zh: n. 轮子；车轮；n. 方向盘；v. 推着有轮之物移动
example1_en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
example1_zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。
example2_en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
example2_zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

meanings_zh: adv. 什么时候；conj. 当……时；一……就；conj. 既然；考虑到
example1_en: When does the next bus leave for town?
example1_zh: 下一班去镇上的公交车什么时候发车？
example2_en: When cities invest in reliable public transport, residents are more likely to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 当城市投资建设可靠的公共交通时，居民就更可能不开私家车出行。

meanings_zh: conj. 每当；每次；conj. 无论何时；随时；adv. 究竟什么时候
example1_en: Whenever I cook soup, my cat waits beside the stove.
example1_zh: 每当我煮汤时，我的猫就守在炉子旁边。
example2_en: Whenever cities expand, planners should consider how new developments will affect existing communities and local wildlife.
example2_zh: 每当城市扩张时，规划者都应考虑新开发项目将如何影响现有社区和当地野生动物。

meanings_zh: adv. 在哪里；到哪里
example1_en: Where is my blue pencil?
example1_zh: 我的蓝色铅笔在哪里？
example2_en: Do you know where the bus stops?
example2_zh: 你知道公共汽车在哪里停吗？

meanings_zh: conj. 无论哪里；在任何地方；adv. 究竟在哪里
example1_en: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
example1_zh: 你觉得哪里最舒服，就可以坐在哪里。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 政府应确保儿童无论住在哪里，包括偏远农村地区，都能接受良好教育。

meanings_zh: det. 哪一个；哪些；pron. 哪一个；哪些；pron. ……的那个；这件事
example1_en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
example1_zh: 今晚去吃饭我该穿哪件夹克？
example2_en: Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
example2_zh: 政府必须决定哪些政策能改善空气质量，又不会给家庭造成过大的经济压力。

meanings_zh: adj. 白色的；n. 白色；n. 蛋白；蛋清
example1_en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
example1_zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。
example2_en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
example2_zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。

meanings_zh: pron. 谁
example1_en: Who is your new classmate?
example1_zh: 谁是你的新同学？
example2_en: Do you know who made this model?
example2_zh: 你知道是谁做了这个模型吗？

meanings_zh: adj. 整个的；完整的；n. 整体；全部
example1_en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在一起烤面包。
example2_en: Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.
example2_zh: 交通政策应考虑整个社区的需求，而不应只关注汽车拥有者。

meanings_zh: det. 谁的；其…的；pron. 谁的东西
example1_en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
example1_zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？
example2_en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
example2_zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。

meanings_zh: adv. 为什么；adv. …的原因
example1_en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
example1_zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？
example2_en: Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
example2_zh: 研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽的；宽阔的；adj. 广泛的；种类多的；adv. 充分地张开
example1_en: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
example1_zh: 即使门口这么宽，这张沙发也搬不进去。
example2_en: Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
example2_zh: 大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。

meanings_zh: adv. 广泛地；普遍地；adv. 差异很大地
example1_en: This fruit is widely available in local shops.
example1_zh: 这种水果在当地商店里随处可买到。
example2_en: Although online learning is widely accepted, access to reliable internet connections still varies considerably between regions.
example2_zh: 尽管在线学习已被广泛接受，各地区获得稳定网络连接的条件仍有很大差异。

meanings_zh: n. 妻子
example1_en: His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
example1_zh: 他的妻子为他们下午的散步准备了三明治。
example2_en: A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
example2_zh: 如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。

meanings_zh: n. 野生动物；野生生物
example1_en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
example1_zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。
example2_en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
example2_zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

meanings_zh: adj. 愿意的；乐意的；adj. 积极肯干的
example1_en: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
example1_zh: 我愿意这周末帮你搬家。
example2_en: Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
example2_zh: 如果价格仍可负担且信息清晰，消费者可能更愿意购买可持续产品。

meanings_zh: v. 获胜；赢得；v. 争取到；获得；n. 胜利
example1_en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。
example2_en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
example2_zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

meanings_zh: n. 风；v. 缠绕；卷绕；v. 蜿蜒；曲折延伸
example1_en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
example1_zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。
example2_en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

meanings_zh: n. 窗；窗户；n. 电脑窗口；n. 可利用的短暂时机
example1_en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
example1_zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
example2_en: Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
example2_zh: 安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。

meanings_zh: adj. 风大的；多风的
example1_en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
example1_zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。
example2_en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
example2_zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。

meanings_zh: n. 翅膀；机翼；n. 建筑物的侧翼；n. 组织内的派别
example1_en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
example1_zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。
example2_en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
example2_zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

meanings_zh: n. 获胜者；优胜者；n. 成功的人或事物；受益者
example1_en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
example1_zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。
example2_en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
example2_zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。

meanings_zh: n. 冬季；冬天；v. 过冬；越冬
example1_en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
example1_zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。
example2_en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
example2_zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。

meanings_zh: n. 智慧；明智；n. 智慧之言；公认看法
example1_en: My grandmother shared her wisdom while we cooked together.
example1_zh: 我和祖母一起做饭时，她分享了自己的人生智慧。
example2_en: The wisdom of expanding road networks is increasingly questioned as cities seek more sustainable transport solutions.
example2_zh: 随着城市寻求更可持续的交通方案，扩建道路网络是否明智越来越受到质疑。

meanings_zh: adj. 有智慧的；明智的
example1_en: Taking a warm coat was a wise decision today.
example1_zh: 今天带上一件暖和的外套是个明智的决定。
example2_en: It would be wise for governments to invest in preventive healthcare rather than rely solely on hospital treatment.
example2_zh: 政府投资预防性医疗，而非仅仅依靠医院治疗，会是明智之举。

meanings_zh: prep. 没有；不带；不与……一起；prep. 未做某事
example1_en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。
example2_en: Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。

meanings_zh: n. 狼；v. 狼吞虎咽地吃
example1_en: A grey wolf stood silently at the forest edge.
example1_zh: 一只灰狼静静地站在森林边缘。
example2_en: Protecting wolf populations can help restore ecological balance by controlling the numbers of deer in forest habitats.
example2_zh: 保护狼群有助于控制森林栖息地中的鹿群数量，从而恢复生态平衡。

meanings_zh: n. 成年女性；女子
example1_en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
example1_zh: 隔壁那位女士在阳台上种了漂亮的花。
example2_en: Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.
example2_zh: 确保每位女性都能接受教育，可以改善几代人的健康状况和经济机会。

meanings_zh: v. 想知道；琢磨；n. 惊叹；惊奇；n. 奇观；奇迹
example1_en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
example1_zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。
example2_en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
example2_zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；令人愉快的
example1_en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。
example2_en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。

meanings_zh: n. 单词；词；n. 诺言；保证；v. 措辞；用言语表达
example1_en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
example1_zh: 我在词典里查了那个不认识的单词。
example2_en: Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.
example2_zh: 学生在有意义的语境中反复接触新词时，记忆效果会更好。

meanings_zh: v.; n. 工作；劳动；起作用
example1_en: My parents work in the city.
example1_zh: 我的父母在城里工作。
example2_en: Teamwork made the difficult task easier.
example2_zh: 团队合作让困难的任务变得更容易。

meanings_zh: n. 练习册；n. 电子表格工作簿
example1_en: I left my workbook in my school bag.
example1_zh: 我把练习册落在书包里了。
example2_en: A well-designed workbook allows students to practise new skills independently and monitor their progress.
example2_zh: 一本设计合理的练习册能让学生独立练习新技能，并跟踪自己的进步。

meanings_zh: n. 实践研讨会；工作坊；n. 车间；作坊
example1_en: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
example1_zh: 我在陶艺工作坊做了一个陶碗。
example2_en: Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
example2_zh: 学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。

meanings_zh: n. 世界；地球；n. 领域；界
example1_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
example1_zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。
example2_en: Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.
example2_zh: 世界各国需要更紧密地合作，以应对气候变化并保护共享的自然资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 全世界的；adv. 遍及全球
example1_en: The band's new song became a worldwide hit.
example1_zh: 这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。
example2_en: Worldwide cooperation is essential for reducing carbon emissions and protecting communities from the effects of climate change.
example2_zh: 全球合作对于减少碳排放、保护社区免受气候变化影响至关重要。

meanings_zh: adj. 担心的；焦虑的
example1_en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
example1_zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。
example2_en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
example2_zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。

meanings_zh: v. 担心；使担忧；n. 担忧；令人担忧的事
example1_en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
example1_zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。
example2_en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
example2_zh: 许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。

meanings_zh: adj. 更差的；更严重的；adv. 更差地；更糟地
example1_en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
example1_zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。
example2_en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
example2_zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。

meanings_zh: adj. 最差的；最严重的；adv. 最差地；最严重地；n. 最坏的情况；最糟的部分
example1_en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
example1_zh: 那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。
example2_en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。

meanings_zh: adj. 价值……的；adj. 值得的；n. 价值；作用
example1_en: This old bicycle is still worth fifty pounds.
example1_zh: 这辆旧自行车仍然值五十英镑。
example2_en: Investing in public transport is worth the initial expense because it can reduce congestion and pollution.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通值得付出前期费用，因为这能减少拥堵和污染。

meanings_zh: n. 伤口；创伤；v. 使受伤；v. 伤害感情
example1_en: The nurse gently cleaned the wound on my knee.
example1_zh: 护士轻轻清洗了我膝盖上的伤口。
example2_en: Access to clean water and basic medical supplies is essential for treating wounds and preventing infection.
example2_zh: 获得清洁用水和基本医疗用品，对处理伤口和预防感染至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 作家；作者
example1_en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
example1_zh: 那位作家等火车时，把笔记本写得满满的。
example2_en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
example2_zh: 优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不合适的；adj. 不道德的；不正当的；adv. 错误地；出差错地
example1_en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
example1_zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。
example2_en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
example2_zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。

meanings_zh: n. 院子；庭院；n. 码（长度单位）
example1_en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
example1_zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。
example2_en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
example2_zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。

meanings_zh: n. 年；一年；n. 学年；年度
example1_en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
example1_zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。
example2_en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
example2_zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。

meanings_zh: adj. 黄色的；n. 黄色；v. 变黄；使变黄
example1_en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
example1_zh: 她挑了一把黄色雨伞，准备在雨中散步。
example2_en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
example2_zh: 黄叶可能表明城市树木正受到缺水或土壤条件不佳的影响。

meanings_zh: adv. 在昨天；n. 昨天
example1_en: I left my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
example1_zh: 我昨天把雨伞落在公交车上了。
example2_en: The transport survey published yesterday suggests that commuters increasingly prefer cycling to driving in city centres.
example2_zh: 昨天发布的交通调查表明，在市中心通勤的人越来越倾向于骑车而非开车。

meanings_zh: adv. 还；尚；已经；conj. 然而；可是；adv. 更；还要
example1_en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
example1_zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。
example2_en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。

meanings_zh: n. 瑜伽
example1_en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
example1_zh: 她在窗边的垫子上练瑜伽。
example2_en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
example2_zh: 在社区中心开设瑜伽课可能有助于居民缓解压力并保持身体柔韧。

meanings_zh: n. 酸奶
example1_en: I mix fresh berries into my yogurt every morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上都往酸奶里拌入新鲜浆果。
example2_en: Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
example2_zh: 原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。

meanings_zh: adj. 年轻的；幼小的；n. 幼崽；幼鸟
example1_en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
example1_zh: 一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。
example2_en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。

meanings_zh: pron. 你的；你们的东西
example1_en: This notebook is yours.
example1_zh: 这本笔记本是你的。
example2_en: My answer is different from yours.
example2_zh: 我的答案和你的不同。

meanings_zh: pron. 你自己；您自己；pron. 你亲自；你本人
example1_en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
example1_zh: 用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。
example2_en: Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
example2_zh: 亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。

meanings_zh: n. 青年时期；青春；n. 青年群体；n. 年轻男子
example1_en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
example1_zh: 我祖母的青年时代是在一个海边村庄度过的。
example2_en: Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 对青年服务的投资能让年轻人掌握实用技能，并增强他们的归属感。

meanings_zh: adj. 好吃的；美味的
example1_en: The dumplings are yummy.
example1_zh: 这些饺子很好吃。
example2_en: This soup smells yummy and warm.
example2_zh: 这碗汤闻起来又香又暖。

meanings_zh: num. 零；n. 零度；零点
example1_en: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
example1_zh: 我们睡觉时，气温降到了零度以下。
example2_en: Achieving zero carbon emissions will require substantial investment in renewable energy, public transport, and more efficient buildings.
example2_zh: 实现零碳排放需要对可再生能源、公共交通和能效更高的建筑进行大量投资。

meanings_zh: n. 区域；地带；v. 划定用途区域
example1_en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
example1_zh: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。
example2_en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
example2_zh: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。

meanings_zh: n. 动物园
example1_en: We saw pandas at the zoo.
example1_zh: 我们在动物园看到了熊猫。
example2_en: The zoo teaches children about wild animals.
example2_zh: 动物园向孩子们介绍野生动物。

meanings_zh: n. 住处；住宿；n. 和解；迁就性安排
example1_en: We found cheap accommodation near the beach last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们在海滩附近找到了便宜的住处。
example2_en: Universities should provide affordable accommodation so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds can study without excessive financial pressure.
example2_zh: 大学应提供价格可负担的住宿，让家境困难的学生能够在不过度承受经济压力的情况下学习。

meanings_zh: n. 广告
example1_en: An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天，一则烹饪课广告吸引了我的注意。
example2_en: Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.
example2_zh: 网络广告通过展示符合用户浏览习惯和兴趣的产品，可以影响消费者的选择。

meanings_zh: 对…入迷的人；吸毒成瘾的人
有癮的；上瘾的；入迷的（；对；很入迷
n. 进步；进展；v. 前进；促进；推进；adj. 预先的；事先的
example1_en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
example1_zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。
example2_en: Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
example2_zh: 可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。

meanings_zh: adj. 先进的；adj. 高级的；高阶的；adj. 后期的；晚期的
example1_en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
example1_zh: 这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。
example2_en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
example2_zh: 先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。

meanings_zh: n. 事情；事务；n. 婚外情；私情
example1_en: The family picnic was a cheerful affair despite the rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下着雨，这次家庭野餐仍然很欢乐。
example2_en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

meanings_zh: 艾伯塔省(加拿大省份)
adj. 非常惊讶的
example1_en: I was amazed to find flowers growing through concrete.
example1_zh: 发现花从混凝土缝里长出来，我十分惊讶。
example2_en: Researchers were amazed by how quickly children learned new vocabulary through interactive games.
example2_zh: 研究人员惊讶地发现，孩子们通过互动游戏学习新词汇的速度如此之快。

meanings_zh: v. 使恼怒；使烦躁
example1_en: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
example1_zh: 我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。
example2_en: Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
example2_zh: 频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。

meanings_zh: adj. 恼怒的；不耐烦的
example1_en: Leila looked annoyed when the printer jammed again.
example1_zh: 打印机又卡纸了，莱拉显得有些恼火。
example2_en: Residents often become annoyed when construction noise continues late into the evening without prior warning.
example2_zh: 如果施工噪声持续到深夜且事先没有通知，居民往往会感到恼火。

meanings_zh: adj. 焦虑的；担忧的；adj. 渴望的；急切的
example1_en: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
example1_zh: 等待考试成绩时，我感到很焦虑。
example2_en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
example2_zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

meanings_zh: adv. 相隔；分开；adv. 成碎片；散开；adv. 除外
example1_en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
example1_zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；重大的；n. 主修专业；该专业学生；v. 主修

example2_zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。

meanings_zh: v. 复习；v. 修订；修改

meanings_zh: adj. 高级的；资深的；adj. 年长的；老年人的；n. 毕业班学生；老年人
example1_en: A senior nurse showed me how to change the bandage.
example1_zh: 一位资深护士教我如何更换绷带。
example2_en: Senior managers should consult employees before introducing policies that significantly affect working conditions across the organisation.
example2_zh: 高层管理人员在推行显著影响整个机构工作条件的政策前，应征求员工意见。

meanings_zh: 首尔(韩国首都)
n. 生理性别；n. 性行为；v. 辨别性别
example1_en: The vet checked the sex of our new kitten.
example1_zh: 兽医检查了我们新养的小猫的性别。
example2_en: Researchers examined whether biological sex influenced participants' responses to the treatment in the clinical study.
example2_zh: 研究人员在临床研究中考察了生理性别是否影响参与者对治疗的反应。

meanings_zh: n. 壳；贝壳；v. 剥壳；去壳；n. 炮弹
example1_en: She found a tiny crab inside the empty shell.
example1_zh: 她在空贝壳里发现了一只小螃蟹。
example2_en: Rising ocean acidity can weaken the shells of marine animals, threatening their survival and wider ecosystems.
example2_zh: 海洋酸度上升会削弱海洋动物的外壳，威胁其生存以及更广泛的生态系统。

meanings_zh: n. 地点；场址；遗址；n. 网站；v. 为……选址；设置
example1_en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
example1_zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。
example2_en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
example2_zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。

meanings_zh: v. 滑动；使滑行；n. 幻灯片；n. 滑梯
example1_en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
example1_zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。
example2_en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
example2_zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。

meanings_zh: n. 足球运动
example1_en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
example2_en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
example2_zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

meanings_zh: n. 解决办法；解答；n. 溶液
example1_en: Adding another shelf was a simple solution to the clutter.
example1_zh: 再加一个架子是解决杂乱问题的简单办法。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源为化石燃料造成的环境问题提供了长期解决方案。

meanings_zh: n. 来源；源头；n. 资料来源；消息来源；v. 寻找并获取
example1_en: We followed the stream uphill to find its source.
example1_zh: 我们沿着小溪向山上走，寻找它的源头。
example2_en: Researchers should compare several independent sources before drawing conclusions about the effects of social media.
example2_zh: 研究人员在对社交媒体的影响下结论之前，应比较多个独立的资料来源。

meanings_zh: adj. 特定的；adj. 明确的；具体的；adj. 特有的
example1_en: Is there a specific colour you would prefer?
example1_zh: 你有没有特别想要的颜色？
example2_en: Governments should set specific targets for reducing air pollution so that progress can be measured accurately.
example2_zh: 政府应制定具体的空气污染减排目标，以便准确衡量进展。

meanings_zh: n. 雕像；塑像
example1_en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
example1_zh: 喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。
example2_en: Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.
example2_zh: 公共雕像可以保存地方历史，但社区应讨论哪些人物值得获得这样的认可。

meanings_zh: n. 罢工；v. 击打；撞击；v. 突然想到；给……印象
example1_en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
example1_zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。
example2_en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
example2_zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。

meanings_zh: v. 艰难地做；努力争取；v. 挣扎；搏斗；n. 艰难的努力；斗争
example1_en: I struggled to carry the heavy bags up the stairs.
example1_zh: 我费力地把那些沉重的袋子提上楼梯。
example2_en: Many young adults struggle to find affordable housing in cities where wages have not kept pace with rents.
example2_zh: 在工资涨幅赶不上房租的城市，许多年轻人很难找到负担得起的住房。

meanings_zh: n. 总结；概要；adj. 概括的；简要的
example1_en: Could you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
example1_zh: 你能简要说说这次会议的内容吗？
example2_en: A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
example2_zh: 报告开头清晰的概要有助于读者迅速了解主要研究结果。

meanings_zh: n. 汗；汗水；v. 出汗
example1_en: Sweat ran down my face during the steep climb.
example1_zh: 爬那段陡坡时，汗水顺着我的脸流下来。
example2_en: People who exercise in hot weather lose water through sweat and should drink regularly.
example2_zh: 在炎热天气里锻炼的人会因出汗而流失水分，应定时饮水。

meanings_zh: 十几岁的（指；至；岁）；青少年的
泰国(国家名)
n. 坟墓；陵墓
example1_en: We visited an ancient stone tomb outside the village.
example1_zh: 我们参观了村外的一座古老石墓。
example2_en: Objects discovered inside the royal tomb provide valuable evidence about ancient beliefs, craftsmanship, and social organisation.
example2_zh: 王陵中发现的物品为研究古代信仰、工艺和社会组织提供了宝贵证据。

meanings_zh: n. 交通运输；交通工具；v. 运输；运送
example1_en: We rely on public transport to get around town.
example1_zh: 我们在城里出行靠公共交通。
example2_en: Better transport links between rural areas and cities can expand employment opportunities for local residents.
example2_zh: 改善乡村与城市之间的交通联系可以为当地居民增加就业机会。

meanings_zh: n. 捕捉器；陷阱；v. 困住；使无法逃脱；n. 圈套；困境
example1_en: We found a mouse inside the humane trap this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我们在活捕鼠笼里发现了一只老鼠。
example2_en: High housing costs can trap families in poverty by leaving little money for education or training.
example2_zh: 高昂的住房成本使家庭几乎无钱支付教育或培训费用，从而令其陷入贫困。

meanings_zh: 海啸
挖掘；发掘
v. 统一；使联合
example1_en: The neighbourhood festival helped unify our divided community.
example1_zh: 邻里节庆帮助我们这个存在隔阂的社区团结起来。
example2_en: A shared public transport network could unify the region while improving access to employment.
example2_zh: 共享的公共交通网络既能将该地区连成一体，也能让人们更方便地获得就业机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 独一无二的；独特的；adj. 特有的；独有的
example1_en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern inside.
example1_zh: 每个手工碗的内侧都有独特的图案。
example2_en: Protecting local crafts helps communities preserve their unique cultural identity in an increasingly globalised world.
example2_zh: 在日益全球化的世界中，保护地方手工艺有助于社区保留独特的文化认同。

meanings_zh: n. 多样化；变化；n. 种类；品种
example1_en: We add variety to lunch with different colourful vegetables.
example1_zh: 我们用各种色彩鲜艳的蔬菜让午餐更丰富。
example2_en: Schools should offer a wide variety of activities to support students with different interests.
example2_zh: 学校应提供丰富多样的活动，以支持兴趣各异的学生。

meanings_zh: n. 签证
example1_en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
example1_zh: 我的学生签证在起飞前不久才办下来。
example2_en: Simpler visa procedures can encourage international students to study abroad and contribute to local economies.
example2_zh: 简化签证手续可以鼓励国际学生出国留学，并为当地经济作出贡献。

meanings_zh: n. 词汇量；词汇；n. 专业词汇
example1_en: Reading short stories helps me build my English vocabulary.
example1_zh: 读短篇故事有助于我扩大英语词汇量。
example2_en: Students need a broad academic vocabulary to understand lectures and express complex ideas clearly in essays.
example2_zh: 学生需要掌握丰富的学术词汇，才能理解讲座并在论文中清晰表达复杂观点。

meanings_zh: n. 火山
example1_en: We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
example1_zh: 我们望着湖对岸的火山，看蒸汽从山中升起。
example2_en: Although an active volcano can threaten nearby communities, volcanic soils often provide valuable land for agriculture.
example2_zh: 虽然活火山会威胁附近社区，但火山土壤往往能为农业提供宝贵的土地。

meanings_zh: v. 吹口哨；鸣哨；呼啸；n. 哨子；n. 口哨声；汽笛声
example1_en: My brother whistles cheerful tunes while washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我哥哥洗碗时会吹欢快的小曲。
example2_en: Lifeguards use whistles to attract swimmers' attention quickly when dangerous conditions develop near the shore.
example2_zh: 岸边出现危险情况时，救生员用哨子迅速引起游泳者的注意。

meanings_zh: 健身房；体育馆
adv. 完全地；绝对地；adv. 当然；完全同意
example1_en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
example1_zh: 我们打扫后，厨房一尘不染。
example2_en: Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.
example2_zh: 对于偏远社区参加在线课程的学生来说，可靠的网络连接必不可少。

meanings_zh: 被……吸引住；专心致志
n. 使用机会；进入权；n. 入口；通道；v. 访问；获取；进入
example1_en: Guests have access to the pool until sunset.
example1_zh: 客人在日落前都可以使用游泳池。
example2_en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。

meanings_zh: n. 配件；附件；n. 服饰配件；n. 从犯；帮凶
example1_en: This small camera accessory keeps my photos steady.
example1_zh: 这个小巧的相机配件能让我拍照时保持稳定。
example2_en: Consumers often replace electronic accessories unnecessarily, increasing waste and demand for raw materials worldwide.
example2_zh: 消费者常常在没有必要的情况下更换电子配件，增加了废弃物和全球对原材料的需求。

meanings_zh: v. 适应；使适应；v. 改编；改装
example1_en: Our cat quickly adapted to life in the new flat.
example1_zh: 我们的猫很快适应了新公寓里的生活。
example2_en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
example2_zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

meanings_zh: v. 承认；v. 准许进入；接收
example1_en: I admit that I forgot to water your plants.
example1_zh: 我承认我忘了给你的植物浇水。
example2_en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
example2_zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。

meanings_zh: adv. 后来；之后
example1_en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。
example2_en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
example2_zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。

meanings_zh: n. 代理机构；中介公司；n. 专门机构；政府部门；n. 自主行动能力
example1_en: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel.
example1_zh: 旅行社为我们预订了航班和酒店。
example2_en: A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.
example2_zh: 国家环境机构应监测工业污染，并确保工厂遵守安全规定。

meanings_zh: adj. 农业的；农用的
example1_en: The museum displays agricultural tools used by local farmers.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了当地农民使用过的农具。
example2_en: Modern agricultural practices can increase food production, but excessive chemical use may damage soil and water quality.
example2_zh: 现代农业生产方式可以提高粮食产量，但过量使用化学品可能损害土壤和水质。

meanings_zh: n. 农业
example1_en: Many families here earn their living through agriculture.
example1_zh: 这里许多家庭靠农业谋生。
example2_en: Sustainable agriculture can protect soil quality while providing enough food for a growing global population.
example2_zh: 可持续农业既能保护土壤质量，又能为不断增长的全球人口提供充足的食物。

meanings_zh: n. 目的；目标；v. 力求；旨在；v. 瞄准；对准
example1_en: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我今天的主要目标是把厨房收拾整齐。
example2_en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
example2_zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人担忧的；惊人的
example1_en: The engine made an alarming noise as we climbed.
example1_zh: 我们上坡时，发动机发出了令人不安的声音。
example2_en: The alarming decline in insect populations could threaten food production and disrupt entire ecosystems.
example2_zh: 昆虫数量令人担忧的下降可能威胁粮食生产，并扰乱整个生态系统。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐专辑；n. 相册；集邮册
example1_en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
example1_zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。
example2_en: Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
example2_zh: 数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全；全然；adv. 总共；adv. 总的来说
example1_en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
example1_zh: 我们彻底不再去那家拥挤的咖啡馆了。
example2_en: Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
example2_zh: 虽然在线课程扩大了学习机会，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

meanings_zh: n. 大使；n. 代表；推广使者
example1_en: The ambassador welcomed visitors to the embassy garden.
example1_zh: 大使在使馆花园迎接了来宾。
example2_en: An ambassador can strengthen international cooperation by encouraging educational exchanges and maintaining dialogue during periods of tension.
example2_zh: 大使可以通过鼓励教育交流并在紧张时期保持对话，来加强国际合作。

meanings_zh: n. 数量；数额；v. 总计；相当于
example1_en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
example1_zh: 往碗里加少量牛奶。
example2_en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 分析；解析
example1_en: A soil analysis showed why my plants were struggling.
example1_zh: 土壤分析揭示了我的植物长势不佳的原因。
example2_en: Careful analysis of travel patterns can help planners design more efficient public transport networks.
example2_zh: 仔细分析出行模式可以帮助规划人员设计更高效的公共交通网络。

meanings_zh: n. 祖先；祖宗；n. 祖先物种；原型
example1_en: One of my ancestors built this old stone house.
example1_zh: 我的一位祖先建造了这座古老的石屋。
example2_en: Studying how our ancestors adapted to environmental change can offer insights into human resilience.
example2_zh: 研究祖先如何适应环境变化，可以帮助我们理解人类的适应能力。

meanings_zh: 盎格鲁－撒克逊人
v. 宣布；公布
example1_en: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
example1_zh: 今天午饭后，我们的老师宣布了获奖者。
example2_en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
example2_zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。

meanings_zh: 羚；羚类动物；藏羚羊
v. 道歉
example1_en: I should apologise for spilling juice on your jacket.
example1_zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，应该向你道歉。
example2_en: Companies should apologise publicly when their mistakes cause inconvenience or financial loss to customers.
example2_zh: 当企业的失误给顾客造成不便或经济损失时，企业应该公开道歉。

meanings_zh: n. 申请；申请书；n. 应用；运用；n. 应用程序
example1_en: I sent my job application before breakfast this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早饭前，我提交了求职申请。
example2_en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
example2_zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。

meanings_zh: v. 任命；委派；v. 指定；约定
example1_en: The club appointed my sister as its new captain.
example1_zh: 俱乐部任命我姐姐为新队长。
example2_en: Schools should appoint qualified counsellors to help students manage stress and make informed career choices.
example2_zh: 学校应聘任合格的辅导员，帮助学生应对压力并作出明智的职业选择。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；处理方式；v. 接近；靠近；v. 着手处理；接洽
example1_en: We tried a different approach to training our puppy.
example1_zh: 我们试着用另一种方法训练小狗。
example2_en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
example2_zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

meanings_zh: n. 考古学家
example1_en: The archaeologist gently brushed soil from a clay bowl.
example1_zh: 考古学家轻轻刷去陶碗上的泥土。
example2_en: An archaeologist can reveal how ancient communities adapted to environmental change by examining tools and settlement patterns.
example2_zh: 考古学家可以通过研究工具和聚落分布，揭示古代群体如何适应环境变化。

meanings_zh: n. 射箭；射箭运动
example1_en: We tried archery at a supervised outdoor activity centre.
example1_zh: 我们在一家户外活动中心的指导下尝试了射箭。
example2_en: Offering archery in schools could introduce students to a sport that develops concentration and physical coordination.
example2_zh: 学校开设射箭课程，可以让学生接触一项培养专注力和身体协调能力的运动。

meanings_zh: n. 争论；争吵；n. 论点；论据
example1_en: We had an argument about whose turn it was.
example1_zh: 我们为该轮到谁而争吵了起来。
example2_en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

meanings_zh: adv. 到一旁；在旁边；adv. 暂且不论；留着备用；n. 旁白；低声插话；题外话
example1_en: She stepped aside to let the cyclist pass.
example1_zh: 她走到一旁，让骑自行车的人过去。
example2_en: Governments should set aside sufficient funds for maintaining public parks, rather than focusing solely on new construction.
example2_zh: 政府应留出足够的资金维护公园，而不是只关注新建项目。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助；协助
example1_en: A friendly librarian assisted me with the printer.
example1_zh: 一位友善的图书管理员帮我使用了打印机。
example2_en: Local volunteers can assist older residents with online services, making essential information more accessible.
example2_zh: 当地志愿者可以帮助老年居民使用在线服务，让他们更容易获取重要信息。

meanings_zh: v. 假定；想当然地认为；v. 承担；就任；v. 呈现；具有
example1_en: Don't assume the shop is open on Sundays.

example1_zh: 每个人都为我们的聚餐带来了一道菜。
example2_en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
example2_zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。

meanings_zh: n. 戏服；装扮服装；n. 民族服装；时代服饰
example1_en: Lena wore a butterfly costume in the school play.
example1_zh: 莉娜在学校话剧里穿了一套蝴蝶戏服。
example2_en: Traditional costume can express cultural identity and help younger generations understand the history of their communities.
example2_zh: 传统服饰能够表达文化认同，并帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的历史。

meanings_zh: n. 郡；县
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village in this county.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母住在这个郡里一个安静的村庄。
example2_en: The county council plans to improve public transport between rural communities and the nearest city.
example2_zh: 郡议会计划改善乡村社区与最近城市之间的公共交通。

meanings_zh: n. 法院；法庭；n. 球场；v. 设法获得；招致
example1_en: She will appear in court on Monday morning.
example1_zh: 她将于星期一上午出庭。
example2_en: Local councils should provide public tennis courts so that more residents can exercise regularly.
example2_zh: 地方议会应提供公共网球场，让更多居民能够经常锻炼。

meanings_zh: n. 庭院；院子；天井
example1_en: We ate breakfast in the courtyard beside a fountain.
example1_zh: 我们在庭院的喷泉旁吃了早餐。
example2_en: Traditional houses with a central courtyard can provide natural ventilation while offering residents a private outdoor space.
example2_zh: 带有中央庭院的传统住宅既能自然通风，又能为住户提供私密的户外空间。

meanings_zh: 创造性地；有创造力地
n. 动物；生物；n. 虚构生物；怪物
example1_en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
example1_zh: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。
example2_en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
example2_zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。

meanings_zh: n. 庄稼；农作物；n. 一季的收成；v. 裁剪；剪短
example1_en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。
example2_en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
example2_zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

meanings_zh: n. 货币；通货；n. 流传；通行
example1_en: We exchanged our money for local currency at the airport.
example1_zh: 我们在机场把钱兑换成了当地货币。
example2_en: A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.
example2_zh: 货币贬值可以降低住宿和其他服务的价格，从而吸引国际游客。

meanings_zh: adj. 当前的；现行的；n. 水流；气流；电流
example1_en: My current flat is much closer to work.
example1_zh: 我现在住的公寓离上班的地方近多了。
example2_en: Current policies may need revision as cities face increasing pressure on housing and transport.
example2_zh: 随着城市住房和交通压力不断增加，现行政策可能需要调整。

meanings_zh: 网霸；网络欺凌
n.柏树
n. 水坝；v. 在……筑坝；拦水
example1_en: We watched water rushing through the gates of the dam.
example1_zh: 我们看着水从大坝的闸门中奔涌而出。
example2_en: Building a dam can provide renewable electricity, but it may also disrupt river ecosystems and displace communities.
example2_zh: 修建水坝可以提供可再生电力，但也可能扰乱河流生态系统并迫使居民搬迁。

meanings_zh: n. 数据；资料
example1_en: My watch collects data about how far I walk.
example1_zh: 我的手表会收集有关我步行距离的数据。
example2_en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
example2_zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

meanings_zh: n. 数据库；资料库
example1_en: The library database helped me find a gardening book.
example1_zh: 图书馆的数据库帮我找到了一本园艺书。
example2_en: Hospitals need secure databases to protect patient records while allowing doctors to access essential information.
example2_zh: 医院需要安全的数据库来保护病历，同时让医生能够获取必要信息。

meanings_zh: n. 十年；十年期
example1_en: They have lived on this street for a decade.
example1_zh: 他们在这条街上已经住了十年。
example2_en: Over the past decade, digital technology has significantly changed how people access education and healthcare.
example2_zh: 过去十年间，数字技术显著改变了人们获取教育和医疗服务的方式。

meanings_zh: n. 防御；保护；n. 辩护；答辩；n. 防守；防守队员
example1_en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
example1_zh: 厚实的城墙为抵御进攻者提供了坚固的屏障。
example2_en: Restoring coastal wetlands offers a natural defence against flooding while creating valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 恢复沿海湿地既能形成防洪的天然屏障，也能为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

meanings_zh: v. 给…下定义；解释含义；v. 明确规定；界定；v. 构成…的特征
example1_en: Can you define this word without using a dictionary?
example1_zh: 你能不用词典解释这个词的含义吗？
example2_en: Governments should clearly define their environmental objectives before introducing policies that affect businesses and local communities.
example2_zh: 政府在推行影响企业和当地社区的政策前，应明确界定其环境目标。

meanings_zh: adv. 肯定地；确实；当然
example1_en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
example1_zh: 昨天下过雨后，我今天肯定会带伞。
example2_en: Improved insulation will definitely reduce heat loss, although total energy savings depend on household behaviour.
example2_zh: 改善隔热性能肯定能减少热量流失，不过总节能量取决于住户的行为。

meanings_zh: n. 部门；司局；系；n. 商店的商品部
example1_en: Please ask our sales department about the delivery date.
example1_zh: 请向我们的销售部门询问送货日期。
example2_en: Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.
example2_zh: 大学各系应定期审查课程，确保课程反映相关领域的发展。

meanings_zh: n. 后裔；子孙；n. 衍生事物；后继形式
example1_en: Her descendants still live in the old family farmhouse.
example1_zh: 她的后代仍住在家族的老农舍里。
example2_en: Preserving traditional crafts allows descendants of local communities to maintain meaningful connections with their cultural heritage.
example2_zh: 保护传统工艺能让当地社区的后代与自身文化遗产保持有意义的联系。

meanings_zh: 渴望；欲望；渴望；期望
n. 绝望；v. 绝望；失去希望
example1_en: He felt deep despair when his final application was rejected.
example1_zh: 最后一份申请被拒后，他感到深深的绝望。
example2_en: Long periods of unemployment can lead to despair, highlighting the importance of accessible career advice and emotional support.
example2_zh: 长期失业可能让人陷入绝望，这凸显了提供便利的职业咨询和情感支持的重要性。

meanings_zh: v. 查明；确定；v. 决定；影响结果；v. 决定；下决心
example1_en: The mechanic determined why my bicycle brakes were sticking.
example1_zh: 修车师傅查明了我的自行车刹车卡住的原因。
example2_en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
example2_zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。

meanings_zh: 有决心的；意志坚定的
n. 示意图；图解；v. 用图解表示
example1_en: The diagram shows how to put the shelves together.
example1_zh: 这张示意图展示了如何组装架子。
example2_en: A clear diagram can help students understand complex biological processes more effectively than a lengthy explanation.
example2_zh: 一张清晰的示意图能比冗长的讲解更有效地帮助学生理解复杂的生物过程。

meanings_zh: 进退两难的境地；困境
n. 折扣；v. 打折出售；v. 不予考虑；低估
example1_en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
example1_zh: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。
example2_en: Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。

meanings_zh: v. 乔装；掩饰；n. 伪装；乔装用品
example1_en: Nadia disguised herself with a wig and oversized glasses.
example1_zh: 娜迪娅戴上假发和超大眼镜，把自己乔装起来。
example2_en: Attractive packaging can disguise poor product quality, making it harder for consumers to make informed choices.
example2_zh: 精美包装可能掩盖产品质量问题，使消费者更难作出明智选择。

meanings_zh: n. 地区；行政区
example1_en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
example1_zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。
example2_en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
example2_zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。

meanings_zh: adj. 多种多样的；不同的
example1_en: Our garden attracts a diverse range of colourful birds.
example1_zh: 我们家的花园吸引了各种色彩鲜艳的鸟儿。
example2_en: A culturally diverse workforce can bring fresh perspectives and improve an organisation's ability to solve problems.
example2_zh: 文化背景多元的员工队伍可以带来新视角，提高组织解决问题的能力。

meanings_zh: n. 多样性；差异性
example1_en: Our garden attracts a surprising diversity of colourful birds.
example1_zh: 我们的花园吸引了种类多得惊人的彩色鸟儿。
example2_en: Cultural diversity can enrich urban life by introducing residents to different traditions, languages, and perspectives.
example2_zh: 文化多样性能让居民接触不同的传统、语言和观点，从而丰富城市生活。

meanings_zh: 两架航天器）对接：（使）；进港；码头；船坞
n. 文件；证件；文档；v. 记录；记载
example1_en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
example1_zh: 合上笔记本电脑之前，请保存文档。
example2_en: Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.
example2_zh: 研究人员应记录当地野生生物的变化，以评估城市开发对环境的影响。

meanings_zh: n. 点；小圆点；v. 散布于；点缀；n. 网址或邮箱中的点
example1_en: Her yellow umbrella has a pattern of blue dots.
example1_zh: 她的黄色雨伞上有蓝色圆点图案。
example2_en: Small villages dot the coastline, attracting visitors who prefer quieter alternatives to crowded seaside resorts.
example2_zh: 小村庄散布在海岸线上，吸引了那些偏爱宁静而非拥挤海滨度假区的游客。

meanings_zh: adv. 在楼下；往楼下；adj. 楼下的
example1_en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
example1_zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。
example2_en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
example2_zh: 在楼下设置卧室可以帮助老年住户在自己家中保持独立生活。

meanings_zh: adv. 在市中心；往市中心；adj. 市中心的；n. 市中心；商业中心区
example1_en: We took the bus downtown to buy new shoes.
example1_zh: 我们乘公交车去市中心买新鞋。
example2_en: Improved public transport can encourage more residents to shop downtown rather than drive to suburban shopping centres.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以鼓励更多居民到市中心购物，而不是开车前往郊区购物中心。

meanings_zh: 龙
adj. 到期应付的；应交的；adj. 预期的；预计到达的；adj. 应得的；应有的
example1_en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
example1_zh: 我们的房租本周末到期应付。
example2_en: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
example2_zh: 学费到期应缴时，一些学生难以同时承担教育支出和基本生活费用。

meanings_zh: adj. 渴望的；热切的
example1_en: The children were eager to open their presents.
example1_zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想拆开礼物。
example2_en: Many graduates are eager to gain practical experience before committing to a particular career path.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生渴望先积累实践经验，再决定具体的职业道路。

meanings_zh: v. 挣得；赚取；v. 赢得；博得
example1_en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
example1_zh: 她放学后帮人遛狗，赚些零花钱。
example2_en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
example2_zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。

meanings_zh: 埃及(国家名)
adj. 埃及的；埃及人的；n. 埃及人
example1_en: We admired Egyptian pottery at the museum yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天在博物馆欣赏了埃及陶器。
example2_en: Ancient Egyptian irrigation systems demonstrate how communities adapted farming practices to seasonal changes in river levels.
example2_zh: 古埃及的灌溉系统展示了当地居民如何调整耕作方式，以适应河流水位的季节性变化。

meanings_zh: v. 选举；推选；v. 选择；决定
example1_en: Our club elected a new captain last night.
example1_zh: 我们俱乐部昨晚选出了一位新队长。
example2_en: Citizens should elect representatives who are willing to address long-term environmental challenges rather than seek immediate popularity.
example2_zh: 公民应当选举愿意应对长期环境挑战的代表，而不是追求眼前人气的人。

meanings_zh: n. 选举；n. 当选
example1_en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
example1_zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。
example2_en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
example2_zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。

meanings_zh: n. 要素；组成部分；n. 化学元素；n. 恶劣天气
example1_en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
example1_zh: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。
example2_en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.
example2_zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。

meanings_zh: adv. 在别处；到别处
example1_en: This café is full, so let's eat elsewhere.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆坐满了，我们去别处吃吧。
example2_en: When local housing becomes unaffordable, young workers often move elsewhere in search of better living conditions.
example2_zh: 当本地住房变得难以负担时，年轻劳动者往往会迁往别处，寻找更好的生活条件。

meanings_zh: 使能够；使可能
使遭受危险；危害
v. 确保；保证
example1_en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
example1_zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that affordable public transport is available to residents in both urban and rural areas.
example2_zh: 政府应确保城市和农村居民都能享有价格实惠的公共交通。

meanings_zh: n. 入口；大门；n. 进入；入学资格
example1_en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后我在入口处与你碰面。
example2_en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
example2_zh: 大学应确保入学要求兼顾不同教育背景，同时维持适当的学术标准。

meanings_zh: v. 委托；托付
example1_en: I entrusted my neighbour with the spare house key.
example1_zh: 我把家里的备用钥匙托付给了邻居。
example2_en: Parents entrust schools with their children's education and expect teachers to provide a safe learning environment.
example2_zh: 家长把孩子的教育托付给学校，并期待教师提供安全的学习环境。

meanings_zh: n. 信封
example1_en: She slipped the birthday card into a blue envelope.
example1_zh: 她把生日贺卡放进了一个蓝色信封。
example2_en: Although digital communication is widespread, official documents are still sometimes delivered in a sealed envelope for privacy.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信十分普及，官方文件有时仍会装在密封信封里送达，以保护隐私。

meanings_zh: n. 设备；器材；装备
example1_en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
example1_zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。
example2_en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
example2_zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

meanings_zh: v. 逃跑；逃脱；v. 避开；免遭；n. 逃脱；解脱
example1_en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
example1_zh: 我们的兔子从围栏的一处小缝隙逃走了。
example2_en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
example2_zh: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。

meanings_zh: v. 建立；创立；v. 确立；使获认可；v. 查明；证实
example1_en: Our neighbours established a gardening club last spring.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居去年春天成立了一个园艺俱乐部。
example2_en: Governments should establish clear standards to ensure that new housing is both safe and energy efficient.
example2_zh: 政府应制定明确的标准，确保新建住房既安全又节能。

meanings_zh: 具有民族特色的；异国风味的；民族的；种族的
n. 节日或重大事件的前夕；n. 夏娃
example1_en: We cooked a special dinner together on New Year's Eve.
example1_zh: 我们在除夕夜一起做了一顿特别的晚餐。
example2_en: On New Year's Eve, cities often extend public transport services to help large crowds travel home safely.
example2_zh: 在除夕夜，城市往往延长公共交通的运营时间，帮助大批人群安全返家。

meanings_zh: adv. 最终；终于
example1_en: After searching every room, we eventually found the missing keys.
example1_zh: 搜遍每个房间后，我们终于找到了丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Investment in public transport may initially be expensive, but it can eventually reduce congestion and improve urban life.
example2_zh: 公共交通投资起初可能成本高昂，但最终能够缓解拥堵并改善城市生活。

meanings_zh: n. 证据；迹象；v. 表明；证明
example1_en: The muddy footprints were evidence that someone had entered.
example1_zh: 泥脚印表明有人进来过。
example2_en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
example2_zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

meanings_zh: adj. 邪恶的；恶毒的；n. 邪恶；罪恶；祸害
example1_en: In the story, an evil wizard steals everyone's dreams.
example1_zh: 故事里，一个邪恶的巫师偷走了所有人的梦。
example2_en: Literature often explores the conflict between good and evil through characters who face difficult moral choices.
example2_zh: 文学作品常通过面临艰难道德选择的人物，探讨善与恶的冲突。

meanings_zh: v. 存在；v. 生存；勉强维生
example1_en: Do you think creatures like these really exist?
example1_zh: 你觉得这样的生物真的存在吗？
example2_en: Significant differences in access to healthcare still exist between rural communities and major urban centres.
example2_zh: 农村社区与主要城市中心在医疗服务的可及性方面仍存在显著差异。

meanings_zh: n. 出口；通道；v. 离开；退出
example1_en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
example1_zh: 我们在电影院后部找到了出口。
example2_en: Public buildings must have clearly visible emergency exits so that occupants can leave safely during an evacuation.
example2_zh: 公共建筑必须设有清晰可见的紧急出口，以便楼内人员在疏散时安全离开。

meanings_zh: v. 出口；输出；n. 出口；出口商品；v. 导出数据
example1_en: My aunt's company exports handmade bowls to several countries.
example1_zh: 我姑姑的公司向多个国家出口手工碗。
example2_en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
example2_zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格突变的冲击。

meanings_zh: n. 程度；范围
example1_en: We only discovered the extent of the leak yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天才发现漏水有多严重。
example2_en: The extent to which public transport reduces pollution depends on passenger numbers and energy sources.
example2_zh: 公共交通能在多大程度上减少污染，取决于乘客数量和能源来源。

meanings_zh: adj. 外部的；外面的；adj. 来自外部的
example1_en: The builders painted the external walls pale yellow.
example1_zh: 建筑工人把外墙刷成了淡黄色。
example2_en: Universities often rely on external funding to conduct research that cannot be supported by tuition fees alone.
example2_zh: 大学经常依赖外部资金，开展仅靠学费无法支持的研究。

meanings_zh: adj. 灭绝的；adj. 死的；不再喷发的
example1_en: My little cousin asked why dinosaurs became extinct.
example1_zh: 我的小表弟问恐龙为什么灭绝了。
example2_en: Without stronger habitat protection, many endangered species could become extinct within the next few decades.
example2_zh: 如果不加强栖息地保护，许多濒危物种可能在未来几十年内灭绝。

meanings_zh: n. 灭绝；消亡
example1_en: These rare birds face extinction if their forest disappears.
example1_zh: 如果这片森林消失，这些珍稀鸟类就会面临灭绝。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential to preventing the extinction of species threatened by intensive farming and urban expansion.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于防止受集约化农业和城市扩张威胁的物种灭绝至关重要。

meanings_zh: 离言；寓言故事
n. 设施；专用场所；n. 功能；服务；n. 天赋；熟练能力
example1_en: The new sports facility has a bright indoor pool.
example1_zh: 这座新体育设施里有一个明亮的室内泳池。
example2_en: Investing in local healthcare facilities can improve access to essential services for people in rural communities.
example2_zh: 投资当地医疗设施可以让农村社区居民更容易获得基本服务。

meanings_zh: v. 褪色；使褪色；v. 逐渐减弱；逐渐消失
example1_en: The curtains have faded after years of bright sunlight.
example1_zh: 窗帘经过多年强烈日晒，已经褪色了。
example2_en: Public interest in environmental campaigns may fade unless organisations provide regular updates and opportunities for participation.
example2_zh: 如果组织不定期提供最新进展和参与机会，公众对环保活动的兴趣可能会逐渐减退。

meanings_zh: adj. 微弱的；隐约的；adj. 头晕欲倒的；v. 昏倒；晕厥
example1_en: A faint light shone through the bedroom curtains.
example1_zh: 一丝微弱的光透过卧室窗帘照了进来。
example2_en: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to detect faint objects that cannot be seen with the naked eye.
example2_zh: 天文学家使用高性能望远镜探测肉眼看不见的暗弱天体。

meanings_zh: n. 信任；信心；n. 宗教信仰；宗教
example1_en: I have faith in your ability to fix this.
example1_zh: 我相信你有能力修好这个。
example2_en: Transparent decision-making can strengthen public faith in institutions and encourage greater participation in community affairs.
example2_zh: 透明的决策过程能够增强公众对机构的信任，并鼓励更多人参与社区事务。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不真实的；adj. 假的；人造的；adj. 不真诚的；虚伪的
example1_en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
example1_zh: 那条关于我们邻居的传闻完全不实。
example2_en: Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.
example2_zh: 声称所有网络信息都可靠是错误的，因此学生应学会批判性地评估信息来源。

meanings_zh: v. 想要；想做；adj. 精致的；豪华的；v. 爱慕；觉得有吸引力
example1_en: Do you fancy a walk by the river after lunch?
example1_zh: 午饭后你想去河边散步吗？
example2_en: Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.
example2_zh: 一些游客更喜欢简朴的当地住宿，而非豪华酒店，因为前者提供更多文化交流机会。

meanings_zh: 遥远的
adj. 极有吸引力的；迷人的
example1_en: The guide told us fascinating stories about the castle.
example1_zh: 导游给我们讲了关于这座城堡的精彩故事。
example2_en: Museum collections offer fascinating insights into how earlier societies adapted to changes in their natural environments.
example2_zh: 博物馆藏品让人们深入了解早期社会如何适应自然环境的变化，令人着迷。

meanings_zh: adj. 致命的；adj. 毁灭性的；导致失败的
example1_en: These wild mushrooms can be fatal if you eat them.
example1_zh: 这些野生蘑菇吃了可能会致命。
example2_en: Lower speed limits near schools can reduce the risk of fatal accidents involving pedestrians and cyclists.
example2_zh: 降低学校附近的限速可以减少涉及行人和骑车人的致命事故风险。

meanings_zh: n. 盛宴；丰盛的一餐；n. 感官盛宴；v. 尽情享用；饱餐
example1_en: We prepared a feast for the whole family.
example1_zh: 我们为全家准备了一顿盛宴。
example2_en: Traditional festivals often include a communal feast that strengthens relationships and preserves local food culture.
example2_zh: 传统节日常有集体宴席，既增进人际关系，也传承当地饮食文化。

meanings_zh: n. 特点；特色；v. 以…为特色；重点展示；n. 面部特征；五官之一
example1_en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
example1_zh: 这个背包最让我喜欢的特点是它的隐藏口袋。
example2_en: Public parks are an essential feature of cities that prioritise residents' health and wellbeing.
example2_zh: 在重视居民健康与福祉的城市中，公共公园是一项不可或缺的特色。

meanings_zh: n. 服务费；学费；酬金
example1_en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
example1_zh: 这家健身房每节课收取少量费用。
example2_en: High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.
example2_zh: 高昂的学费可能使家境困难的学生不愿申请大学，即使有经济援助可用。

meanings_zh: adj. 财务的；财政的；金融的
example1_en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
example1_zh: 购买第一套住房前，我们咨询了理财建议。
example2_en: Financial support for disadvantaged students can improve access to higher education and reduce long-term inequality.
example2_zh: 为弱势学生提供经济支持可以增加他们接受高等教育的机会，并减少长期存在的不平等。

meanings_zh: 鞭炮；爆竹
n. 烟花；焰火
example1_en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
example1_zh: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。
example2_en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
example2_zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引游客，但其噪声可能打扰当地居民和野生动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 灵活的；可调整的；adj. 柔韧的；易弯曲的
example1_en: My flexible schedule lets me collect the children after school.
example1_zh: 我的时间安排很灵活，可以在放学后接孩子。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

meanings_zh: v. 漂浮；浮动；v. 提出供考虑；n. 游行彩车
example1_en: A yellow leaf floated gently across the garden pond.
example1_zh: 一片黄叶轻轻漂过花园里的池塘。
example2_en: Researchers have floated the idea of using artificial islands to provide additional housing in crowded coastal cities.
example2_zh: 研究人员提出了利用人工岛为拥挤的沿海城市提供更多住房的想法。

meanings_zh: n. 泡沫；n. 泡沫材料；v. 起泡沫
example1_en: White foam covered my hands as I washed the dishes.
example1_zh: 洗碗时，白色泡沫盖满了我的双手。
example2_en: Manufacturers often use foam packaging to protect fragile goods, although some types are difficult to recycle.
example2_zh: 制造商常用泡沫包装保护易碎商品，但某些泡沫材料难以回收。

meanings_zh: v. 折叠；对折；n. 褶；折痕；v. 倒闭；停业
example1_en: Please fold these towels and put them on the shelf.
example1_zh: 请把这些毛巾叠好，放到架子上。
example2_en: Small businesses may fold when rising rental costs make it impossible to maintain a reasonable profit.
example2_zh: 当租金上涨导致无法维持合理利润时，小企业可能倒闭。

meanings_zh: adj. 以前的；前任的；adj. 前者的
example1_en: My former neighbour still visits us every summer.
example1_zh: 我以前的邻居每年夏天仍会来看我们。
example2_en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
example2_zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

meanings_zh: n. 大笔财富；n. 运气；命运
example1_en: That tiny flat near the station costs a fortune.
example1_zh: 车站附近那套小公寓贵得惊人。
example2_en: Some entrepreneurs build a fortune by developing affordable products that meet previously overlooked needs.
example2_zh: 一些创业者通过开发满足以往被忽视需求的平价产品，积累了巨额财富。

meanings_zh: 坦率的；直率的；坦白说；坦率地说
边境；国界；边远地区
皱眉
n. 功能；作用；v. 运转；发挥作用；n. 函数
example1_en: What is the function of this small red button?
example1_zh: 这个红色小按钮有什么作用？
example2_en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
example2_zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

meanings_zh: n. 基金；专用资金；n. 资金；财力；v. 为……提供资金
example1_en: We started a small fund to repair the playground.
example1_zh: 我们设立了一笔小额专款，用来修缮游乐场。
example2_en: Governments should fund research into renewable energy to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve energy security.
example2_zh: 政府应资助可再生能源研究，以减少对化石燃料的依赖并提高能源安全。

meanings_zh: adv. 进一步；更远地；adj. 更多的；进一步的；v. 促进；推进
example1_en: We walked further along the beach before stopping.
example1_zh: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。
example2_en: Further research is needed to understand how urban green spaces affect residents' mental health.
example2_zh: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。

meanings_zh: n. 画廊；美术馆；n. 楼座；旁听席；n. 图片集；图库
example1_en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
example1_zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。
example2_en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
example2_zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。

meanings_zh: v. 收集；搜集；v. 聚集；召集；v. 推断；理解
example1_en: We gathered fallen apples in a basket before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们把掉落的苹果收进了篮子。
example2_en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
example2_zh: 研究人员向当地居民收集信息，以了解公共交通如何影响就业机会的获取。

meanings_zh: adj. 慷慨的；大方的；adj. 充足的；大量的
example1_en: Our generous neighbour shared her fresh vegetables with us.
example1_zh: 我们那位大方的邻居把新鲜蔬菜分给了我们。
example2_en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
example2_zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；n. 巨人；n. 大企业；杰出人物
example1_en: A giant pumpkin filled almost the entire garden cart.
example1_zh: 一个巨大的南瓜几乎占满了整辆园艺推车。
example2_en: Technology giants have considerable influence over how people access information and communicate with one another.
example2_zh: 科技巨头对人们获取信息和相互交流的方式有很大影响。

meanings_zh: n. 地球仪；n. 地球；世界；n. 球体；球状物
example1_en: She spun the globe and pointed to a tiny island.
example1_zh: 她转动地球仪，指向一座小岛。
example2_en: Researchers across the globe are sharing climate data to improve predictions of extreme weather events.
example2_zh: 世界各地的研究人员正在共享气候数据，以提高对极端天气事件的预测能力。

meanings_zh: abbr.全球(卫星)定位系统
n. 优雅；优美；n. 宽限；恩惠；v. 为…增色；使优美
example1_en: The dancer moved across the stage with effortless grace.
example1_zh: 那位舞者轻盈优雅地穿过舞台。
example2_en: A short grace period can help households manage unexpected delays in receiving their income.
example2_zh: 短暂的宽限期可以帮助家庭应对收入意外延迟到账的情况。

meanings_zh: adj. 逐渐的；渐进的；adj. 坡度平缓的
example1_en: There was a gradual improvement in her sleep.
example1_zh: 她的睡眠逐渐改善了。
example2_en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
example2_zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。

meanings_zh: 涂鸦；胡写乱画
adj. 感激的；感谢的
example1_en: I am grateful for your help with the move.
example1_zh: 谢谢你帮我搬家。
example2_en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
example2_zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。

meanings_zh: n. 感激；感恩
example1_en: She brought fresh flowers to express her gratitude.
example1_zh: 她带来鲜花表达感激之情。
example2_en: Schools can encourage gratitude by helping students recognise the contributions that others make to their daily lives.
example2_zh: 学校可以帮助学生认识到他人对自己日常生活的贡献，从而培养感恩之心。

meanings_zh: 重力；引力
n. 指导原则；准则
example1_en: These guidelines explain how to store food safely.
example1_zh: 这些指南说明了如何安全储存食物。
example2_en: Clear guidelines on data collection can help researchers protect participants while maintaining the quality of their studies.
example2_zh: 明确的数据收集准则可以帮助研究人员在维持研究质量的同时保护参与者。

meanings_zh: 秋葵汤（用秋葵英做的浓鸡汤或海鲜汤
n. 栖息地；生存环境
example1_en: This pond provides a perfect habitat for frogs.
example1_zh: 这个池塘为青蛙提供了理想的栖息地。
example2_en: Urban expansion destroys natural habitats, making it harder for native species to find food and shelter.
example2_zh: 城市扩张破坏了自然栖息地，使本地物种更难找到食物和庇护所。

meanings_zh: n.万圣节前夕
n. 收割；收成；v. 收割；采收
example1_en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
example1_zh: 我们做了一个自制苹果派，庆祝苹果丰收。
example2_en: Unpredictable rainfall can reduce the annual harvest, threatening rural incomes and increasing food prices in cities.
example2_zh: 难以预测的降雨可能减少年度收成，威胁农村收入并推高城市食品价格。

meanings_zh: n. 脚后跟；n. 鞋跟
example1_en: These new shoes rub against my left heel.
example1_zh: 这双新鞋磨我的左脚后跟。
example2_en: Shoes that support the heel properly may improve comfort for people who spend long hours standing.
example2_zh: 能适当支撑脚后跟的鞋子，可以让长时间站立的人感觉更舒适。

meanings_zh: adj. 药草的；香草制的
example1_en: I usually drink herbal tea before going to bed.
example1_zh: 我通常在睡前喝花草茶。
example2_en: Although herbal remedies are widely used, their safety and effectiveness should be assessed through reliable scientific research.
example2_zh: 尽管草药疗法应用广泛，其安全性和有效性仍应通过可靠的科学研究来评估。

meanings_zh: n. 兽群；畜群；v. 驱赶；使聚集
example1_en: A herd of cows blocked the narrow country road.
example1_zh: 一群奶牛堵住了狭窄的乡间道路。
example2_en: Protecting migration routes allows herds of wild animals to reach essential sources of food and water.
example2_zh: 保护迁徙路线能让野生动物群到达重要的食物和水源所在地。

meanings_zh: n. 文化遗产；传承
example1_en: These old songs are part of our family heritage.
example1_zh: 这些老歌是我们家族传承的一部分。
example2_en: Protecting cultural heritage can strengthen community identity while attracting visitors who support local businesses.
example2_zh: 保护文化遗产能够增强社区认同感，同时吸引游客，支持当地商业。

meanings_zh: vi.犹豫;迟疑;顾虑
adj.高端的
n.嘻哈音乐;嘻哈文化
v. 雇用；v. 租用；n. 租用；租借
example1_en: We hired a van to move our furniture.
example1_zh: 我们租了一辆货车来搬家具。
example2_en: Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.
example2_zh: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。

meanings_zh: adj. 有历史意义的；历史著名的
example1_en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
example1_zh: 我们在日落前走过了那座历史名桥。
example2_en: Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
example2_zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市保留文化特色，同时吸引游客并支持当地商业。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人厌恶的；adj. 可怕的；令人震惊的
example1_en: A horrible smell came from the forgotten lunch box.
example1_zh: 那个被遗忘的午餐盒散发出难闻的气味。
example2_en: Residents described the horrible conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter enforcement of safety standards.
example2_zh: 居民描述了拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁更严格地执行安全标准。

meanings_zh: 猎人
v. 识别；辨认；v. 找出；确定；v. 产生共鸣；认同
example1_en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
example1_zh: 你能认出停在我们围栏上的那只鸟吗？
example2_en: Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.
example2_zh: 学校应尽早发现学习困难，让学生在落后之前获得适当的支持。

meanings_zh: n. 身份；n. 特性；认同感
example1_en: The receptionist checked my identity before handing me the key.
example1_zh: 接待员核实我的身份后，才把钥匙交给我。
example2_en: Preserving local languages can strengthen cultural identity while helping communities pass traditional knowledge to younger generations.
example2_zh: 保护地方语言能够增强文化认同，同时帮助社区向年轻一代传承传统知识。

meanings_zh: v. 忽视；不理睬
example1_en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
example1_zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。
example2_en: Governments cannot ignore the long-term effects of air pollution on children's health and development.
example2_zh: 政府不能忽视空气污染对儿童健康与发育的长期影响。

meanings_zh: adj. 非法的；违法的
example1_en: It is illegal to park here overnight without permission.
example1_zh: 未经许可在这里通宵停车是违法的。
example2_en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to prevent illegal fishing and protect vulnerable marine ecosystems.
